Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kütuseetteandemasinist
description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda kütuseetteandemasiniste, kes panustab Eesti ja Balti elektrijaamade igapäevasesse töösse ja aitab saavutada ettevõtte eesmärke. Töökohad on tähtajalised kuni 31.01.2027 töösuhte võimaliku pikendamisega.
Sinu tööülesanneteks on: • tagada tahkekütuse katkematu ja ohutu etteandmine elektrijaama tootmisprotsessis; • jälgida ja kontrollida kütuseetteandeseadmete ning -mehhanismide tööd; • kõrvaldada lihtsamaid rikkeid ja teha seadmete hooldustöid; • valmistada seadmeid ette remondiks ning võtta need pärast remonti vastu.

Omalt poolt pakume: • teha vastutusrikkast ja väärtustloovat tööd;
• väljaõpet töökohal; • toetava juhi ja meeskonna; • tasuta transport Narvast ja Sillamäelt; • liituda meie heaolupaketiga, mis võimaldab kasutada spordi- ja/või raviteenuseid soodsatel tingimustel. Hoolime sinu tervisest!

Muud nõuded: sul on vähemalt kesk- või kutseharidus;
oled valmis töötama graafiku alusel 12-tunnilistes vahetustes; oled kohusetundlik, täpne, korrektne ja sulle sobib töö meeskonnas.

title: Senior Server
description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

title: Cook
description:
Work tasks: - Prepare a variety of dishes and baked goods according to established recipes and quality standards.
- Handle and prepare fresh ingredients, including meat, vegetables, and dough. - Ensure that all baked products meet established standards for quality, taste, and presentation. - Follow precise measurements and preparation techniques to maintain consistent product quality. - Monitor the baking process to achieve optimal results. - Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant kitchen environment while operating modern kitchen equipment efficiently. - Monitor inventory levels, assist with ordering supplies, ensure proper storage and labeling of ingredients, and minimize waste. - Ensure compliance with food safety and sanitation standards by conducting regular inspections of kitchen equipment, workspaces, and storage areas. - Effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks, particularly during peak operating hours. - Adhere to work schedules and deadlines, ensuring that all products are prepared on time. - Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth kitchen operations and maintain a positive working environment. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and oversee the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory management, and overall operational readiness. - Develop and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly work plans covering staffing, production, inventory management, cleaning, maintenance, and other routine operational activities. - Communicate and collaborate effectively with service staff, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to ensure the smooth operation of the kitchen and restaurant. - Prepare and coordinate employee work schedules, breaks, replacements, and task assignments, adjusting staffing arrangements according to workload, employee absences, and operational needs. - Monitor customer service quality and assist service staff when necessary, particularly during peak hours, employee breaks, staff shortages, or employee absences.

We offer: - The opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly, supportive, and professional international team where every member’s contribution is valued. - Modern working conditions and professional equipment. - Competitive remuneration. - Opportunities for career advancement and personal development. - Affordable staff meals at our restaurant-bakery.

Other requirements: - Knowledge of baking techniques and current trends is an advantage.
- Strong attention to detail, reliability, excellent organizational skills, and commitment to maintaining hygiene and safety standards. - A positive, motivated, and cooperative attitude, with the ability to lead by example and maintain a positive working environment. - Leadership skills, including the ability to supervise and guide assistant cooks. - Passion for cooking and dedication to preparing high-quality food. - A valid health certificate for food handling. - Ability to work effectively under pressure and in a fast-paced environment. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required. Further details regarding the work schedule will be provided during the recruitment process. - Physical stamina to stand for extended periods and meet the demands of a busy restaurant-bakery environment.

title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment.
Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets.
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland.
We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas.
Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Töö on füüsiline ning eeldab valmisolekut tõsta ja liigutada kuni 20 kg kaaluvaid esemeid, seadmeid ja töövahendeid. Laupäev on tavapärase töögraafiku osa. Peamised tööülesanded Külalistoad Külalistubade ettevalmistamine, koristamine ja hooldamine Eha töö-, tervise- ja ohutusnõuete kohaselt. Majapidamiskäru ja laoruumide puhta ning korrastatuna hoidmine. Suhtlus ja meeskonnatöö Tõhus suhtlemine majapidamisjuhi ja teiste kolleegidega. Täpse teabe edastamine tehtud tööde, pooleliolevate ülesannete ja külaliste soovide kohta. Koostöö kolleegidega sujuva igapäevase töökorralduse tagamiseks. Professionaalse ja lugupidava käitumise säilitamine.

Põhjalikku väljaõpet ja tuge sisseelamisel. Tasuta toitlustust igal tööpäeval. Eha poolt vajalikke tööriideid. Transporti või sõidukompensatsiooni vastavalt kokkuleppele. Rollis arenedes ja oma võimekust näidates saad võtta rohkem vastutust, panustada majapidamisprotseduuride täiustamisse ning meeskonna kasvades liikuda edasi majapidamistööde juhendaja rolli.

title: Logistic & Event Specialist
description:
**Logistics Specialist — Events, Cleaning & Facility Operations**

**Hype Siivous | Helsinki, Finland Full-time or part-time**

Hype Siivous is looking for a reliable, practical and proactive Logistics Specialist to support event preparation, cleaning and daily operations at an innovation facility hosting approximately 500–600 internal community and private events annually.

This hands-on role combines furniture setup, equipment movement, cleaning and facility support. You will take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate clearly and help leave every space safe, organised and ready for use.

Cleaning is a regular and essential part of this position. The role is not limited to event logistics or furniture preparation.

**_YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES_**

Event preparation and logistics Prepare meeting rooms and event spaces according to agreed floor plans and event requirements. Arrange tables, chairs and equipment with attention to presentation, accessibility and safe movement. Handle load-in and load-out: move furniture, equipment and supplies into and out of the venue. Move items between nearby spaces or locations, including driving when assigned. Support orderly venue entry and departure, keeping entrances, exits and circulation routes clear. Restore furniture and equipment after events. Check equipment and furniture and report damage or missing items. Follow safe lifting and handling procedures, using suitable equipment and team support.

Cleaning and facility care Clean and prepare spaces before, during and after events. Vacuum and mop floors, wipe tables, chairs and accessible surfaces, empty bins and remove ordinary waste. Carry out assigned cleaning of meeting rooms, event spaces, common areas, kitchens or kitchenettes, and washrooms. Leave spaces clean, organised and ready for their next use. Use cleaning products and equipment safely, following training and site instructions. Report maintenance needs, missing supplies and cleanliness or safety concerns.

Communication and ownership Coordinate with the Event Manager and facility team on schedules, layouts, changes and readiness. Plan and prioritise work during busy periods. Complete tasks with limited supervision while keeping colleagues informed. Provide clear handovers and report delays or unfinished tasks promptly. Follow through on commitments, take responsibility and ask for support when needed. Help coordinate practical setup tasks with colleagues when assigned.

The balance between logistics, event preparation and cleaning varies with the event schedule and facility needs. Duties are carried out within the agreed role, training and safe working practices.

**_What we are looking for_**

Relevant experience in event logistics, furniture setup, cleaning, facility operations or similar practical work. A valid category B driving licence and driving experience. Excellent practical English for understanding instructions, coordinating tasks and reporting issues. Finnish and/or Swedish language skills are an advantage, but are not required. Ability to safely perform physically demanding logistics and cleaning duties, using appropriate handling equipment and team support. Good understanding of room layouts and furniture positioning. Strong organisation, attention to detail and a cooperative attitude towards logistics and cleaning duties. Initiative, practical leadership and a strong sense of responsibility. A calm, solution-focused approach when schedules change or deadlines are tight. Ability to work independently while staying connected with the team.

Work eligibility: Applicants must have a valid right to work in Finland for this role and a lawful basis to reside in Finland. Where a residence permit is required, it must be valid and allow the work concerned. Relevant documentation will be verified before employment begins.

Preferred qualifications: An Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti) and Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi) are advantages, but are not mandatory requirements for applying.

**_Employment and working hours_**

Full-time: Permanent employment, 37.5 hours per week. Full-time work and onboarding start on 15 January 2027.

Part-time: Starts immediately and continues until further notice. Variable working hours of 0–20 hours per week. No minimum weekly hours are guaranteed.

Schedule: Monday to Saturday, with agreed early-morning, daytime or evening shifts according to event bookings. Workload varies seasonally, with greater staffing needs during busy periods. Flexibility means working agreed shifts—not being available around the clock. 6.5 hours a day.

Pay: According to the applicable collective agreement.

**_What we offer_**

A varied role combining event logistics, cleaning and facility support. An active innovation environment with community and private events. Opportunities to take ownership of practical operations and develop coordination skills. Collaboration with event management and the facility team. Onboarding into venue layouts, equipment, cleaning methods and safety procedures.

**_How to apply_**

Send your CV and a short introduction to **_employment@hypesiivous.fi_** by 31 October 2026.

Please include: Your relevant logistics, event preparation and cleaning experience. Your driving experience and licence category. Your language skills, including English and any Finnish or Swedish. Your availability and earliest starting date. Whether you are applying for part-time or full-time work. Whether you hold an Occupational Safety Card or Hygiene Passport. Confirmation of whether you currently have the right to work in Finland for this role.

Please do not send passport or residence-permit copies with your initial application. Relevant documentation will be checked securely before employment begins.

We assess applicants on their skills, experience and ability to perform the role safely.

title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
description:
Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!

In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.

In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that:
Every moment is pedagogical
Play is the foundation of learning
Learning happens throughout the whole day
Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround
Childrens interests and questions guide learning

Your core responsibilities:
Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities
Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses
Observe and document childrens learning and development
Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families
Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals
Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoors

Our daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.

We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.

Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027:
Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship
At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education
At least level B2 in English language
Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly.

Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028:
Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language
Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland
Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre
Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis

We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.

We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible:
Assistance with degree recognition process
Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment
Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland
Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members)
Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.

Language training and relocation schedule:
Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential.
Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.

Salary and benefits:
Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience
ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting)
Comprehensive private occupational health care
Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers
Holiday bonus pay

Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process:
Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc
Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY
Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4

We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!

Please note:
(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.
(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

title: People Analytics Partner
description:
The People Analytics Partner serves as a strategic advisor to senior business and HR leaders across Marine, Energy and Group Functions, enabling data informed decisions on workforce, talent, organizational effectiveness and future workforce priorities.

By combining business acumen, consulting expertise and advanced analytics, the role translates complex business challenges into actionable workforce insights and recommendations. The People Analytics Partner partners closely with leaders to identify opportunities, address organizational challenges and maximize the impact of people-related investments and interventions.

Beyond delivering insights, the role plays a key part in advancing Wärtsilä's People Analytics capabilities. This includes shaping the People Analytics roadmap, supporting the evolution and adoption of Visier, onboarding new workforce data sources and ensuring that analytics solutions continue to meet evolving business and HR needs.

The role also acts as a catalyst for data-informed decision-making, helping build analytical capabilities across HR and promoting innovative approaches to address future workforce and work challenges.

We are ideally looking for an individual based in Finland to connect and align with senior stakeholders and group corporate functions and operate across global timezones, but would consider other European locations.

Key accountabilities:


1. Strategic Workforce Advisory & Business Partnering


* Partner with senior business leaders, HR Business Partners and COEs across Marine, Energy and Group Functions to identify strategic workforce challenges and opportunities.
* Shape and influence workforce, talent and organizational decisions through data-informed insights and evidence-based recommendations.
* Act as a trusted advisor on workforce composition, talent flows, retention, competences, leadership effectiveness and employee experience.
* Support business strategy execution by translating strategic priorities into workforce analytics and actionable recommendations.
* Facilitate strategic discussions with senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions and guide decision-making through data and evidence.
* Lead complex analyses to identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities impacting business performance.
* Deliver end-to-end people analytics projects, from problem definition and stakeholder engagement through analysis, recommendations and implementation support.
* Develop predictive, diagnostic and scenario-based analyses to support proactive workforce decisions.


2. People Intelligence & Analytics Platform Development


* Lead the onboarding and integration of new data sources into Visier, including talent, learning, engagement, organizational effectiveness and workforce planning data.
* Collaborate with HR COEs and business stakeholders to define business requirements and prioritize analytics development initiatives.
* Drive the development of scalable analytics solutions, dashboards and self-service capabilities.
* Contribute to the People Analytics roadmap, ensuring alignment between business priorities, HR strategy and technology investments.
* Champion data governance principles and support the continuous improvement of workforce data quality, accessibility and trust.
* Partner with HR Technology, Data Governance and Process Owners to continuously enhance Wärtsilä's People Analytics ecosystem.


3. Capability Building, Innovation & Thought Leadership


* Promote data-informed decision-making across HR and business communities.
* Build analytics capabilities within HR by educating stakeholders on workforce insights, analytics methodologies and best practices.
* Stay current with external trends in People Analytics, AI, workforce intelligence and employee listening.
* Drive the adoption of new analytics capabilities and innovative approaches to workforce decision-making.
* Contribute to the evolution of People Analytics methodologies, governance and operating models.


Experience & Qualifications:

Required


* Significant experience in People Analytics, Workforce Planning, HR Consulting or a related analytical role.
* Experience partnering with senior business and HR leaders in a global organization.
* Proven track record of leading complex analytics or consulting projects from concept to implementation.
* Experience working with workforce data, analytics platforms and visualization tools.
* English is our common business lannguage, fluency in both written spoken English is mandatory.


Preferred


* Master's in Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Psychology or a related field.
* 8-12+ years of relevant experience in consulting, People Analytics, Workforce Planning or HR Strategy.
* Experience with Visier and modern HR analytics ecosystems.
* Experience in predictive analytics, employee listening and organizational effectiveness.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics and future workforce trends.


Contact & next steps:


We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

title: Project Assistant, Metso
description:
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/c6d6529a-671b-48f7-b799-567e88253d31/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Project Assistant?

We are looking for a Project Assistant to join Metsos Document Control and Project Support team. You will be part of large international plant delivery projects, supporting delivery teams and ensuring that practical arrangements run smoothly and efficiently.

In this role, you organize travel arrangements for project personnel and customers, including flights, accommodation, and ground transportation. You prepare visa invitation letters for customers and suppliers and coordinate visa and work permit processes for project personnel across different countries.

You organize meetings both at the office and at external locations, ensuring that all arrangements are in place. You take care of ordering necessary materials such as personal protective equipment (PPE) and business gifts, and act as a key contact for travel agencies. In addition, you handle travel-related invoices and maintain up-to-date traveler profiles.

This is a full-time, one-year fixed-term position with the strong possibility of continuation. The position starts as soon as possible. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Metso. The position is based in Espoo and requires working at the office 3 days per week.

What are we looking for?

To succeed in this role, you bring a few years of experience from assistant or project support roles. You are comfortable working with MS Office tools and have experience with invoice handling and travel expense systems. You are familiar with visa and work permit processes in different countries, and you have a good understanding of travel safety and handling travel-related personal data. Fluent Finnish and English skills, both written and spoken, are essential, and additional language skills are considered an asset.

You have a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work and can prioritize effectively and adapt to changing situations. You take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating smoothly as part of a team. Experience working in an international environment and an understanding of different cultures are considered an advantage.

Why us?

We value our dedicated and driven professionals. As an important part of our highly motivated and skilled team, you contribute directly to our shared success. title: Närvårdare
description:
VERKSAMHETEN
Äldreomsorgen i Mariehamns stad sysselsätter omkring 200 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder bland annat hemservice, dagverksamhet, korttidsvård, serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg samt institutionsvård. De aktuella tjänsterna som ska tillsättas är placerade inom hemservice.

ARBETET
Arbetet består av att utföra grundläggande omvårdnadsinsatser utifrån klientens behov genom ett rehabiliterande och aktiverande förhållningssätt. Samtliga klienter har en kontaktperson som bland annat ansvarar för planering av insatser, uppföljning och att ge information. Dokumentation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet. Som närvårdare inom hemservice arbetar du självständigt men har alltid kollegor att samarbeta med.

För tillsvidare anställning söker vi dig som har formell behörighet som närvårdare med skyddad yrkesbeteckning och är registrerad i Valvira. Om du saknar den formella behörigheten som närvårdare så är du ändå välkommen att söka och kan då vara aktuell för ett vikariat. Du klarar av varierande arbetsuppgifter, har ett fint bemötande och bidrar till arbetsglädje. Du kan arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med kollegor samt de övriga professionerna du kommer i kontakt med. Du har en positiv inställning till, och bidrar till verksamhetens kontinuerliga förbättringsarbete.

VILLKOR
Vi kan erbjuda följande platser:

6 st 100 %
2 st 91,5 %
2 st 75 %

Samtliga anställningar är tillsvidare i arbetsavtalsförhållande. Arbetet inleds med en prövotid om 6 månader och startar enligt överenskommelse. Grundlönen är 2874,34 euro i månaden för heltidsarbete och uppfyllda behörighetskrav, vidare tillkommer eventuella erfarenhetstillägg och individuella lönetillägg. Staden erbjuder dessutom omfattande företagshälsovård och friskvårdsförmåner.

Anställningen kräver vaccinationsskydd i enlighet med § 48 i Lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016).

ANSÖKAN
Vi ber dig söka platsen genom länken i denna annons.

title: Liikkuva huoltoasentaja, Cafe Break Finland Oy
description:
Haluatko työn, jossa yhdistyvät tekniikka, asiakaspalvelu ja itsenäinen työskentely?

Cafe Break on yksi Suomen suurimmista työpaikkojen kahvi- ja vesiratkaisuihin erikoistuneista yrityksistä. Palvelemme yli 1 800 asiakasta ympäri Suomen, ja automaateistamme nautitaan päivittäin yli 350 000 kupillista kahvia. Menestyksemme perustuu erinomaiseen asiakaspalveluun, nopeaan huoltoon sekä paikalliseen, yrittäjähenkiseen toimintatapaan. Asiakkaamme saavat oman kahvin ammattilaisen, joka pitää huolen siitä, että kahvitauot toimivat ilman katkoksia.

Nyt etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme liikkuvaa huoltoasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen palvelemaan asiakkaitamme Pirkanmaan, Varsinais-Suomen ja Satakunnan alueella.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Työssä vastaat kahvi- ja vesiautomaattien:

- vikahuolloista
- uusien laitteiden asennuksista
- määräaikaishuolloista ja pesuista
- teknisestä vianetsinnästä
- asiakaspalvelusta asiakkaiden tiloissa
- omien huoltoreittien ja työpäivien suunnittelusta.
Cafe Breakin tärkeimpiä kilpailuetuja ovat huollon laatu ja nopeus. Siksi etsimme henkilöä, joka pystyy reagoimaan nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja ratkomaan ongelmia asiakkaiden arjessa.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

- nautit teknisten ongelmien ratkaisemisesta
- ymmärrät mekaanisten laitteiden toimintaa
- sinua kiinnostavat pumput, venttiilit, putkistot, liikkuvat osat ja elektroniikka
- työskentelet vastuullisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti
- osaat suunnitella työpäiväsi itsenäisesti
- siedät kiirettä, muutoksia ja ajoittaista epävarmuutta
- kohtaat asiakkaat ammattimaisesti myös haastavissa tilanteissa
- kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi.
Aikaisempaa kokemusta kahvi- tai vesiautomaateista ei tarvita. Tehtävässä tärkeintä ovat tekninen kiinnostus, oppimiskyky sekä halu sitoutua pitkäjänteisesti uuteen ammattiin.

Miksi tämä tehtävä on erilainen?

Tämä ei ole perinteinen huoltoasentajan työ, jossa päivän tehtävät ovat täsmälleen tiedossa aamulla.

Asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnan kannalta toimivat kahvi- ja vesiautomaatit ovat tärkeitä, joten kiireellinen vikailmoitus voi muuttaa koko päivän aikataulun hetkessä. Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinun tulee viihtyä liikkuvassa työssä, osata priorisoida ja pysyä toimintakykyisenä myös silloin, kun kaikki ei mene alkuperäisen suunnitelman mukaan.

Jos nautit itsenäisyydestä, vastuusta ja ongelmanratkaisusta, tämä työ tarjoaa siihen erinomaiset mahdollisuudet.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- vakituisen työsuhteen vakavaraisessa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä
- kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään
- kokeneen organisaation teknisen tuen
- tarvittavat hygienia- ja sähköturvallisuuskoulutukset
- yrityksen auton jolla kulkea työajot sekä polttoainekortin
- ePassi-/lounasedun
- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksesi mukaan (n. 16-18 €/h)
Työaika ja sijainti

- Työ on pääsääntöisesti arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä.
- Toiminta-alueena ovat Pirkanmaa, Varsinais-Suomi ja Satakunta.
- Työ sisältää runsaasti ajamista ja liikkumista asiakaskohteiden välillä.
Barona hoitaa rekrytointiprosessin Cafe Breakin puolesta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Valittu henkilö tulee työllistymään suoraan Cafe Breakille.

Etsimme pitkäaikaista tekijää, joka haluaa kehittyä kahvi- ja vesiautomaattien huollon ammattilaiseksi osana yritystä, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat erinomainen asiakaspalvelu, rehellisyys, suomalainen yrittäjyys sekä nopea huoltopalvelu.

Take a break... Cafe Break!

title: Yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettaja (Parola)
description:
Haemme yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Parolaan!

Etsitkö monipuolista kuljettajan työtä, jossa päivät eivät toista itseään? Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään ajotyön ja käytännön tekemisen osana vakavaraisen alan yrityksen toimintaa.

Työssäsi kuljetat raskaan kaluston renkaita asiakkaille sekä noudat pinnoitettavia renkaita takaisin käsiteltäväksi. Lähtöpiste sijaitsee Parolassa, josta kuormat lastataan pääsääntöisesti lastauslaiturilta lastaajan avustuksella. Asiakaskohteissa työ on usein omatoimisempaa – renkaita puretaan pumppukärryn avulla, ja noudettavat renkaat voivat sijaita esimerkiksi piha-alueilla, halleissa tai varastoissa. Renkaat painavat noin 50 kg kappaleelta, joten työ edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja reipasta työotetta.

Työ sisältää reissutyötä noin 2–3 päivänä viikossa. Yöpymisiä tulee säännöllisesti arkipäivinä, mutta viikonlopputyötä tehdään vain poikkeustapauksissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- CE-ajokorttia ja voimassa olevaa ammattipätevyyttä.

- Kokemusta yhdistelmäajoneuvon kuljettamisesta.

- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta osallistua myös kuormien käsittelyyn.

- Itsenäistä työotetta, vastuullisuutta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä.

- Tarjoamme sinulle

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn (40 h/viikko).


TES mukaisen palkan.

Varmat tunnit myös hiljaisempina jaksoina. Mikäli ajoa on tilapäisesti vähemmän, työaikaa täydennetään esimerkiksi varastotehtävillä – työtunnit eivät vähene.

Monipuolisen työn, jossa yhdistyvät ajaminen, asiakaskohtaamiset ja käytännön tekeminen.

Perehdytyksen sekä mukavan työyhteisön.

Jos viihdyt ratin takana, et kaihda fyysistä työtä ja arvostat vakituista työpaikkaa luotettavan työnantajan palveluksessa, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Sähköpostimme ovat muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi. title: HCC Architect (IT), Tampere
description:
About the role

As an Hybrid Cloud Computing Architect specializing in cloud and database technologies, you will play a key role in transforming on-premises databases towards public cloud and autonomous database services, designing scalable, secure, and cost-conscious solutions.

You are offered
A permanent, full-time position within a forward-thinking global IT organization, offering hybrid remote work options, professional growth in cutting-edge cloud technologies, and a collaborative team environment.

Work tasks

In this role, you will lead the database modernization journey, collaborating with global teams and suppliers to architect secure, scalable cloud-native database solutions.
- Take architectural responsibility for cloud and database solutions, including security, performance, and integrations
- Support the transformation of on-premises database environments towards public cloud and autonomous database services
- Develop and design new database and cloud-based data platform services, improving usability and maintainability
- Contribute to cloud migration planning, database modernization, and architecture reviews with application teams
- Collaborate with the Chief Architect to support roadmap development and long-term technology direction
- Align business roadmaps with database and cloud technology roadmaps, considering capacity, security, and cost
- Support external BUILD development and ensure smooth, well-documented handovers to RUN operations

We are looking for

- Strong understanding of database technologies, such as Oracle and SQL Server
- Good knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, public cloud services, and migration approaches
- Experience or strong interest in autonomous database services and managed database platforms
- Basic knowledge of project management and agile methodologies
- Experience in supplier management and collaborating with technology vendors and application teams

It is meritorious if you have
- Understanding of performance optimization, security compliance, and lifecycle management
- Ability to translate business requirements into practical architectural roadmaps
- Excellent communication and coordination skills in a global environment

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work. We will tell more about our client company in the interview stages.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri, Vantaan Energia
description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaan Energialle kahta kunnossapitoinsinööriä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Olemme yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kaupunkienergiayhtiöistä ja Suomen suurin jätteen energiahyödyntäjä. Tuotamme ja toimitamme lämpöä ja sähköä sekä tarjoamme näihin liittyviä palveluita. Ratkaisemme asiakkaidemme haasteita varmistamalla, että energia kiertää mahdollisimman tehokkaasti. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta, jotta vantaalaisilla olisi tarjolla edullista, toimitusvarmaa ja yhä vähäpäästöisempää energiaa sekä siihen liittyviä palveluita nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Kunnianhimoisten suunnitelmiemme ydin on osaava, motivoitunutja hyvinvoiva henkilöstömme, josta huolehtiminen on meille ykkösasia. www.vantaanenergia.fi

Tehtävä

Tehtävät sijoittuvat korkealämpötilalaitokselle (HWP) ja jätevoimala 2-laitokselle. Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä vastaat oman laitoksesi kunnossapitotoiminnan johtamisesta, kehittämisestä ja toimintavarmuudesta. Kyseessä on vastuullinen ja monipuolinen asiantuntija-sekä esihenkilörooli, jossa toimit oman laitoksen kunnossapidon vetäjänä. Tavoitteenasi on varmistaa laitoksen turvallinen, tehokas ja häiriötön toiminta sekä tuotanto-omaisuuden pitkäjänteinen kehittäminen.

Tehtävässä toimit kunnossapidon tiimin esihenkilönä sekä vastaat ulkoistenpalveluntarjoajien ja alihankkijoiden ohjauksesta. Osallistut myös kunnossapidon budjetointiin, investointien suunnitteluun sekä kehityshankkeisiin yhteistyössä tuotannon, käytön ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- oman laitoksen kunnossapitotoiminnan sekä tiimin johtaminen ja kehittäminen
- tuotantolaitoksen käytettävyyden, turvallisuuden ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen
- kunnossapidon pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelu ja kehitystyö
- kunnossapidon budjetointiin osallistuminen sekä kustannusten seuranta
- hankintojen, kilpailutusten ja ulkoisten palveluiden koordinointi
- kunnossapidon KPI-mittareiden ja tunnuslukujen seuranta sekä kehittäminen
- alihankkijoiden työn ohjaus ja valvonta
- yhteistyö tuotannon, käytön, omaisuudenhallinnan sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
- lakisääteisten velvollisuuksien ja turvallisuusvaatimusten noudattamisen varmistaminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa kokonaisvastuun oman energiantuotantolaitoksen kunnossapidosta osana vakavaraista ja tulevaisuuteen katsovaa energia-alan yritystä. Pääset työskentelemään keskeisessä roolissa, jossa vaikutat suoraan laitoksen suorituskykyyn, turvallisuuteen ja kehitykseen.

Saat tueksesi kokeneen organisaation, osaavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa asiantuntijuuttasi ja johtamisosaamistasi energia-alan mielenkiintoisimpien tehtävien parissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa esim. kone- tai energiatekniikka (insinööri tai DI)
- usean vuoden kokemusta kunnossapitotehtävistä prosessiteollisuudessa
- voimalaitos-, energia- tai kaukolämpötekniikan tuntemusta
- ymmärrystä kunnossapidon menetelmistä ja kehittämisestä
- hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaitoja ja valmiuksia toimia esihenkilötehtävistä
- kehitysmyönteistä, suunnitelmallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa
- hankinta- ja kilpailutusosaaminen katsotaan eduksi
- kiinteiden polttoaineiden tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja solmitaan suoraan Vantaan Energia Oy:n kanssa.Barona toimii rekrytointikumppanina.

Oletko sinä uusi energia-alan huipputekijä?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävät täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Tietosuojasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tai WhatsAppin kautta.

Tehtävässä työskentely edellyttää hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä, työhöntulotarkastusta sekä huumausainetestausta. Nämä toteutetaan valituille henkilöille ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Katri Hyppänen, Seniorikonsultti, Barona Teknisetasiantuntijat p. 050 439 9785 ma-to klo 10-14.

title: Engineer, Mechanics
description:
Join us, become part of our **#Fastemsians** work community and grow to be a future professional. Read more and come catch your dream job!

We are looking for an **Engineer, Mechanics** to join our Service Products Delivery team in Tampere. As an Engineer, Mechanics you will contribute to our Service Products deliveries and design according to our customers needs and Fastems long-term experience. This position will allow you to participate in a wide range of different Service deliveries to keep our installed base functioning.

As part of the Service Products Delivery team, you will work collaborating on diverse Service Product deliveries and supporting our local Service organizations and customers all around the world. Service Products are critical end-of-life components that will be upgraded to the latest technology, and the risk of an unexpected breakdown will be minimized. Service Products delivery team is also responsible for delivering different kinds of smaller system modifications and – changes.

The team consists of approx. 14 skilled professionals: delivery managers, electrical engineers and software developers, and together, as a team, we make sure that our customers worldwide are fully supported. We are working tightly as a team and help and support for the mechanical engineer is also available within our company from highly skilled colleagues from different teams.

As an expert in your field, your work contains designing Fastems products and systems modifications in customer deliveries so that the results of the deliveries meet the specifications, standards of quality, budget, and schedule. This includes thinking of possible new design solutions, creating models, manufacturing drawings, and schematics.A large part of the work contains supporting global Service functions relating to mechanical solutions and designs and participating in the Service Product development. Fastems value a unique culture where innovation and enabling development are important and supported in eachrole. We guarantee a flexible and relaxed atmosphere and work environment, where it is possible to develop ones skills and passion in agile ways.

**We expect you to have:**

- MSc or BSc in mechanical engineering

- A few years of experience in design work

- Up to date knowledge of manufacturing technologies

- Good communication and teamwork skills


- Experience of mechanical engineering tools (SolidWorks)

- Basics of strength calculations (with e.g. SolidWorks Simulation)

- Fluent skills in English and Finnish, both written and oral


**As a benefit for the applicant we consider:**

- Experience of industrial robotics and automation systems

- Experience of hydraulic and pneumatic systems and components

- Experience from other engineering softwares (Visual Components, Aton)


- Experience of other technical calculations


As a person you are self-driven, systematic and genuinely interested in technology. You want to keep quality as a priority in your daily work. You naturally maintain an open and positive atmosphere in a team.

**We can offer you:**

- A chance to work in the heart of development and robotics to shape the future of manufacturing industry

- Fastems strong company culture expressed through our **values**

- Career and development opportunities

- International work atmosphere and global activities

- Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely

- Good employment benefits, such as culture benefit and lunch benefit at the office

description:

Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!

Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!



Tehtävänkuvaus

Haemme asiakkaallemme Raumalle mekaanista asentajaa pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Työtehtävääsi kuuluu koneiden kokoonpano ja laitteiden asennustehtävät. Työt alkavat 6 kuukauden määräaikaisuudella, jonka jälkeen sopivalle työntekijälle tarjotaan vakituista paikkaa. Töitä tehdään arkipäivisin päivävuorossa klo 8-16. Työtä tehdään 37,5h/vk. Jos haluat päästä työskentelemään osana ammattimaista työporukkaa, niin hae mukaan!

Toivomme sinulta

Sinulla on työhön soveltuva koulutus (esim. raskaan kaluston, autonasentajan tai metallialan), teknisten piirusten lukutaitoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta muutaman vuoden ajalta. Pärjäät työssäsi itsenäisesti ja työnjälkesi on laadukasta. Olet innokas ja sinulta löytyy motivaatiota. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat kantaa vastuuta. Monipuolinen alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi sekä kaikenlainen koneasennuksen ja hydrauliikan tuntemus sekä autopuolen harrastuneisuus. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Hae heti klikkaamalla painiketta "Hae työpaikkaa". Muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi). Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.

Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!


Contio Henkilöstöpalvelut

title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja, Turku
description:
_Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Tavallisten kunnossapitopalveluiden lisäksi he tarjoavat kokonaisvaltaisia kunnossapidon palvelusopimuksia ja kiinteähintaisia tuotteistettuja palveluita. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._

Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Tämän lisäksi automaatioasentaja vastaa järjestelmien tarkastuksista ja niiden toimivuuden testauksesta. Työ on osaltaan liikkuvaa, joten valittavan henkilön tulee olla valmis liikkumaan myös eri asiakkaiden toimipisteisiin. Tämän vuoksi vaadimme hakijalta B-ajokorttia.

Hakijalta odotamme aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähkö- tai automaatioalan koulutusta sekä kokemusta sähkö- ja automaatioalan asennuksista. Tulevan sähköautomaatioasentajan tulee olla oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva sekä motivoitunut ja aidosti kiinnostunut alasta. Työntekijältä vaaditaan voimassa olevia tulityö-, työturvallisuus- ja EA-kortteja.

Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa, työaikojen kuitenkin ollessa työskentelykohteista riippuen joustavia. Työkielenä käytetään suomea, joten suomen kielen taito on ehdoton.

TYÖKUUTIO!

Olemme asiakkaidemme taustavoima rekrytoinneissa sekä olemme työntekijöidemme tukena koko työsuhteen ajan. Tavoitteenamme on yhdistää työntekijät uusiin työpaikkoihin. Meillä on työmahdollisuuksia opiskelijoille, alan vaihtajille, kesätyöntekijöille sekä jo kokeneille osaajille! Voit lukea meistä sekä kauttamme tarjottavista työntekijöiden eduista lisää www.tyokuutio.fi.

title: Huoltomekaanikko, Espoo
description:
**Etsimme asiakkaallemme huoltomekaanikkoa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen.**

Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisten huolto- ja asennustehtävien parissa toistaiseksi voimassa olevassa työsuhteessa? Etsimme asiakkaallemme osaavia ja motivoituneita ammattilaisia vahvistamaan huoltotiimiä Turkuun.

Tehtävänkuva

Työssä vastaat erilaisten trukkien, henkilöstönostimien ja maansiirtokoneiden huolto-, korjaus- ja asennustehtävistä. Työ sisältää sekä korjaamo- että kenttätyöskentelyä, joten valmius liikkua asiakaskohteissa on tärkeää.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu

- Mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt

- Vikadiagnostiikka ja korjaustoimenpiteet

- Sähköisten komponenttien ja järjestelmien asennukset

- Hydrauliikkajärjestelmien huolto ja vianetsintä

- Määräaikaishuollot ja kunnossapitotehtävät

- Asiakaskohteissa tapahtuvat huolto- ja asennustyöt


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Kokemusta raskaan kaluston tai työkoneiden huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- Hydrauliikan, mekaniikan ja sähköjärjestelmien tuntemusta

- Valmius liikkua asiakaskohteissa

- Suomen kielen taito


Lisäksi arvostamme

- Ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja oma-aloitteisuutta

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana tiimiä

- Hyvää palveluasennetta


Tarjoamme

- Vakituisen työsuhteen kasvavassa toimintaympäristössä

- Monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi

- Ammattitaitoisen ja tukevan työyhteisön


Lähetä hakemuksesi sähköpostilla osoitteeseen toimisto@tyokuutio.fi tai täytä valmis hakemuspohja osoitteessa www.tyokuutio.fi

- Maintaining and enhancing existing SAS solutions

- Providing documentation and technical support as needed

- Solid experience with Base SAS

Preferred background:

title: Automation Service Engineer
description:
For our client were looking for an experienced Automation Service Engineer.

You will support customers under service agreements in sectors such as life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, power and heat generation, and energy management. Your work covers engineering and commissioning, both in ongoing service and in projects. Most assignments are in Finland, with the occasional trip abroad. Expect roughly 30-150 travel days a year, depending on how you split your time between remote work and customer sites.

What you will do:
 Handle service requests and help customers solve urgent issues
 Plan and carry out control system hardware and software work, and commission systems on site or remotely
 Maintain the quality of installed base records
 Work closely with service coordinators, project managers, lead engineers, teammates and customer contacts
 Join upgrade and modernization projects from time to time
 Deliver service work efficiently and to a high standard, within contract terms, budget, quality and safety rules

What you bring:
 Degree in automation engineering, or comparable hands-on experience
 Understanding of power plant automation and electrical systems, including PLC design
 Background in engineering work in life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, or power generation
 Good command of Finnish and English, spoken and written. Swedish is a plus.
 A customer-minded, collaborative way of working, with drive to deliver and keep learning

Are you ready to take the lead on strategic transactions in a multinational and multifaceted business environment? Do you find meaning in using your skills to promote sustainable and innovation-driven future in a global material solutions company?

If these sound like your career goals, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **UPM** as a **Director, M&A Legal** in a newly established role.

_UPM is entering an exciting phase where strategic transactions continue to play an important role in shaping our future. We are building a dedicated M&A Legal capability to support that journey, and we are looking for a business-minded lawyer who enjoys collaboration, takes ownership and thrives in helping organizations navigate complex opportunities and change._

**\-Markus Skrabb, VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal**

**As a Director, M&A Legal**, you will join UPM's Legal and Compliance function. The role is preferably based in Helsinki, Finland (or other UPM location), and you will report to VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal.

**In this role,** you will take a leading, hands-on role in mergers, acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic transactions. You will operate across UPM's business areas and geographical footprint, and work with business area leaders, senior management, Legal and Compliance colleagues, other corporate functions and external advisers. In addition to legal support in transactions, you will contribute to developing consistent, efficient and practical M&A legal ways of working across UPM.

**Your key responsibilities will include**:

- leading and coordinating legal workstreams in acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, reorganizations and other strategic transactions;

- providing pragmatic, commercially focused advice to transaction teams, business leadership and senior management;

- coordinating legal due diligence and translating material findings into contractual protections, risk-mitigation actions and clear decision-making materials;

- drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share and asset purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements and ancillary documents;

- planning and coordinating signing, closing and transaction implementation activities;

- working with legal specialists and other functions on merger control, compliance, finance, tax, sustainability, employment, intellectual property, data protection and other relevant matters;

- managing external legal advisers, including scope, resourcing, quality and cost; and

- developing UPM's M&A legal governance, templates, playbooks and transaction tools (including legal tech & AI solutions), and promoting lessons learned and knowledge sharing.


The role involves travel according to transaction activity. UPM's team members currently work based on a hybrid work policy, but due to the collaborative and fast-paced nature of this role, frequent office presence is preferred.

**You could be an ideal candidate if you:**

- are an experienced M&A lawyer with a masters degree in law (or an equivalent legal qualification), who combines strong transaction expertise with sound business judgement and a practical, solution-oriented approach;

- have substantial M&A experience from a reputable law firm, an international company or a combination of both, in which context you have led complex domestic and cross-border transactions and have strong experience in legal due diligence as well as assessing, drafting and negotiating transaction documentation;

- take ownership, communicate clearly and move complex matters forward in demanding and time-sensitive situations;

- are a credible leader and influencer who can build trust across the organization, aligning stakeholders with different perspectives, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority;

- understand transaction structures and the interaction between legal, commercial, financial, tax, regulatory and operational considerations;

- can translate legal risks into clear, proportionate and actionable advice and have strong leadership, influencing, project-management, stakeholder-management and negotiation skills;

- work effectively with business leaders, internal specialists, external counsel and counterparties;

- are proactive, structured and comfortable managing several workstreams under pressure; and

- have excellent written and spoken English (Finnish or other relevant language skills are an advantage). Experience in listed-company transactions, carve-outs, joint ventures, merger control, foreign investment screening or post-merger integration is an advantage.


**UPM offers you:**

- **A meaningful role**: You will contribute directly to UPM's strategic development by supporting in transactions of significant importance to the company.

- **A key role with broad exposure**: You will work across UPM's businesses, functions, countries and organizational boundaries, including with senior management.

- **An opportunity to build**: As the first dedicated M&A Legal resource, you will help shape UPM's shared M&A legal practices, governance, tools and institutional knowledge.

- **Inspired and motivated colleagues**: You will join an experienced, collaborative and international Legal and Compliance community.

- **Development opportunities**: The role offers varied and demanding transaction work and broad exposure to UPM's businesses, strategy and operating environment.

- **Responsibility for people and the environment**: UPM's ethical principles embrace people and the environment, and the company continuously works to build a more sustainable future.


**_UPM_** _is a material solutions company, renewing products and entire value chains with an extensive portfolio of renewable fibers, advanced materials, decarbonization solutions, and communication papers. UPM's performance in sustainability has been recognized by third parties, including EcoVadis and the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices. UPM operates globally and employs approximately 15,100 people worldwide, with annual sales of approximately €9.7 billion. UPM's shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd._
