title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

title: Purchasing Specialist
description:
**About Sine Engineering**

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, including communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technology, and our solutions power many of today's active interceptor operations.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

**Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere.**

We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive **Purchasing Specialist** to develop and manage our Finland offices end-to-end procurement activities from creating purchase orders and validating supplier confirmations to ensuring timely deliveries and resolving shortages. You will maintain daily communication with suppliers, support onboarding and RFQ processes.

What we need is a strong procurement professional who will thrive in a global role with a lot of independence and responsibility, with the potential to grow into team leadership.

In this position you will be building the procurement process in Finland together with your international colleagues and manager. Your colleagues and stakeholders are spread across several countries, so you'll work in an international collaboration setup, but you will as well work closely with our Engineering and Finance teams, so you should have a good understanding of the Finnish procurement field.

With us you'll learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company. Because this is a key role in Finland, it is also an opportunity to develop something new, and a possibility grow into a leadership position.

**Location:** Tampere, on-site, fulltime, permanent position

**Key responsibilities**

- Create and manage purchase orders (POs) based on MRP, requisitions, or project needs


- Validate order confirmations: prices, delivery dates, quantities


- Follow up with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery


- Resolve delivery delays, shortages, and discrepancies.


- Follow up with warehouse team to have proper receiving within WH


- Maintain day-to-day communication with suppliers


- Support onboarding new suppliers by collecting documents and coordinating approval flows


- Request quotes (RFQs) and compare proposal


- Provide purchasing support during new product development (NPI)


- Support engineering changes (ECR/ECO) by updating suppliers and adjusting POs


**What we require**

To succeed in this role, you should have:

- Good knowledge of Finnish procurement process, limitations and constraints

- Good understanding of purchasing processes (RFQ, RFI, POs, contracts, and incoterms)

- Supplier management skills (evaluation, onboarding, performance tracking)


- Cost analysis skills like ability to compare quotes, calculate landed cost, evaluate TCO


- Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)


- Basic contract understanding like payment terms, delivery terms, warranty clauses etc.


- Strong ability to analyze prices, trends, and delivery performance


- Proficiency with Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation)


- Understanding demand planning and how it impacts purchasing


- English: B2 or higher


**What we see as a plus**

- Experience working at EMS factories

- Highly adaptable mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and solve problems beyond previous experience


**What We Offer**

**Paid Time Off**

The Employee is entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**

- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the taxfree limit as a fringe benefit.


- Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies.


- Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support.


- Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care.


- Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time.


- Business Travel Insurance: coverage for workrelated travel.


- Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks.


**Work Model**

- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00.


- NoCrunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed.


- MeetingLight Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings.


**Growth & Innovation**

- HighEnd Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals.


- Lab & Gadget Budget: annual budget for hardware, tools, books, and learning materials.


- Hackathons & Offsites: regular internal events focused on innovation and technology.


**Travel & Mobility**

- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation.


- Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum taxfree Vero rates.


**Impact & Culture**

- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement.


**Culture Statement**

Dont meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesnt perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.

Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.

**Privacy Notice**

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

Your data will be handled in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. We will retain your application data for up to 2 years, unless you consent to a longer retention period.

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting: privacy@sineeng.com

title: MORS Software : Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Type**: Full-time and permanent

**Location**: Helsinki, Aleksanterinkatu 48

**Application deadline**: 20.10.2026

**Looking for a role where you can take real ownership and help shape the next generation of business-critical fintech software?**

MORS Software develops Treasury Management and Asset & Liability Management software for banks. The product is evolving from a primarily desktop architecture toward a browser-based experience, a durable application/API layer and governed AI/agentic capabilities through MORSia.

Now, MORS is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to join its growing engineering team.

**What will you be doing?**

As a Senior Software Engineer at MORS, you will take end-to-end ownership of key areas of its treasury and banking software. Your work will be backend-focused, with C#/.NET at the core, and will combine work on established production systems with building new solutions. Roughly 60% of the work focuses on the existing product and architecture and 40% on new development.

Your initial focus will be on Financial Planning and Payments, where you will take ownership of existing functionality while contributing to their continued development. Over time, your scope may expand into other areas of MORSs banking software.

Ownership here means more than implementing predefined tickets. You will work with Product and domain specialists to understand the underlying business problem, design the solution, implement and test it, take it to production, investigate issues, and improve it further. You will also have room to challenge existing approaches and influence technical and architectural decisions together with MORS's CTO and engineering team. **What makes you a great fit?**

You are an experienced backend engineer who enjoys taking responsibility for complex software rather than focusing only on an isolated part of the development cycle. You can navigate an established codebase, make pragmatic technical decisions, and move work forward independently even when every requirement has not been defined upfront.

You do not need previous banking experience, but you should be interested in understanding why the software exists and what it enables for customers. MORS values engineers who communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and remain curious as development practices and technologies evolve.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 5 years of professional experience with C#/.NET and strong backend development skills

- Experience owning, debugging, and developing established production software and business-critical functionality

- Strong SQL Server and data access skills, combined with a good understanding of REST APIs and systems integration

- Experience with automated testing, source control, and CI/CD as part of professional software development

- Good English skills and the ability to plan work independently, identify dependencies, and communicate technical risks clearly


**Additional skills we value:**

- Experience with banking, payments, treasury, ALM, or another regulated or business-critical software environment

- Familiarity with Azure and modern ASP.NET Core

- Hands-on knowledge of modernizing legacy .NET applications, including WPF-based systems

- Understanding of batch processing, long-running jobs, workflows, or audit-sensitive systems


**What MORS offers you:**

- Take real ownership of business-critical software, with the autonomy to influence technical decisions and how your areas evolve

- Play a key role in MORSs technical modernization, working with both established systems and new architecture

- Develop deep expertise in banking technology by solving complex problems across Financial Planning, Payments, treasury, and risk management

- Grow your scope as the engineering team expands, with room to take on broader responsibilities and influence technical decisions

- Explore new ways of building software, including AI-assisted development, while having a say in how these tools are adopted


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by MORS Software. The position is based in Helsinki, with the current hybrid model typically involving around two-three days per week at MORS's office at Aleksanterinkatu 48. At the beginning of the employment we hope you will primarily work at the office. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible, taking the selected candidate's notice period into account. Salary in this position is 5500-7500 €/month depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Recruitment process timeline:**

- _Initial video interviews with aTalent: week 43_

- _We will notify all candidates about the next steps by week 44 at the latest_

- _Interview rounds with MORS: week 44 – week 45_


**Interested in taking ownership of what comes next at MORS?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 20th of October via our application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/387497/create/.

A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with MORS Software here: https://morssoftware.com/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (+358 44 783 5666, veera.kokko\[at\]atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Service Instructor
description:
**Come and join us as a Service Instructor in Cleaning Services for Commercial Cleaning in the Uusimaa region!**

Are you an experienced cleaning professional interested in a guiding role where you can support the daily operations of a team and help ensure high-quality service delivery? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

You will work under a supervisor as a Service Instructor and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating procedures. You will act as a key link between employees, management, and customers, supporting your supervisor in daily operations. However, the position does not include direct managerial responsibility.

Customer service is a central part of the role, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills. In this position, you will have a direct impact on customer experience and the smooth running of customer relationships. Therefore, active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-oriented approach are essential.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Ensuring the quality of daily cleaning operations and planning work allocation, as well as using resources cost-effectively

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement suggestions

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Customer collaboration

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- Experience in cleaning work and knowledge of commercial cleaning services

- The ability to guide and support a work community in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful working atmosphere, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and initiative

- A customer-focused approach and positive attitude

- The ability to work under pressure and solve problems

- The ability to communicate verbally and in writing in either Finnish or English. Language skills play an important role in this guidance-oriented position to ensure understanding of work instructions, safe working practices, and the management of employment-related matters. If one language is fluent, the other can be at a basic level. We value a diverse work community where different language and cultural backgrounds are considered a strength.

- A valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen

- A valid driver's license


**We offer you:**

- A permanent, full-time employment contract of 37.5 hours per week

- Work shifts on weekdays and weekends, starting from 6:00 a.m. We expect flexibility to work different shifts when needed.

- A start date agreed upon together

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment conditions, a safe working environment, and a strong commitment to employee well-being

- A competitive salary in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Property Service Employees, €2,235/month


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect and do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and healthy work community.

**Did you know?**

People enjoy working at N-Clean, and our employee eNPS score is an outstanding 55! This is reflected in our daily work through mutual respect and a genuine commitment to succeeding together.

N-Clean has succeeded in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-oriented and responsible working life. In 2024, we were chosen as the Most Human-Centric Workplace in Finland, and in 2025 we placed third in the competition and achieved 3rd place in the Finlands Most Human-Centric Working Life Act category. This recognition highlights our people-focused recruitment approach, where meaningful encounters, appreciation, and candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join our top team!**

**Submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 20 October 2026.**

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.

title: Director of Human Resources
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking an experienced, strategic and highly collaborative HR leader to join our School Leadership Team and lead the development of people strategy and HR practice across the school.

This senior leadership role requires excellent professional knowledge with sound judgement, courage, discretion and exceptional interpersonal skills. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating complexity, providing trusted advice and constructive challenge, resolving conflict and leading sensitive and difficult conversations with clarity, empathy and confidence.

The Director of Human Resources builds trust and alignment while maintaining the professional independence necessary to provide clear HR advice, uphold organisational expectations and address challenging issues directly and constructively.

A strong understanding of employment law, collective agreements and the Finnish employment environment is important, together with the ability to lead strategically within a diverse international community.

**Key Responsibilities Include:**

- Lead the development and implementation of the schools HR strategy, ensuring that people practices, systems and structures support ISHs strategic priorities and mission.

- Partner closely with the Head of School and School Leadership Team, providing trusted advice, professional expertise and constructive challenge on workforce planning, organisational development and complex personnel matters.

- Drive continuous improvement in HR systems, policies and practices, identifying opportunities to strengthen organisational effectiveness, employee experience and accountability.

- Lead and oversee full-cycle recruitment, selection, onboarding and offboarding, ensuring rigorous, equitable and efficient processes aligned with school policies, safeguarding expectations and DEIJ principles.

- Lead performance and employee relations processes, including professional growth, workplace conflict, performance improvement, and disciplinary matters with clarity, empathy, and discretion.

- Build and sustain a culture of exceptional collaboration, trust and shared accountability, working across teams and perspectives to build alignment and address differences constructively.

- Ensure HR practices and decisions comply with Finnish employment legislation, applicable collective agreements, school policies and relevant regulatory requirements.

- Collaborate with the Director of Business and Operations and Head of School on compensation, benefits, leave and other employment conditions.

- Strengthen staff engagement and wellbeing through purposeful feedback mechanisms, effective communication and appropriate collaboration with occupational health services.

- Oversee employment contracts, absence procedures, HR digital systems, international recruitment and relocation procedures, and other key personnel processes.

- Champion the schools safeguarding culture through rigorous safer recruitment and HR practices, ensuring that employee-related safeguarding concerns are recognised, reported and addressed promptly in accordance with school procedures.


- Contribute actively as a member of the School Leadership Team, taking collective responsibility for whole-school priorities and helping to shape a positive, inclusive and high-performing organisational culture.


**What We Offer**

This senior leadership role offers a significant opportunity to shape ISHs people strategy, influence organisational culture and drive meaningful organisational development within a vibrant international learning community.

ISH offers competitive compensation and benefits and an environment in which professional expertise, initiative and leadership are valued. The successful candidate will have meaningful scope to influence organisational practice while working within a highly collaborative leadership culture built on trust, accountability, inclusion and shared responsibility.

**Salary:**

The salary will be commensurate with qualifications and relevant experience, in accordance with the ISH pay structure and applicable collective agreements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- A university degree in Human Resources, employment law, business administration, organisational leadership or another relevant field.

- Significant professional experience within an established HR function, preferably including senior or leadership responsibility.

- Strong knowledge of employment law and working knowledge of collective agreements and the legal environment relevant to schools in Finland.

- Experience in international, multicultural and/or educational environments.

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters, including performance concerns, workplace conflict and disciplinary processes.

- Confidence and capability to conduct difficult, courageous conversations and provide direct, constructive feedback.

- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to build trust, influence effectively, and collaborate across diverse teams while maintaining independent professional judgement.

- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and manage organisational and employment-related risk.

- Adaptability, resilience and the capacity to prioritise effectively in a dynamic and complex environment.

- High levels of integrity, discretion and commitment to confidentiality.

- Excellent competence in HR technology and digital tools.


**Child Protection & Safeguarding** ISH is committed to the highest standards of safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. Successful candidates will be required to sign the schools Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct and successfully complete appropriate background checks, including police clearance and reference verification.

**Employment Start Date**

- As soon as possible, ideally December 2026 and no later than January 2027.

title: Welders Wanted in Kurikka
description:
Welders Wanted in Kurikka

We are looking for welders for permanent employment with our client company in Kurikka. The need is significant and urgent, and work will begin promptly as soon as suitable candidates are found. Recruitment is carried out in cooperation between our client company and Wulff Works. Wulff Works will handle applications and any inquiries to centralize the workload.

The selected candidates will primarily work with MAG welding. We are looking for professionals with previous experience in welding. Depending on the position, the work will be carried out in either one or two shifts.

We expect applicants to have:

 * previous experience in welding
 * MAG welding skills
 * the ability to read technical drawings
 * the ability to follow safety and work instructions
 * be at least 18 years old

We offer you:

 * permanent and full-time employment
 * varied welding tasks in an industrial production environment
 * the opportunity to work for our long-established and stable client company

Salary: Your salary will be at least €14.30/hour. The salary is based on job requirement group 6 or 7 under the collective agreement for the technology industry, plus a 6% individual pay component paid from the very beginning of employment.

In addition to the minimum salary, a production bonus system is in place. If you work in two shifts, you will also receive shift allowances in accordance with the collective agreement for the technology industry. The evening shift allowance is €1.35/hour. The estimated total average hourly earnings at the beginning of employment are approximately €15.00–€17.00/hour.

How to Apply

title: Housekeepers- Hanko
description:
**Do you want to do work that matters? Are you customer service oriented and like to see the results of your work immediately?** At Siskon Siivous, our cleaners are cleanliness professionals - they make sure our customers' premises are clean and safe.

**We are now looking for housekeepers for a hotel in Hanko**

**What does your working day look like?**

As a housekeeper, you will be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and safety of the client's premises. You will follow detailed instructions and checklists to ensure all areas, including guest rooms, restrooms, hallways, and common spaces, meet the required hygiene standards. Attention to detail and accuracy will be essential in your role. Don't worry – we will provide thorough training and an induction to ensure you are well-prepared to succeed.

**You will succeed in your job if you have:**

- Experience in the cleaning industry

- Good organizational and interpersonal skills

- A positive service attitude and a responsible approach to work

- Fluency in Finnish or English, other languages a plus


**Why us?**

We give you responsibility, but you won't be alone. Our work community is diverse and fair - we get things done right the first time. You'll get a comprehensive induction and the opportunity to learn more. You'll be supported by your supervisor and meet your colleagues regularly, for example in team meetings. We use high-quality cleaning equipment and environmentally friendly products.

**The job in a nutshell:**

- **Location:** Hanko -please check the map location

- **Hourly wage:** 12.59 € / h

- **Working hours per week:** 0–37.5 h/week, working on an as-needed basis. Please note that this is not a guaranteed full-time position; the number of working hours depends on available shifts and operational needs

- **Working hours:** from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:00

- **Fair employer** – we comply with collective agreement for workers in the property services sector


**Interested?**

If you recognise yourself from the description, don't hesitate - submit your application and join us to do work that really matters. With us, you'll be part of a professional team where cleanliness isn't just about cleaning - it's about safety, well-being and a smooth everyday life. Siskon Siivous Oy is a company founded in 1994, which takes good care of its employees and offers reliable and high-quality cleaning services to its customers.

title: AI Lead, Marine
description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows
- Strong project ownership, collaboration, and communication skills
- A curious, pragmatic, and business-oriented mindset

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a team that supports each other. Modern tools. Hybrid working flexibility to balance work and free time. Training and mentoring to help you grow, and our warm EloWe culture built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by October 11th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, because different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us on Fridays between 8-11

title: Seasonal hotel cleaners / Hotellisiivoojia talvisesonkiin, Kemi
description:

SERVICE PROVIDERS TO HOTEL CLEANING FOR WINTER SEASON 2026-2027 IN KEMI

You will work in a multicultural environment, and communication within the work community is mainly in English. The work is physical and requires good tolerance for pressure.

What we expect from you?

- Flexibility with varying working hours.

- Motivation and willingness to commit to quality work.

- Good interaction skills, as you will communicate with both the work community and customers.

Earlier experience from cleaning and / or degree is considered a plus but not necessary.

Non-EU/EEA applicants must already hold a valid residence/work permit that allows employment in Finland.

What we offer you:

- Comprehensive orientation and training.

- Support from a tight-knit work community.

- SOL Life program to support well-being and occupational safety.

Salary, working hours, and employment relationship

- Employment is temporary and part-time seasonal work. The contract starts on November 23, 2026, and ends on April 4, 2027. The possibility for continuation can be assessed in the spring.

- Working hours vary according to occupancy rate approximately 20–30 hours per week. Shifts are scheduled between Monday and Sunday, between 8 AM and 4 PM (08–16).

title: Trädgårdsunderhåll Trädgårdmästare Trädgårdsarbetare
description:
Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Ni kan läsa mer om företaget och hur vi jobbar på vår hemsida www.jardinriviera.com

Vi behöver en morgonpigg, positiv och glad person som gillar att ta del av teamets kunskaper och vår service.

Du är proaktiv, ansvarstagande, har god lyssningsförmåga, visar nyfikenhet och är bra på att interagera och planera ditt arbete.

Vi letar efter dig som sätter ett värde i att utföra arbetet på bästa möjliga vis och som inte är rädd för att hugga i när och där det behövs.

För att lyckas och trivas i tjänsten behöver du vara serviceinriktad och ta ansvar för att hålla hög kvalitet i det arbete du utför.

Vi tror också att du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och att du har lätt för att samarbeta.

För oss är det viktigt att ha ett trevligt och glatt bemötande, både mot varandra såväl som kunderna samt att ha ett intresse för trädgårdar.

B-körkort är ett måste då vi använder bilar för att ta oss till våra kunder.

Du ska förutom svenska även kunna prata engelska då nästan all kommunikation sker på engelska, franska är självklart en bra merit.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Om detta kan vara av intresse, lägg en mail till oss på info@jardinriviera.com där du berättar om dig själv samt erfarenhet osv.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! ☀️🌴

Jardin Riviera

description:

The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. ? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). title: Manager Commerce Poissonnerie F/H
description:
Nous sommes.
Auchan Retail France, une entreprise de distribution de plus de collaborateurs au service de millions de clients chaque année.
Ce que nous voulons, c'est aider nos clients à bien manger et vivre mieux, tout en préservant la planète.
Que l'on soit en entrepôt, en magasin ou sur des fonctions support, notre point commun à tous, c'est de faire en sorte que nos clients aient plaisir à faire leurs courses chez nous.
Parce que nos collaborateurs sont aussi nos premiers clients, nous veillons chaque jour à leur bien-être et leur évolution professionnelle.
Vous avez envie de.

Manager une équipe passionnée et professionnelle, les aider à s'épanouir et à développer leurs compétences au travers d'une passion commune pour les produits de la mer.


Fidéliser vos clients, en garantissant leur satisfaction par votre étal, vos rayons et vos conseils (étiquetage, hygiène/propreté, traçabilité, théâtralisation...) au travers des produits de qualité supérieure et d'une large gamme de choix.


Dynamiser votre commerce, en mettant en place, avec vos équipes des partenariats (fournisseurs/éleveurs/producteurs locaux...) et des animations commerciales adaptées aux spécialités locales.


Garantir la performance de votre commerce, en analysant et pilotant les indicateurs commerciaux (CA, marges, démarques...) du compte d'exploitation. Activer les bons leviers (politique prix, budgets d'achats) et piloter vos stocks, approvisionnements et commandes.

Vous êtes.
Diplômé de niveau CAP/BEP/BP en Poissonnerie, vous avez une expérience de minimum 2 ans sur un poste similaire (Responsable rayon poissonnerie, Chef de rayon marée...). Passionné.e par les produits et la relation client, vous savez accompagner et gérer les chiffres d'un rayon.
Le poste de Manager Commerce Poissonnerie F/H (Niveau 7) est fait pour vous.
Rencontrons-nous !

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Spécialisés dans le concept de "Finest Lunch", nous proposons une cuisine fraîche, gourmande et variée (bowls, wraps, sandwichs, salades et livraison de kebabs).
Notre ambition est d'offrir une expérience de restauration rapide premium à notre clientèle, en alliant rapidité de service et excellence des produits.

VOTRE RÔLE ET VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT
Véritable pilier de l'établissement, vous prendrez la direction d'une équipe dynamique de 8 personnes.
Au quotidien, vous évoluerez dans un environnement exigeant où l'équipe s'attache à :
- Préparer les ingrédients et les plats selon nos recettes établies.
- Assurer la propreté et l'organisation constante de l'espace de travail.
- Respecter scrupuleusement les normes de sécurité alimentaire et d'hygiène.
- Collaborer étroitement pour garantir un service rapide et efficace.

VOS MISSIONS PRINCIPALES
En tant que Manager, votre rôle est de conjuguer excellence opérationnelle et leadership humain. Vos missions se déclinent en cinq axes majeurs :
- Management et Leadership : Coordonner l'équipe, assurer la cohésion et piloter la formation continue de vos collaborateurs.
- Supervision Opérationnelle : Veiller à la fluidité du service, gérer les périodes de forte activité ("coups de feu") et soutenir vos équipes sur le terrain.
- Contrôle Qualité : Garantir que chaque plat respecte scrupuleusement les fiches techniques et les standards de qualité élevés de l'enseigne.
- Gestion de l'Hygiène et de la Sécurité : Être le/la garant(e) de l'application stricte des normes HACCP au sein de la cuisine.
- Gestion des Stocks : Suivre les inventaires, piloter les commandes fournisseurs et mettre en œuvre des actions de lutte contre le gaspillage alimentaire.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ
- Vous possédez une expérience confirmée en management d'équipe de cuisine.
- Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les normes d'hygiène HACCP.
- Vous faites preuve d'un leadership naturel et d'une grande capacité de gestion du stress.
- Votre rigueur et votre sens de l'organisation vous permettent de garantir une qualité constante, fidèle à l'image de marque de notre enseigne.

Prêt(e) à faire saliver le monde de l'entreprise à Aix-en-Provence ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature dès maintenant !

title: Ingénieur Avant-Vente Défense et Sécurité F/H
description:

Notre équipe pluridisciplinaire, composée d'experts en avant-vente, vente, think/build/run et intégration de services digitaux, collabore étroitement avec les différentes filiales du groupe Orange pour offrir des solutions sur mesure et performantes?: connectivité fixe-mobile-satellite, hébergement de données/cloud, IA, développement applicatif, cybersécurité avec Orange Cyberdefense.

Vous disposez de connaissances techniques solides dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : réseaux WAN (SDWAN/DSN, WAN, etc.), réseaux LAN SD-LAN/LAN/WLAN, LAN Datacenter, LAN Optique, Interconnexion vers les Cloud Service Providers, Services par satellite (LEO, MEO, GEO), 4G/5G, Cybersécurité.
Vous êtes orienté client et voulez relever un challenge commercial
Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et aimez travailler avec une multitude d'interlocuteurs, internes ou externes.
Vous avez idéalement des expériences réussies dans la constitution et la validation technique d'offres

title: Responsable Approvisionnement Biomasse H/F
description:
MISSIONS :
- Rédige et tient à jour les procédures concernant la mobilisation sur chantier de défriche agricole, urbaine ou forestière, de récupération de connexes de scieries, de bois en fin de vie ou autre sourcing biomasse,
- Assure la prospection et la recherche de fournisseurs/ sous traitant de biomasse ou transporteur de biomasse,
- Pilote le choix, la négociation, et la contractualisation des achats de biomasse ou de gestion de chantiers de défriches ou forestiers en concertation avec sa direction,
- Soumet à sa direction les choix d'achats de biomasse,
- A un œil vigilant sur la conformité réglementaire de l'origine de la biomasse en lien avec sa direction,
- Planifie et organise les livraisons de biomasse (hebdomadaire, mensuel, annuel) pour assurer un approvisionnement permettant le fonctionnement de la ou des centrales en production,
- Planifie, contrôle et coordonne les activités d'exploitation forestières (abattage, débardage, broyage, transport, stockage) pour les chantiers de l'équipe de mobilisation,
- Organise les opérations de stockage/déstockage sur parc de rupture le cas échéant,
- Suit les contrats en communication permanente avec la responsable de parc à bois,
- Informe le Responsable de parc en cas de difficultés d'approvisionnement ou de changement de volume livré au jour le jour pour permettre la coordination appro/réception,
- Réalise les calculs de coût de biomasse réel/ chantier,
- Programme et organise les chantiers de défriche selon une stratégie définie et validé par la direction,
- Recherche des solutions à toutes situations problématiques rencontrées sur le terrain ou avec les parties prenantes en créant de nouvelle procédure au besoin.
- Fais de chaque expérience une analyse permettant d'améliorer les procédures dans l'ensemble.

PILOTAGE FINANCIER ET ADMINISTRATIF DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- S'assure du respect des objectifs budgétaires fixés par la direction Providex et des objectifs d'approvisionnement de biomasse, il engage et suit les commandes de biomasse auprès des fournisseurs en concertation avec la direction,
- Tient à jours les indicateurs de coûts sur la biomasse en concertation avec la responsable de parc à bois qui suit la réception de la biomasse,
- Analyse les indicateurs, pointe les écarts et dysfonctionnements, propose des solutions à la direction.

MANAGEMENT DES ÉQUIPES DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- Manage et anime l'équipe de mobilisation (mobilisateurs),
- S'assure de la continuité de service dans l'équipe mobilisateurs,
- Identifie, valorise et développe les compétences de ses collaborateurs en proposant des formations appropriées,
- Participe aux groupes de travail au sein de la centrale, destinés à améliorer l'appareil de production ou les conditions de travail,
- S'assure de la prévention des risques professionnels sur l'activité qu'il encadre en lien avec sa direction,
- Assure la mise en place de procédure adéquate avec le ou la SQE sur les chantiers de mobilisation.

SÉCURITÉ :
- Suit et veille à faire appliquer les recommandations du SQE  sur les chantiers,
- Informe la direction et QSEE de tout incident, accident ou situation à risque, et traite l'anomalie en conséquence,
- Veille à l'application de toutes les règles et procédures de sécurité établies.

ENVIRONNEMENT :
- Veille en permanence au respect absolu des normes environnementale sur chantier,
- Anticipe toutes anomalies à venir, agit et fait agir en conséquence.

QUALITÉ :
- Décline la politique qualité qui sera déployée,
- Applique et fait appliquer les procédures du SMI,
- Suit les non conformités, actions correctives et préventives,
- Renseigne et suit les indicateurs biomasse mis en place par la direction,
- Suit et applique les recommandations du QSEE,
- Informe le personnel de la politique et de l'application des dispositions Qualité qui seront mis en place.

title: Orthoptistes : un CDI à Sedan H/F Debutant ok !
description:
DN8 Solutions LTD recrute un orthoptiste (H/F) pour exercer au sein d'un cabinet ophtalmologique situé à Sedan. Ce poste en contrat à durée indéterminée constitue une opportunité d'intégrer une structure médicale à taille humaine, où vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prise en charge des patients aux côtés des médecins ophtalmologistes.
Vous assurez l'ensemble des actes orthoptiques dans le cadre de consultations organisées et encadrées.
Vos missions portent principalement sur le bilan visuel, le dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation, ainsi que sur la rééducation orthoptique des patients de tous âges.
Vous contribuez activement à la fluidité des consultations en réalisant les examens complémentaires nécessaires à l'établissement du diagnostic médical.
Le poste est ouvert aux candidats débutants. Vous bénéficiez d'un encadrement adapté à votre niveau d'expérience et d'une montée en compétences progressive dans un environnement clinique structuré. Cette configuration est particulièrement favorable pour les orthoptistes souhaitant consolider leur pratique clinique en sortie de formation.
Vous évoluez dans un cadre de travail stable, avec des horaires définis permettant un équilibre satisfaisant entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Les équipements techniques mis à disposition sont adaptés aux exigences de la pratique orthoptique contemporaine, incluant les outils de réfractométrie, de périmétrie et d'imagerie fonctionnelle.
Ce poste représente une opportunité concrète de développer votre expertise clinique au sein d'une équipe médicale investie dans la qualité des soins apportés à ses patients.
Profil recherché:
Titulaire du Certificat de Capacité d'Orthoptiste (CCO), vous êtes débutant(e) ou disposez d'une première expérience en cabinet ophtalmologique ou en structure de soins. Les candidatures en sortie de formation sont les bienvenues.
- Maîtrise des techniques de bilan visuel et de réfraction subjective et objective
- Connaissance des protocoles de dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation
- Capacité à réaliser des examens complémentaires ophtalmologiques : réfractométrie, périmétrie, et imagerie fonctionnelle
- Aptitude à conduire des séances de rééducation orthoptique auprès de patients de tous âges, de la pédiatrie à la gériatrie
- Connaissance des pathologies relevant du champ orthoptique : strabisme, amblyopie, troubles oculomoteurs, basse vision
- Capacité à travailler en coordination avec les médecins ophtalmologistes dans le cadre de consultations structurées
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de traçabilité et de suivi patient utilisés en cabinet médical
- Rigueur dans la réalisation des actes et sens des responsabilités vis-à-vis des patients
- Qualités relationnelles permettant d'instaurer un climat de confiance avec des patients d'horizons et d'âges variés
- Capacité d'adaptation et volonté de progresser dans un environnement clinique encadré
- Sens de l'organisation pour contribuer à la fluidité des consultations au sein du cabinet

title: OT-System Specialist (m/w/d)* (Netzwerkadministrator/in)

Als globaler Konzern für Materialtechnologie finden wir so neue Wege, eine bessere Zukunft zu gestalten - für unsere Partnerunternehmen, unsere KundInnen und unsere MitarbeiterInnen.

Sie möchten dort ansetzen, wo IT und Produktion zusammenkommen? Mit Ihrer Expertise in OT Security tragen Sie maßgeblich dazu bei, Standards, Normen und Richtlinien umzusetzen.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Konzeption, Standardisierung und Umsetzung von Netzwerk-Infrastrukturen für Produktionsbetriebe am Standort Mainz und beratend für andere Lokationen weltweit
- Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Netzwerk-Infrastruktur zur Steigerung von Sicherheit, Effizienz und Verfügbarkeit

- Evaluierung von IT-Technologien für den Einsatz im produktionsnahen Umfeld
- Inbetriebnahme und Montage von Servern, Netzwerkkomponenten und Edge Devices
- Analyse von Netzwerk- und IT-Security Risiken innerhalb der Infrastrukturen, Aufzeigen und Umsetzen von Lösungen zur Gefahrenabwehr in diesen Bereichen
- Planung und Durchführung von Wartungen, Migrationen sowie Retrofits
- Durchführung von Change- und Incidentmanagement gemäß ITIL-Prinzipien
- Mitwirken bei der Inbetriebnahme sowie der Pflege von Komponenten des OT-Assetmanagement

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium der Elektro- und Informationstechnik, Techniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im OT-Umfeld (z.B. Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik)
- Erste Berufserfahrung in dem Bereich IT/OT Infrastruktur und Security
- Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Routing, Switching sowie in OT spezifischen Kommunikationsprotokollen (Industrial Ethernet, ProfiNet, Modbus TCP, OPC UA)
- Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Konzeption und dem Betrieb von LAN-Infrastrukturen

title: Inside Sales Advisor / Kundenberater Inside Sales  (m/w/d) – Berlin (Verkaufsberater/in)
description:
Was Dich erwartet

In dieser Rolle als Inside Sales Advisor / Sales Operations Advisor / Sales Support Advisor betreust du Kunden und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Verkaufsprozess. Als erste Anlaufstelle in unseren digitalen Vertriebskanälen gewährleistest du ein erstklassiges Kundenerlebnis und teilst dein Fachwissen über Tesla-Produkte. Du begleitest virtuelle Testfahrten, organisierst die Fahrzeugflotte für Remote Test Drives und koordinierst die Übergabe an das Virtual Sales Team oder lokale Standorte. Zudem übernimmst du administrative Aufgaben rund um Fahrzeugbestellungen, einschließlich Stornierungen und Exporten. Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Team und unterstützt deutschlandweit bei Fahrzeuganfragen. Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamgeist sind entscheidend. Virtuelle Kommunikation per Telefon, Chat und E-Mail gehört zu deinem Alltag, während du gemeinsam mit dem Team individuelle und gemeinsame Vertriebsziele erreichst.

Wir bieten



- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvoltschulungen, Managementtrainings)
- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen
- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten
- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem Cash Award auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein 13. Monatsgehalt sowie die Option auf eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket umfasst  
- Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team, das sich durch eine tolle Stimmung und hervorragende Teamarbeit auszeichnet. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet

Was zu tun ist

- Kundenbetreuung und administrative Unterstützung: Die schnelle und konkrete Beantwortung aller eingehenden Kundenanfragen über alle virtuellen Kanäle (einschließlich Anrufe, E-Mails, SMS, Chat, andere virtuelle Beratungen usw.) und Deeskalation bei kritischen Anfragen ist dir ein wichtiges Anliegen. Du begleitest Kunden bei der Nutzung von Remote Test Drives und kümmerst dich um die gesamte Verwaltung der Flotte (z.B. Öffnungszeiten der Standorte, Anpassung der Flottenausfälle, Fahrzeugüberwachung bei Unfällen)
- Umsetzung von Fahrzeugbestellung-Stornierungen: Du überprüfst und setzt Stornierungen von Fahrzeugbestellungen für den deutschen Markt um. Dies beinhaltet auch die Einleitung von Erstattungen
- Unterstützung beim Export- und Mehrwertsteuerfreie Prozesse: Du überprüfst und unterstützt bei der Abwicklung von VAT-free Bestellungen und arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Kunden zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Fahrzeuge korrekt für den Export verkauft werden
- Request-Management: Du bearbeitest alle eingehenden Kundenanfragen über unsere Website (Probefahrten, Rückrufwünsche, Inzahlungnahmen) und unterstützt lokale Standorte bei Bedarf
- Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstansprache aller Web Sales Opportunities in Deutschland. Dabei übernimmst du den ersten Kontakt mit potenziellen Kund:innen, sicherst einen professionellen und überzeugenden ersten Eindruck und leitest die nächsten Schritte im Verkaufsprozess ein  
- Zudem unterstützt du die Stores beim Erstkontakt von Event Sales Opportunities. Hierbei sorgst du dafür, dass Interessent: innen schnell und kompetent betreut werden und trägst aktiv zum Erfolg von Events  
- Darüber hinaus nimmst du an zielgerichteten Call-Kampagnen teil, mit dem Fokus auf Leasings Verlängerungen. Dabei begleitest du Kundinnen im Entscheidungsprozess, stärkst die Kundenbindung und trägst zur langfristigen Kundenzufriedenheit bei

Was mitzubringen ist

- Berufserfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Inside Sales, Sales Support oder einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem digitalen Vertriebsumfeld mit und kennst die Herausforderung, in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu arbeiten
- Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist in der Lage, sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch sicher zu kommunizieren, um mit Kunden aus dem internationalen Bereich (z.B. beim VAT-free Processing) professionell umzugehen
- Organisationsgeschick: Deine strukturierten Arbeitsmethoden und deine Fähigkeit zur richtigen Prioritätensetzung machen dich zu einem echten Organisationstalent
- Proaktives Handeln: Du bist eigeninitiativ und zeigst eine hohe Problemlösungsfähigkeit und hohe Serviceorientierung. Bei Schwierigkeiten gehst du direkt auf die Lösung zu und bist stets bereit, dich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen
- Technische Kenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit modernen CRM-Tools und bist sicher im digitalen Arbeitsumfeld
- Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen. Du kannst im Schichtdienst arbeiten, um dein Team zu unterstützen. Dies können auch Wochenenden sowie Morgen- und Abendschichten umfassen (innerhalb: Montag bis Samstag, 8-19 Uhr)

Tesla ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit verwirklicht, und der sich der Diversität am Arbeitsplatz verpflichtet hat. To be effective in this role, the engineer will need to be intimately familiar with the detailed behavior of these electro-mechanical components and the tools and equipment used in their design and manufacture.  He/She will work with other Engineering teams to root cause and implement countermeasures of field issues to improve quality, reliability, durability of the products.  Tesla offers the opportunity to work on industry leading products and bleeding edge technology in a fast paced, dynamic, and high visibility role.

What You’ll Do

- Drive issue resolution from root cause analysis to countermeasure implementation on electromechanical components from Tesla’s Energy Products
- Investigate system assemblies, modules, components to identify root cause of failure in Tesla’s Energy products
- Design and conduct fault replication tests experiments on power converters and low voltage PCBA's including board rework and FW/HW testing
- Collaborate with appropriate engineers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to drive resolution to the identified failure causes
- Provide inputs to design and manufacturing teams to improve design and production yield. Can be achieved through lessons learnt, product teardowns etc. helping to identify risks
- Support design reviews and DFMEAs based on prior failure experience
- Candidate should be detail oriented, and excellent communication skills

What You’ll Bring

- BS/MS Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience
- Strong demonstrable experience in Power Electronics/power converter circuits for energy storage/automotive applications
- Electrical/Electronic design experience a strong plus
- Strong demonstrable hands-on experience with electrical test equipment: Power Supplies, Multimeter, Oscilloscopes, and other common equipment
- Strong & demonstratable focus on adhering to Lab safety practices
- Extremely proficient at reading schematics and troubleshooting analog and digital circuits
- Familiarity with or willingness to learn the different failure analysis techniques including 2D and 3D X-Ray, Cross Sectioning, FTIR, DSC, SEM, and FLIR Thermography
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills required
- Experience with hand tools, basic power tools, soldering, and instrumentation is desirable

title: Finance Transformation Manager (f/m/d) (Controller/in)

description:

Department: SE FIN TI BC

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis

Mode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day

For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.
At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.
A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Subject to the future setup and related decisions, the role may offer a path toward taking on team leadership responsibility for this unit.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Support the carve-out of Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness
* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs
* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences
* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards
* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey
* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership role

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field
* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment
* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team
* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation
* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

You define the operating model, the cost center and manpower steering logic, the reporting cadence and the standards that the functions will be steered by, and you build the team that runs them.
You are not starting from an empty page. A part of the team will transfer into the new unit, so you begin with experienced colleagues who know the business, the processes and you grow the team around them. Siemens Energy's corporate Function Controlling team supports you closely on top of that, so you can build on proven methods and standards rather than invent everything yourself.

A standalone company needs its own function cost transparency from day one — and few finance leaders get the chance to shape a controlling discipline that does not exist yet, with experienced colleagues behind them, for a company that is coming into existence around them.
Your second role is that of Finance Business Partner to the corporate functions — IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement and Finance among them. You are the financial counterpart their leaders turn to, and just as importantly you develop your own people into that role: a function controller who only reports numbers is not yet a business partner, and getting the team there is one of your central tasks.

Working closely with engineering, quality, and project teams, you will build resilient supplier partnerships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and ensure a secure, cost-effective supply chain that supports global business growth.
