* Lead supplier development programs to strengthen quality, capability, and supply chain resilience in technically complex and regulated environments
* Negotiate complex commercial contracts, including pricing, intellectual property, and long-term service agreements, to maximize value and minimize risk
* Proactively assess supply chain risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity across global procurement activities

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics or a comparable technical or business discipline
* Extensive experience in strategic procurement, sourcing, or category management with a strong focus on electronic equipment and technical commodities
* Proven expertise in managing complex supplier relationships, supplier development, and procurement projects within regulated or high-technology industries
* Strong commercial acumen with advanced contract negotiation, contract management, and risk mitigation capabilities
* Analytical and strategic mindset with excellent stakeholder management skills; knowledge of AI applications and procurement automation is a plus
* Business fluent in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

title: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/284669?source=BA

description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As a Senior Expert Corporate Production Management (m/f/d) at Exyte, you will play a key role in implementing and further developing our Lean philosophy across international projects.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Implementing Lean Design and Lean Construction methods across all project phases using PPM (Project Production Management), LPS (Last Planner System), and Exyte standard software.
- Training project team members and key users on Lean Construction methods, tools, and software.
- Continuously improving and optimizing standardized Lean tools and methods in close collaboration with stakeholders.

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to facilitate workshops and trainings.

- Readiness to undertake regular weekly travel to our project sites for up to five days per week to support and train teams in the implementation of Lean principles and production control.
- Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

title: Commercial Project Manager / Project Controller (f/m/d) for Germany (Vertriebscontroller/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities
* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams
* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI
* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS D

What You Bring

* Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.
* Fluent in English and German is an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

title: Oberärztin / Oberarzt (w/m/d) Allgemeine Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie (Oberarzt/-ärztin)
description:
Erleben Sie echte Unterstützung und Zusammenhalt im Job, in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld, geprägt von Wertschätzung und Vertrauen. Beim LWL PsychiatrieVerbund Westfalen arbeiten wir gemeinsam an einem wichtigen Ziel: die Versorgung unserer Patient:innen und Bewohner:innen so hochwertig wie möglich zu gestalten.

Die LWL-Klinik Paderborn ist ein Fachkrankenhaus für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie, Akademisches Lehrkrankenhaus der Universität Münster sowie Kooperationspartner der Fakultät für Gesundheitswissenschaften der Universität Bielefeld und versorgt gemeindenah mit 220 stationären Betten, 60 Tagesklinikplätzen und drei ausgebauten Institutsambulanzen etwa 14.000 Patientinnen und Patienten jährlich.

Die Abteilung Allgemeine Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie behandelt Menschen mit akuten und anhaltenden psychischen Störungen, insbesondere mit schizophrenen Psychosen, affektiven Störungen, Anpassungsstörungen, Angst- oder Zwangserkrankungen, somatoformen Störungen oder Persönlichkeitsstörungen.

So tun Sie bei uns Gutes:

- Die oberärztliche Leitung einer allgemeinpsychiatrischen Station mit  bis zu 25 Behandlungsplätzen im kollegialen Leitungsteam zusammen mit der Pflegerischen Leitung
- Die psychiatrisch/psychotherapeutische Anleitung der Assistenzärztinnen/-ärzte sowie der Therapeut:innen    
- Die Beteiligung an der strukturierten Weiterbildung der assistenzärztlichen und weiteren therapeutischen Kolleg:innen
- Die aktive Beteiligung an der strukturellen und inhaltlichen Entwicklung der Konzepte der Allgemeinpsychiatrie.

Das wünschen wir uns:

- Anerkennung als Fachärztin/-arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
- Bereitschaft zum ambulanten Arbeiten
- Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Leitungsfunktionen
- Engagement, Teamfähigkeit und ein hohes Maß an sozialer Kompetenz
- Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in abteilungsbezogenen settingübergreifenden Versorgungsformen
- Teilnahme am Hintergrunddienst

Darauf können Sie sich freuen:

- Faire Gehaltsstruktur: Leistungsorientierte Vergütung nach TV-Ärzte/VKA sowie Nebenverdienstmöglichkeiten
- Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell: unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, Voll- oder Teilzeit, Teilnahme an Bereitschaftsdiensten
- Work-Life-Balance: Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privat- bzw. Familienleben (Zertifizierung), exaktes Zeiterfassungssystem, Kooperation mit dem Fitnessstudio FitX
- Individuelle Entwicklung: Attraktive Fort- und Weiterbildungen (LWL-Führungskräftequalifikation), Zugang zur Fachliteratur, Regelmäßige interne und externe Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten mit Freistellung für 10 Tage
- Mobilität: Gute Verkehrsanbindung, Wir helfen Ihnen sowohl bei der Suche nach Wohnraum, als auch nach weiteren benötigten Unterstützungsangeboten
- Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiter:innen Rabattprogramm

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wir laden Sie gerne zu einer unverbindlichen Hospitation ein. Die Kosten für Anfahrt/Unterbringung übernimmt für Sie die Klinik.

Der LWL strebt eine diverse Personalaufstellung an. Bewerbungen von Frauen und geeigneten schwerbehinderten Menschen sind daher ausdrücklich erwünscht. Darüber hinaus begrüßen wir alle Bewerbungen von Menschen, unabhängig von ihrer kulturellen und sozialen Herkunft, ihrem Alter, ihrer Religion und Weltanschauung oder ihrer sexuellen Orientierung und geschlechtlichen Identität.

In Bereichen, in denen Frauen unterrepräsentiert sind, werden sie bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung entsprechend den Zielen des LGG NRW bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Bitte bewerben Sie sich online bis zum 31.10.2026.

title: Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, Power Electronics (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
description:
What to Expect

Please not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. Your work contributes directly to the world's transition to sustainable energy. At the lead level, you will also set technical direction and guide a small team of mechanical engineers.

What You’ll Do

- Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures
- Solve electronics packaging end-to-end: thermal management, high-voltage insulation (creepage/clearance), IP67+ sealing, EMI, shock/vibration, and long-term environmental reliability
- Lead track: Serve as technical owner of a product line, mentor 3–4+ engineers, lead and approve design reviews, and enforce technical rigor and schedule discipline
- Analyze before you cut metal: thermal / CFD, structural FEA, tolerance stacks, DFM / DFA / DFR, and DFMEA where it matters
- Design custom magnetics and power interfaces (inductors, transformers, chokes, terminals) as first-class mechanical products, not afterthoughts
- Partner with electrical, systems, reliability, manufacturing, supply chain, and compliance teams, and design against UL / IEC / GB standards through to certification
- Drive prototypes into reality: builds, test support, characterization, design verification, and root-cause analysis of failures
- Release for production in CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE: 3D models, 2D drawings with GD&T, PLM / ECOs / BOMs, and supplier collaboration for automated manufacturing at thousands of units per week

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master’s degree preferred for senior/ staff/ lead level
- Strong mechanical fundamentals and a physics-based, first-principles approach to structural and thermal problems
- Proven product design ownership from concept to scaled production (portfolio preferred)
- Lead track: 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including 2+ years of design leadership
- Fluency in CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for high-volume processes (molding, stamping, die casting, fastening, joining, dispensing)
- Ability to run, or critically review, thermal / CFD / structural analysis, plus working knowledge of power electronics components (PCBAs, MOSFETs, inductors, transformers)
- Detail-oriented, with clear written and verbal communication in English and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Highly valued:
- Direct experience in power electronics packaging: inverters, chargers, DC-DC, magnetics, busbars, or HV semiconductor modules
- Experience designing against certification standards (UL, IEC, GB) and obtaining certificates
- Multiphysics intuition: heat transfer, fluids, mechanics, and materials (magnetics a strong plus)
- MATLAB / Python for data reduction, scripting, or reduced-order thermal models
- PLM / change control / BOM discipline in a fast-moving product environment
- Hands-on lab instinct: you would rather instrument a prototype than argue from a slide

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

title: Recruiter - Engineering and Robotics (Recruiter/in)
description:
What to Expect

Tesla's EMEA Recruiting team is seeking an Engineering Recruiter to join us in Berlin. In this role, you'll drive hiring for diverse technical teams, across Engineering and Robotics, fuelling our most complex and high-impact Optimus projects, without being confined to a single job family or skillset. We're looking for a proven expert in technical recruiting who can source, engage, and evaluate EMEA's top engineering talent, while building and owning relationships with our senior leadership. Beyond hiring, you'll elevate the team by mentoring junior recruiters, modelling best practices, and leading initiatives to refine our processes and workflows. Ideal candidates are data-driven problem-solvers who thrive in ambiguity, apply strong project management skills, and innovate creative solutions to recruitment challenges. One hire at a time, you'll help assemble the talent revolutionizing energy and transportation, accelerating our path to a sustainable future and shaping the systems and products that power our employees' and customers' daily lives.

What You’ll Do

- Collaborate closely with hiring managers to evaluate talent needs, deliver expert guidance on hiring strategies, and own the end-to-end recruitment cycle for high-stakes technical roles.
- Establish and manage realistic recruiting timelines, proactively identifying risks and implementing solutions to keep processes on track and efficient.
- Leverage data analytics to evaluate candidate pipelines, measure recruitment performance, analyse talent market trends, and deliver insightful weekly reports to management and stakeholders.
- Continuously monitor and optimize the recruiting funnel, deploying innovative techniques to source, attract, and engage high-quality passive and active talent across EMEA, ensuring a steady flow of top-tier candidates.
- Lead in-depth behavioural interviews and phone screens to rigorously assess technical expertise and cultural fit within Tesla's fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
- Guide hiring managers in designing effective interview processes, including structuring panels, defining evaluation criteria, and ensuring alignment with role requirements.
- Prioritize a high-quality candidate experience at every touchpoint, continuously identifying ways to streamline processes and enhance overall satisfaction.
- Go above and beyond core recruiting duties by leading long-term projects to enhance team capabilities, while flexibly supporting urgent, high-priority hiring needs across other areas or functions as required.

What You’ll Bring

- Demonstrated excellence in sourcing, assessing, and hiring top-tier engineering talent, ideally within the automotive or related high-tech industries.
- Proven expertise in managing relationships with hiring teams and business partners, leading talent needs assessments, and developing effective hiring plans.

title: Finance Transformation Manager (f/m/d) (Controller/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Location: Erlangen, Nürnberg, Mühlheim, Hamburg, Berlin, Lisbon, Bucharest, Warsaw

Department: SE FIN TI BC

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis

Mode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day

For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.
At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.
A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Subject to the future setup and related decisions, the role may offer a path toward taking on team leadership responsibility for this unit.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Support the carve-out of Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness
* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs
* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences
* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards
* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey
* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership role

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field
* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment
* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team
* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation
* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

This position is newly created, and that is the whole point of it. Transformation of Industry does not yet have a dedicated Function Controlling — you are the person who builds it, for a functional cost base estimated at more than €600 million. You define the operating model, the cost center and manpower steering logic, the reporting cadence and the standards that the functions will be steered by, and you build the team that runs them.
You are not starting from an empty page. A part of the team will transfer into the new unit, so you begin with experienced colleagues who know the business, the processes and you grow the team around them. title: Sozialarbeiterin / Erzieherin für Wochenenddienste (Tagesdienst) im Mutter-Kind-Verbund (m/w/d) (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
Der Mutter-Kind-Verbund von Prowo Berlin bietet Unterstützung für schwangere Frauen und Mütter, die psychische Erkrankungen oder schwere Lebenskrisen erleben, und ihren Kindern unter sechs Jahren. - Bereitschaftsdienst in der Therapeutischen Wohngemeinschaft in Kreuzberg
- Wochenend-/Feiertags-Dienstzeiten: 08.00 – 14.15 oder 13.45 – 20.00 Uhr

- erforderlich: Berufsabschluss als Erzieherin, Sozialpädagogin, Sozialarbeiterin, Heilpädagogin, Psychologin oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit psychisch erkrankten Menschen
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Müttern und Kindern
- eigenverantwortliche Handlungskompetenzen
- eine wertschätzende Haltung

title: Field Reliability & Quality Engineer, Electrical (m/f/d) (Site Reliability Engineer)
description:
What to Expect

The Field Quality team’s mission is to improve customer experience of Tesla products by reducing field issues. The role is responsible for our charging product portfolio including, but not limited to Super & Mega charger, Optimus Charging and Wall connector and works cross functionally with other engineering and service teams. We are seeking a multi-faceted engineer who will be responsible for all aspects of identifying, analyzing, root causing, implementing countermeasures, and reporting on issues affecting products. To be effective, the Field Quality engineer will need to be intimately familiar with the detailed behavior of our Energy Products and the tools and equipment used in their design and manufacture.  They will work with other engineering teams to quickly mitigate and implement countermeasures of field issues to improve quality, reliability, and durability of the products.

What You’ll Do

- Monitor products field performance, identify trending issues.  Prioritize based on severity, occurrence, and/or cost of each failure mode
- Triage emerging trends and use engineering first principals to come up with failure hypothesis
- Coordinate efforts with the Failure Analysis team to identify root causes of problems
- Apply knowledge of mechanical, electrical engineering and PCBA manufacturing to drive containment and corrective action implementation into production / design / supplier / Firmware
- Communicate field performance of the engineering system, gather buy-in from engineering leadership on improvement priorities and urgency
- Drive continuous improvement in design and performance by providing direct and accurate feedback to design owners
- Share Lessons Learned from previous field issues; Provide upfront feedback by participating in design reviews to ensure product performance, reliability, and manufacturability issues are identified and risks mitigated (DFMEAs)
- Take part in ongoing optimization of the products and processes (performance, cost, technology)

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics hardware design, design validation, hardware testing, mechanical system reliability, or durability testing (including relevant internship or academic lab work experience)
- Ability/experience to navigate existing software/firmware tools and logs to identify and label failure modes encountered
- The successful candidate for this position must have a broad engineering background with the ability to work with design engineering, manufacturing, service, and suppliers across a wide variety of issues
- Exceptional problem solving and Failure Analysis, strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills are an absolute requirement to establish effective working relationships within Tesla and outside
- Ability to use tools and business system applications to manage, synthesize, and interpret data
- Preferred: Experience with inverters, EV batteries, HV controls, and/or industrial grid codes
- Preferred: Experience working with DC Fast charging systems/features (e.g. high-voltage DC busses, DC isolation monitoring, grid-tied systems, network diagnostics, CAN communication, PLC, Modbus, TCP/IP protocols, etc.)

description:

Tesla is seeking a dynamic, strategic, and experienced attorney to support, collaborate with, and guide business partners at its Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg and the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region on environmental and occupational health and safety (EHS) legal compliance and enforcement matters applicable to automobile manufacturing, service & delivery, lithium refining and battery development, renewable energy products, and sustainable recycling programs for end-of-life product disposal.You must be ready to put on steel-toed boots and traverse our facilities to learn the business and help support operations on EHS legal matters. The position will be based at Gigafactory and travel will be required to other company locations as needed.

What You’ll Do

- Reporting to Tesla’s Associate General Counsel for Environment, Health & Safety, and Security, provide EHS legal support for Tesla’s Gigafactory and EMEA operations, including counseling on all aspects of air, waste, chemical, and water-related regulatory compliance, permitting, and enforcement issues
- Collaborate with the EHS teams on EHS initiatives and work closely with EHS and other business partners and leaders to anticipate, assess, and manage legal impacts on major business decisions

title: Senior Manager Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Personal)
description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As Senior Manager Global Mobility (m/f/d) you are accountable for the strategic design, governance, and operational excellence of the company's global mobility programs in alignment with the VPCBM. This role provides expert leadership across international assignments, permanent transfers, short-term assignments, localization, and cross-border employment models ensuring compliance with tax, immigration, social security and labor law of both home, and host countries.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

Regional Compensation Management

- Lead the execution of regional compensation strategies in alignment with global compensation frameworks.
- Manage annual compensation cycles, including salary planning, merit increases, promotions, bonus programs, and market adjustments.
- Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on compensation decisions related to hiring, internal movement, retention, and workforce planning.
- Conduct job evaluations and support job architecture governance within the regions.
- Monitor market trends and benchmarking data to recommend competitive compensation practices.
- Ensure compensation practices comply with local labor, pay transparency, and wage equity regulations.

Benefits Strategy & Administration

- Manage regional employee benefit team and ensure the programs are aligned with overall Total Rewards objectives.
- Evaluate plan competitiveness, utilization, employee feedback, and cost effectiveness.
- Support benefit renewals, vendor negotiations, cost management initiatives, and employee communications.
- Recommend program enhancements based on market trends and workforce needs.

Mobility Program Management

- Oversee regional mobility team activities including permanent transfers, international assignments, business travelers, localization, and cross-border employment arrangements.
- Ensure guidance to business leaders and HR on appropriate workforce deployment solutions is provided.
- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with immigration, tax, payroll, social security, and employment requirements.
- Support assignment cost projections, budgeting, and approval processes.
- Manage complex and sensitive mobility cases, including senior leadership relocations and critical talent deployments.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

- Ensure compensation, benefits, and mobility programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Payroll, Tax, and external advisors to mitigate compliance and financial risks.
- Support internal and external audits and maintain appropriate governance documentation.
- Monitor legislative and regulatory developments impacting Total Rewards programs.
- Escalate risks and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

Analytics, Reporting & Program Effectiveness

- Analyze compensation, benefits, and mobility data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
- Conduct market benchmarking and support regional workforce planning initiatives.
- Develop dashboards, reports, and business cases to support data-driven decision making.
- Measure program effectiveness and recommend process improvements and efficiencies.
- Drive adoption of technology and process standardization across the region.

Managerial Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a regional team of 3 Compensation, Benefits, and/or Mobility professionals.
- Establish team objectives, priorities, and development plans.
- Provide coaching and direction on complex employee and business cases.
- Ensure consistent service delivery and stakeholder satisfaction across the region.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, or related field
- Strong knowledge of compensation strategy, job architecture, benchmarking, and incentive programs.
- Knowledge of employee benefits design, administration, and vendor management.

As a Commodity Manager (f/m/d) CD & NUC, you will shape the sourcing strategy for some of Siemens Energy’s most advanced technology categories, including electronic equipment, controls, digitalization, and nuclear services. What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics or a comparable technical or business discipline

* Business fluent in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

The portfolio comprises drug containment and delivery solutions for injectable drugs ranging from prefillable glass and polymer syringes, to cartridges, vials, and ampoules. Every day, a team of around 4,700 people from over 65 nations works at SCHOTT Pharma to contribute to global healthcare. Ranging from active health management via flexible working hours and hybrid work all the way to corporate pension plans: everything geared to suit your goals and needs. - Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.

- Leitungserfahrung im sozialwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsfeld
- Interesse an Vernetzung und konzeptioneller Arbeit

- Vergütung nach Haustarif in Anlehnung an TV-L SuE 2025, S18
- arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach der Probezeit in Höhe von 4,6% des monatlichen Bruttogehaltes und Kinderzuschlag

title: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Ræsting/Cleaning
description:
*Job Title:** Housekeeping & Breakfast Attendant
**Location:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógar, Iceland
**Position:** Full-Time
**Start Date:** November 15, 2026

Hótel Skógafoss and Hótel Anna, located in the beautiful surroundings of South Iceland, are seeking a dedicated and versatile individual to join our team in a full-time capacity. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and reliable professional responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and ensuring our guests have a wonderful start to their day.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Performing comprehensive cleaning of guest rooms and public areas to ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment.
* Managing all aspects of the daily breakfast service, including setting up and replenishing the buffet, and ensuring the dining area is clean and well-presented.
* Handling the hotel's laundry services, including washing, drying, and folding linens.
* Providing excellent customer service, assisting guests with inquiries, and processing payments for breakfast when required.

**The Ideal Candidate:**
* Has proven experience in housekeeping and/or food and beverage service.
* Is fluent in English and possesses excellent communication skills. Proficiency in other languages is a strong asset.
* Holds a valid B-category driver's license.
* Is a dependable team player with a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.
* Is flexible and willing to work a varied schedule.

**What We Offer:**
* A stable, full-time position in a friendly and dynamic work environment.
* Competitive wages according to the collective bargaining agreement with the VLFS union.
* **On-site accommodation is available for a fee.**
* The opportunity to live and work in one of Iceland's most scenic areas.

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

Interested parties are requested to send an application along with a CV to the email address: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is
Last application date is November 15th , 2026.

**Starfsheiti:** Umsjónaraðili herbergja og morgunverðar
**Staðsetning:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógum
**Starfshlutfall:** Fullt starf
**Starf hefst:** 15. nóvember 2026

Hótel Skógafoss og Hótel Anna, staðsett í hinu fallega umhverfi Suðurlands, óska eftir að ráða þjónustulundaðan og fjölhæfan einstakling í fullt starf. Leitum að ábyrgum og traustum aðila sem hefur metnað til að viðhalda ýtrustu kröfum um hreinlæti og tryggja að gestir okkar fái frábæra byrjun á deginum.

* Umfangsmikil þrif á herbergjum og sameiginlegum rýmum hótelsins til að tryggja snyrtilegt og notalegt umhverfi.
* Fullnaðarumsjón með morgunverðarþjónustu, þ.m.t. undirbúningur og áfylling á hlaðborð.
* Umsjón með þvotti hótelsins, s.s. þvottur, þurrkun og frágangur á líni.
* Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu, aðstoða gesti og taka við greiðslum fyrir morgunverð þegar við á.

**Hæfniskröfur:**
* Sönnuð reynsla af þrifum og/eða störfum í veitingaþjónustu er skilyrði.
* Mjög góð enskukunnátta og framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni. Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.
* Gilt ökuskírteini (B-flokkur) er skilyrði.
* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.
* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.

**Það sem við bjóðum:**
* Öruggt fullt starf á vinalegum og lifandi vinnustað.
* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.
* **Húsnæði er í boði á staðnum gegn gjaldi.**
* Einstakt tækifæri til að búa og starfa á einum fallegasta stað landsins.

**Umsóknir:**
Farið er yfir umsóknir jafnóðum.

Áhugasamir vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our team in Reykjavík.

In this role, you will design and build the distributed systems that run our AAA rated MMO, EVE Online: one persistent world, no instancing, tens of thousands of players sharing the same simulation. You possess a solid grasp of distributed systems, together with a genuine feel for reasoning about consistency, latency, and failure at scale.

Your Tasks:
System Design: Design and build the distributed systems that partition and rebalance simulation load across nodes.
Consistency and Failure: Keep state consistent under partial failure, and shape the failure semantics so a bad node degrades one region instead of taking down a fight.
Performance: Design messaging and RPC paths where latency budgets are measured in milliseconds.
Services and Data: Work on service decomposition, service interfaces, data replication, and caching strategies.
Implementation and Delivery: Write code, take a design from design review through to production, and manage priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.
Measurement and Iteration: Instrument your work, load test it, and use that evidence to shape the next iteration.
Collaboration: Work with product owners and game designers to understand what a feature demands of the platform, then design systems that meet those demands within real constraints.

Your Profile:
5+ years in professional software development, with real depth in distributed or concurrent systems.
Strong in at least one systems or backend language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, or Python), and the judgment to reach for a different one when the problem calls for it.
A track record designing distributed systems: service and API boundaries, consistency and coordination models, replication, partitioning, and graceful degradation when a node fails.
Solid fundamentals: complexity analysis, concurrency and synchronization, queueing behaviour, and a real feel for the CAP and latency tradeoffs you're making.
Comfortable with distributed communication patterns and the tools behind them: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming.
Experience with data stores and how they scale, relational and nonrelational, plus the caching and replication strategies built on top.
You run what you build: operating services in production on cloud (AWS or Azure) and on Kubernetes.
You use telemetry to reason about live behaviour (tracing, metrics, structured logging with tools like OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or Prometheus) and you load and failure test a design rather than assume it holds.

Nice to have:
A bachelor's in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is just as welcome.
Infrastructure as code and automated delivery (Terraform, Packer, Ansible, or similar) as the way your systems ship and change safely.
Networking and systems fundamentals (UNIX, TCP/IP, load balancing, CDNs) good enough to debug your own systems down to the wire.

What We Can Offer You:
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

title: 3D Artist
description:
Fenris Creations is looking for a 3D Artist with generalist range to join the EVE Online art team in our Reykjavik studio.

New Eden is built from hard surface ships and structures, station interiors, props and environments, along with the materials and lighting that hold them together. Some of that work starts from finished concept art. Some of it starts from a conversation and a rough direction, and needs an artist who can design in 3D rather than wait for someone else to draw it first. This role covers both.

You will own assets from early visual development through modelling, texturing and final polish in the CARBON engine, including any VFX pass the asset needs to read properly in game.

Your Tasks:
Create high quality, production ready 3D assets from concept art or, when required, develop original asset designs independently and in close collaboration with the Art Director and the wider art team, using 3D tools to explore shape language, function, proportion, scale and visual identity.
Take ownership of assigned assets and drive them from initial idea through final delivery, including design, high and low poly modelling, UVs, LODs, texturing, materials, VFX and final polish.
Ensure assets meet established artistic, technical and performance standards, working with Technical Art and Engineering to stay inside memory and performance budgets without giving up visual fidelity. Contribute ideas that improve visual quality, consistency and production workflows.
Participate actively in idea development within the art department, and collaborate with concept, VFX, technical art, design and engineering. Present work clearly, respond constructively to feedback and iterate efficiently.
Manage your own priorities and identifying problems, opportunities and next steps. Estimate tasks, communicate progress and raise risks or blockers early.

Your Profile:
Approximately three to five years of professional experience creating 3D assets for games, or a portfolio demonstrating an equivalent level of ability and production experience including work taken through a complete real-time pipeline. Strong modelling, texturing and material creation skills, with a solid grounding in PBR authoring and an understanding of how a real-time renderer will treat your work.
Ability to create assets from established concept art, and to develop original designs from broader creative direction. Strong understanding of shape language, form, proportion, scale, composition and visual hierarchy.
Confident with industry standard 3D and 2D software, for example Maya, Blender and Photoshop. Working knowledge of real-time optimisation and technical constraints, including topology, LODs, texture budgets and draw call cost, and comfortable working in an in-house engine and toolset.
Ability to create or contribute to VFX passes so that an asset reads correctly in game. You do not need to be a VFX specialist, but you do need to be able to finish your own assets rather than hand them on for someone else to complete.
Able to work independently, take ownership of an asset from initial idea to final delivery, and drive it forward without waiting to be asked. Comfortable presenting work, receiving direct critique, iterating quickly, and contributing to creative discussion across disciplines and departments. Clear communicator in written and spoken English.
An interest in science fiction design and the visual universe of EVE Online.

Nice to have:
Deeper VFX ability.
Scripting in Python.
A history of contributing to open source graphics, tooling or content pipeline projects.

What We Can Offer You:
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
