title: Deputy Project Control Manager
description:
The Deputy Project Control Manager supports the Project Control Manager in planning, coordinating, and overseeing all project control functions, including cost control, scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, and reporting. The role ensures that project performance is accurately measured and communicated, enabling effective decision-making and timely corrective actions.

Acting as a key interface between engineering, procurement, construction, and finance teams, the Deputy Project Control Manager helps ensure alignment between scope, schedule, cost, and risk throughout the project lifecycle. The role may act on behalf of the Project Control Manager when required.

Key Responsibilities

Project Controls Support

    Assist in establishing and maintaining integrated project control systems covering cost, schedule, progress, and forecasting.
    Support development and maintenance of project budgets, cost breakdown structures (CBS), and work breakdown structures (WBS).
    Ensure alignment between project scope, schedule, and cost baselines.

Cost & Schedule Monitoring

    Monitor project cost and schedule performance against approved baselines.
    Support preparation of forecasts, including Estimate at Completion (EAC) and cash flow projections.
    Analyse variances and performance trends, identifying root causes and potential mitigation measures.

Reporting & Performance Analysis

    Prepare accurate and timely project control reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
    Support monthly project reviews and management reporting with reliable data and analysis.
    Ensure consistency and integrity of project control data across systems and reports.

Change & Risk Management

    Support evaluation of change requests, variations, and claims by assessing schedule and cost impacts.
    Assist in managing project contingencies and tracking risk exposure.
    Ensure approved changes are reflected in updated baselines and forecasts.

Contract & Progress Management

    Support review of contractor progress, invoices, and cost reports for accuracy and contractual compliance.
    Assist in tracking commitments, accruals, and progress measurement.
    Coordinate with planning and cost teams to ensure accurate progress reporting.

Collaboration & Governance

    Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Planners, Cost Controllers, and Construction teams to integrate project controls into daily execution.
    Support development, implementation, and adherence to project control procedures and governance.
    Provide guidance and mentoring to junior project control staff.

Continuous Improvement

    Identify opportunities to improve project control processes, tools, and reporting practices.
    Capture and apply lessons learned to enhance future project performance.

Competencies and Experience

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
    Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in project controls, cost control, or planning roles within industrial, infrastructure, or EPC projects.
    Solid understanding of project cost control, scheduling, progress measurement, and forecasting.
    Experience with project control and planning tools (e.g., cost control systems, scheduling software).
    Good knowledge of contracts, change management, and project governance.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Effective communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
    High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

title: Cost Controller Manager
description:
The Cost Controller Manager is responsible for establishing, managing, and overseeing all project cost control activities to ensure effective financial planning, monitoring, forecasting, and reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

The role ensures that project costs are controlled in line with approved budgets, schedules, and contractual requirements, while providing accurate and timely financial insight to support informed decision-making.

The Cost Controller Manager works closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Finance teams to integrate cost control processes with overall project execution.

The role plays a key part in identifying financial risks and opportunities, supporting change management, and ensuring cost transparency across all project phases.

Key Responsibilities

Cost Control & Financial Management

    Establish and maintain the project cost control structure, including budgets, cost breakdown structures (CBS), and control accounts.
    Monitor actual costs versus budget and forecast final project costs (Estimate at Completion).
    Ensure alignment between cost, schedule, and scope to support effective project controls.
    Analyze cost deviations and trends, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions.
    Ensure compliance with internal cost control procedures and financial governance requirements.

Forecasting & Reporting

    Prepare accurate and timely cost reports, forecasts, and dashboards for project and senior management.
    Provide clear visibility of cost performance, risks, and opportunities.
    Support monthly and periodic financial reviews with reliable cost data and analysis.
    Ensure consistency and accuracy of cost data across systems and reporting tools.

Change & Risk Management

    Support evaluation of change requests, variations, and claims by assessing cost impacts.
    Maintain cost contingency management and track risk-related cost exposure.
    Collaborate with project teams to mitigate financial risks and optimize cost outcomes.
    Ensure approved changes are reflected accurately in budgets and forecasts.

Contract & Procurement Support

    Support procurement and contract management with cost analysis, payment verification, and financial evaluations.
    Review contractor invoices, progress claims, and cost reports to ensure accuracy and contractual compliance.
    Track commitments, accruals, and cash flow forecasts.

Collaboration & Governance

    Work closely with Project Managers, Planners, Engineers, and Construction teams to ensure cost control is fully integrated into project execution.
    Provide guidance and training on cost control practices and tools.
    Ensure audit readiness through proper documentation, traceability, and cost records.

Continuous Improvement

    Identify opportunities to improve cost control processes, tools, and reporting methodologies.
    Capture and apply lessons learned to enhance future project cost performance.
    Promote best practices in cost management across the organization.

Competencies and Experience

    Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Economics, or a related field.
    Minimum of 7 years of experience in project cost control, preferably within industrial, infrastructure, or EPC projects.
    Strong knowledge of project cost management, forecasting, and financial reporting.
    Experience working with project controls systems and cost management tools.
    Solid understanding of contracts, change management, and project financial governance.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
    High level of accuracy, integrity, and attention to detail.

title: Principal User Researcher
description:
The role

Sharkmob is an innovative AAA video game company dedicated to creating engaging multiplayer experiences. Our research lab focuses on understanding what drives players and enhances their enjoyment. We collect insights using traditional research methods, whether through usability testing or playtests, to guide our developers in making data-driven decisions. Our Data, User Research, and Design teams work closely to interpret player behaviours and conduct extended research in collaboration with local universities.

As a Principal User Researcher, you will be the craft expert who leads research efforts, mentor teammates, & support design. You will also align user research activities across the studio, driving player-centric game development.

This is a fixed-term position, with the possibility of extension depending on business needs.

Responsibilities

    

Design & execute studies using experimental design and research methodology.

    

Actively share knowledge and maintain key stakeholder relationships via workshops, reports, and presentations

    

Develop, promote, and ensure good user research practices.

    

Guide game teams in planning user research strategies for the lifecycle of their games.

    

Support teams via expert reviews, UX writing, and industry knowledge to guide decision making

    

Promote collaboration between Data, UX, Design, and Marketing teams.

    

Provide consultative support and guidance to senior stakeholders.

    

Mentor and upskill User Researchers in all areas of the craft.

Requirements

    

8+ years of experience in user research

    

Experience in mentoring or leading teams.

    

Bachelor's degree or higher in experimental/social/cognitive psychology, human-computer interaction, or equivalent industry experience.

    

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    

Extensive experience with user interviews, surveys, moderating research sessions, and usability tests.

    

Passion for video games is beneficial, and experience in game development or the entertainment industry is desirable.

    

Strong analytical skills with a background or coursework in descriptive and inferential statistics.

Bonus points

    

Experience with shooter or live service games.

    

Experience in UX design or UX writing

Who we are

Sharkmob is a Swedish game developer founded in 2017. We create AAA-quality games for PC and console, using the Unreal Engine to power our ambitions of taking multiplayer games to new heights. We are currently developing Exoborne, our first original IP. In 2022, we released Bloodhunt, a battle royale set in the Vampire: The Masquerade universe.

At Sharkmob, we believe great games are created by diverse teams with different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative workplace where creativity can thrive. Our culture is built around shared ownership, a passion for creating great games, and, just as importantly, having fun along the way.

We’d love for you to join us on our journey and become part of our crew. To learn more about Sharkmob, our projects, and the perks of being a crew member, visit our homepage.

title: Director of Development, Minecraft Core
description:
Mojang Studios is best known as the creators of Minecraft, but we’re also on a mission – to build a better world through the power of play.

Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It’s the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. From the relentless experimentation of our endlessly inspiring community to the classrooms where Minecraft has become an essential teaching tool, play is the bedrock of our existence.

About the Role  

As Director of Development, you are a senior leader responsible for turning studio strategy into executable outcomes across multiple disciplines. You own the development operating system: planning, dependency management, production health, risk mitigation, cross-functional alignment, and delivery cadence.

You lead delivery across a complex game development organization, ensuring that work moves coherently between design, engineering, platform, production, QA, and live operations. Through strong coordination, transparency, and execution excellence, you enable teams to build high-quality player experiences in a scalable and sustainable way, creating the conditions needed to turn ambitious visions into reality.



Key Responsibilities  

    Representing delivery excellence on the Core Leadership Team
    Accountable for delivery excellence across multiple departments, ensuring the organisation has the clarity, structure, tools, and ways of working needed to execute effectively
    Owns delivery health across the full development cycle, including planning, progress visibility, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and escalation paths
    Connects organisational priorities to execution, translating leadership direction into clear operating rhythms, decisions, and delivery plans
    Drives alignment across design, platform, engineering, production, QA, and live operations, ensuring teams are working against shared priorities and expectations
    Establishes scalable delivery models for complex game development, improving how multiple teams plan, collaborate, execute, test and playtest, and deliver together
    Provides leadership visibility on organisational readiness, delivery performance, key risks, dependencies, and strategic trade-offs.
    Leading people manager excellence by strengthening the group with the right tools and systems, modeling people management excellence, coaching managers through complex leadership situations, and helping build consistency in how teams are supported
    Promotes rituals, forums, and practices that strengthen team health, such as manager communities, craft communities, feedback loops, and spaces for learning, reflection, and continuous improvement



What you’ll need to succeed

    Proven experience leading large-scale game or software development organisations
    Strong track record of delivering complex products and services in a live operating  environment
    Proven experience implementing or improving development systems, delivery frameworks, forecasting, and organizational operating models
    Deep understanding of game development, production, engineering, and cross-functional execution
    Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels
    Exceptional communication, influence, and stakeholder alignment skills
    Passion for games, player experience, and empowering creative teams
    Experience building, leading, and developing inclusive, high-performing team



Leadership Characteristics

    Brings clarity to ambiguity and alignment to complexity
    Focuses on outcomes and player value rather than process for its own sake
    Creates an environment where teams can do their best work
    Balances creative ambition with delivery discipline and organisational effectiveness
    Leads with trust, accountability, transparency, and integrity



Bonus

    Experience leading development organizations within AAA games or large-scale live-service products.
    Experience scaling organizations through periods of growth, transformation, or increasing technical complexity.
    Familiarity with modern planning approaches, portfolio management, and data-informed decision making.
    Experience supporting geographically distributed or global development teams.



What You Need to Know  

We’re looking for candidates who are eligible to work in Sweden. Since our hybrid work model requires three onsite days per week, you’ll need to be based in Stockholm to collaborate with your team and soak up the studio energy.

Mojang Studios

Mojang Studios is a Microsoft-owned game developer. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden and has offices around the world, including Stockholm, Redmond, Tokyo, London, and Shanghai. We’re always working on new and exciting ways to expand the Minecraft universe.

Our community is global and incredibly diverse. We keep this in mind when developing anything, as we want people to feel included in Minecraft. And in recruiting, our goal is to make Mojang Studios as diverse as our community.

We got started as a tiny indie developer, and part of our culture still reflects that heritage. But we’re also proud to belong to Xbox Game Studios, which creates unique opportunities to grow and develop.

To help us achieve amazing things, we have built an equally amazing studio space. Situated right on the water by Söder Mälarstrand, it’s filled to the brim with all the tools, toys and caffeine required to create world-class entertainment.

But in the end, it’s the people of Mojang Studios that make this place truly special. When you join, you’ll find yourself in the company of incredibly bright, warm, and creative individuals – all united and working toward a single goal. Come help us reach it!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA home furnishing offer and make it more accessible for the many people. You will be part of IKEA Supply and the Supply Chain Development organisation. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

Is This Role for Me?

    Do you share IKEA’s values?
    Do you have at least 5 years' experience as a Data Engineer or equivalent?
    Are you Databricks or Fabric certified?
    Do you have deep operational knowledge of Python, SQL and PySpark?

If your answer is yes to at least three of the four statements above, then come and join us at IKEA!

Job Description

Supply Data & Analytics has the assignment to create value and enable business growth by bringing data from across IKEA together to gather actionable insights. Data & Analytics is passionate about making data, analytics and insights easily findable and explainable for the many to enable better and faster decision-making.

We work closely with our business stakeholders and form product teams that deliver cutting edge data driven solutions for our coworkers.

We work in a modern multi cloud-based environment, and you will be a part of the engineering team continuously developing and operating data products and analytical capabilities. You will be regularly involved in workshops with coworkers to harness modern data infrastructure efficiently and provide long term solutions.

Supporting a complex organisation to realise the benefits that modern data engineering can bring is at the heart of the role.

As a Data Engineer at IKEA, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure to support business needs, and decision-making processes.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Design, develop, and maintain data models (including dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault, and Medallion architecture) to support business needs of analytics and self-service reporting across Core Business Supply.
    Design, implement, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate diverse internal and external data sources (databases, APIs, real-time streams) into IKEAs data platforms.
    Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, analysts, data product leaders, and data scientists to translate complex supply chain and business requirements into scalable, performant, and well-governed data models and solutions.
    Establish, promote, and enforce data engineering best practices, including data modelling standards, data quality, version control, testing, monitoring, documentation, and metadata management.
    Optimise data models and pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency across batch and real-time processing.
    Ensure data is stored, processed, and accessed securely, with full adherence to data governance, privacy, and compliance standards.
    Contribute to the development and adoption of reusable frameworks, components, and semantic layers that accelerate data product delivery and increase consistency across the organisation.
    Stay current with emerging data engineering technologies and practices, applying them where they create clear business value.
    Promote a culture of data sharing, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement while guiding and developing less experienced coworkers through mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

In this role you will report to our Data Engineering Manager within Data & Technology at IKEA Supply.

The role is office based, with flexibility to work from home where required.

Qualifications

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people & data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question, and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.

We believe that our new colleague in Data Engineering should have at least 5 years' experience in designing, building, implementing and operating data pipelines that collect, manage, and convert raw data into usable information, with a high industry standard as well as excellent knowledge of SQL, Python and PySpark.

In addition, excellent working knowledge of Databricks, with Associate Data Engineer or Professional Data Engineer certification is crucial. It would also be beneficial to have knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, ideally with DP-600 or DP-700 certification.

The ideal applicant has good communication and collaboration skills and will be a team player who takes ownership, builds cross-functional relationships with coworkers, and loves sharing knowledge. You are a curious problem solver who wants to keep learning in a dynamic global environment. The role is office based so meeting face to face and working collaboratively to solve problems should be something you enjoy.

The IKEA culture and values are crucial for our business and day to day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA here.

If you are passionate about data engineering, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want to contribute to the success of a global furniture retailer, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us as we continue to innovate and shape the future of our industry.

Additional information

We look forward to receiving your application in English. Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process earlier than stated if we find the right candidate. This position will be based in Älmhult, Sweden. We regret that we are unable to handle applications made by e-mail. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than 22 Oct. 2026.

For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Håkan Almblad, Data Engineering Manager at hakan.almblad@inter.ikea.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Katie Pettersson at katie.pettersson2@inter.ikea.com.

title: Director, Marketing Creative & Art Direction, Minecraft
description:
Mojang Studios is best known as the creators of Minecraft, but we’re also on a mission – to build a better world through the power of play.

Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It’s the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. This role translates established business and brand strategy, audience insight, cultural signals, channel behavior, and performance learning into distinctive creative strategies, platforms, campaign architectures, and scalable design systems.  

The Director leads creative from brief shaping and concept development through production, launch, and learning, while making strong decisions around creative resourcing, partner strategy, investment, and creative tradeoffs in close partnership with Production. Operating as a T-shaped, AI-enabled player-coach, the Director leads at portfolio level while remaining hands-on at consequential moments to raise the creative bar, develop talent, and enable teams and partners to deliver outstanding work at scale.

Mojang Studios

title: Commissioning Engineer Liquid Food Solutions
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Commissioning Engineer that will have a key role in providing technical service to our Market Companies and end customers.



The position is permanent and based in Lund. The role includes up to 150 travel days per year.

What you will do

The work is project based and will give you the opportunity to work with the latest technologies. Your main task will be to test, start-up and fine-tune our solutions, both our branded processing units and complete process lines, at our production site and at end-customer’s factories all over the world. You will also have a key role in building competence in the team. We can offer you a very interesting position and an opportunity to grow and become professional in one of our core technologies for food processing.



You will focus on

    Commissioning, start-up and troubleshooting of branded processing units and process lines at our customer’s sites.
    Delivery tests performed in our engineering workshops.
    Technical training and support to Tetra Pak´s Market Companies.

We believe you have

Processing Liquid Food Solutions is responsible for development and manufacturing of solutions and branded processing units for the processing of liquid foods within dairy, beverage, prepared food, and plant based. We work closely with our market operations and customers to understand their true needs. To secure that we, create and convey our solutions that provide the greatest value for Tetra Pak and its Customers. Processing Liquid Food Solutions has approx. 350 employees in five main sites: Sweden, China, Mexico, USA, India, Singapore.



    You have a technical education on at least high school level
    Good understanding of automation
    Experience of mechanical engineering and hands-on work

title: Vineyard Workers and Tractor Operators
description:
Vineyard Workers and Tractor Operators at Assmåsa Vineyard

Autumn and winter 2026–2027 • Spring and summer 2027

Location: Assmåsa Estate, Skåne, Sweden

We are looking for motivated and reliable vineyard workers and tractor operators for autumn and winter 2026–2027 and the coming spring and summer 2027. Whether you are available for one season or several, please tell us when you can start and how long you can stay.

Only applicants with the legal right to work in Sweden will be considered.

About Us

Assmåsa Vineyard was founded by the Wikholm family in 2018/2019 and is located in the countryside near Snogeholmssjön, between Sjöbo and Ystad. Together with Flädie Vineyard, acquired in 2020, we are committed to producing high-quality Swedish wines. You will join a small international team and contribute to the work that takes our vines through each season.

About the Role

You will work closely with the vineyard manager and the team on daily vineyard operations. Tasks change with the season, weather and needs of the vines. Most work takes place outdoors, including during the colder months. Previous vineyard experience is an advantage but is not required for vineyard worker roles. Tractor operators should have relevant practical experience and be comfortable handling machinery safely.

Seasonal Responsibilities

Autumn 2026

• Support harvesting where needed, followed by clearing and tidying the vineyard after harvest.

• Help prepare the vineyard for winter, including checking posts, wires and other vineyard infrastructure.

• Clean and organise tools and equipment and assist with general vineyard maintenance.

Winter 2026–2027

• Carry out winter pruning according to instructions and help remove cut vine material.

• Maintain trellises, posts and wires and prepare tools and equipment for spring.

Spring 2027

• Continue pruning where needed and tie down canes ahead of the growing season.

• Assist with shoot thinning, early canopy management and planting or replacing vines where required.

Summer 2027

• Carry out canopy management, shoot positioning, leaf removal and other seasonal vineyard tasks.

• Help maintain the vineyard, monitor vine condition and prepare for the next harvest.

For tractor operator roles

• Operate tractors and vineyard equipment for seasonal field work and maintenance.

• Carry out routine equipment checks, keep machinery clean and report faults or maintenance needs.

Requirements

• Good physical condition and willingness to carry out repetitive manual work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including cold and wet weather.

• Ability to understand instructions and communicate in English; written English is also required.

• A reliable, responsible approach, attention to detail and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

• Experience with outdoor manual work is an advantage. Relevant machinery experience is expected for tractor operator roles.

• A category B driving licence is an advantage.

Employment Terms

• Seasonal employment with potential extension, depending on vineyard needs and mutual agreement.

• Start date and employment period by agreement. Please specify your availability for autumn, winter, spring and summer.

• Applicants should live within commuting distance or arrange their own accommodation for the employment period.

• Daytime working hours; occasional weekend work may occur during busy periods.

Application

Send your CV and cover letter to work@fladievingard.se.

Subject line: Application Vineyard Worker / Tractor Operator 2026–2027

In your cover letter, explain why you would like to work with us, describe your relevant experience and state whether you are applying as a vineyard worker, tractor operator or both. Include your earliest start date and the period or periods you are available.

Applications without a CV and cover letter will not be considered. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Screening Questions

Do you have the legal right to work in Sweden?

When can you start, and which seasons or dates are you available for?

Do you have experience with vineyard work, pruning or other outdoor manual work? Please describe briefly.

If applying as a tractor operator, which tractors, machinery or implements have you used?

Can you carry out physically demanding work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including winter?

Do you live within commuting distance, or can you arrange your own accommodation?

Which languages do you speak, and do you hold a category B driving licence?

title: Research engineer
description:
Join us as a research engineer and play a key role in supporting world-class research in materials science. Working closely with students, researchers, and advanced laboratory equipment, you will contribute to the development of materials and manufacturing technologies for a more sustainable future.

Information about the division

The https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/me/research/materials-and-manufacture/ at the https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/me/ (ME) conducts research and teaching in the areas of materials science and manufacturing technology. The activities range from materials design and coating development to additive manufacturing and the development of cutting processes. The work is mainly experimental and includes advanced microscopy and surface technology with links to theory. The division is responsible for the mechanical workshop and coordinates its experimental activities with the division of Computational Mechanics and Engineering Materials, whose activities in the Materials Manufacturing Lab are focused on mechanical testing and polymer processing. The two divisions share the need for advanced experimental support when it comes to computers and equipment.

Job description

As a research engineer, you will support Master's students, doctoral students, postdoctoral researchers, and staff by providing operational and technical support for laboratory equipment and related systems. The role includes maintenance support for advanced research instruments, contact with suppliers and service organisations, purchasing consumables and electronic devices, and assisting with invoicing for external users. You will also contribute to ensuring compliance with applicable work environment legislation within your areas of responsibility.

Contract terms

Temporary employment, for a maximum period of one year.

Qualifications

As a research engineer, you will support the operation and maintenance of advanced characterization equipment. This includes troubleshooting technical issues and coordinating with suppliers' service organizations when needed. To qualify for the position, you should have:

    a university degree, or equivalent qualifications, in a relevant technical field,
    knowledge of electrics, electrical installations, or digital electronics,
    the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical problems,
    good communication skills in both Swedish and English.

It is meritorious if you have:

    knowledge of mechanics, compressed air systems, cooling systems, and gases,
    experience from materials science or laboratory environments,
    experience supporting computers and electronic devices.

As many issues arise unexpectedly, you enjoy solving technical challenges and supporting students and researchers in their daily work. The position offers a varied workday with a wide range of responsibilities.

What we offer

Chalmers provides a cultivating and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of https://www.goteborg.com/en/. Read more about https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/work-with-us/chalmers-as-an-employer/ and our https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/work-with-us/chalmers-as-an-employer/benefits-and-conditions/ for employees.

Chalmers aims to actively improve our gender balance. We work broadly with equality projects, for example the https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/organisation-and-governance/equality/genie-gender-initiative-for-excellence/. Equality and diversity are substantial foundations in all activities at Chalmers.

Application procedure

The application should be attached as PDF files, as below:

CV

Personal letter

Other documents (optional):

    Copies of completed education, grades etc.

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.

Please use the button at the bottom of the page to reach the application form. We do not accept applications sent by email.

Application deadline: November 6th, 2026

For questions, please contact:

Uta Klement

uta.klement@chalmers.se

*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***

Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.

Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.

title: Sourcing Lead, EU and Americas - Gothenburg, Sweden
description:
Surgical Science is a global organisation and leading provider of medical training simulations and software solutions. Surgical Science is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market.

  

Together with healthcare partners and customers in more than 90 countries, we enhance patient safety and healthcare outcomes through evidence-based, state-of-the-art simulation technology that improves clinical proficiency and performance - enabling safe and effective training without putting patients at risk.

  

Our solutions are used by medical training centres, universities, hospitals, and the medical device industry for practice, assessment, and certification.

  

With offices in Gothenburg (HQ), Stockholm, Tel Aviv, Cleveland, Cardiff, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, we are a fast-growing and stable organisation in a rapidly evolving world. We foster a hybrid work culture that supports onsite and remote collaboration across teams and time zones.

  

The simulators that train tomorrow's surgeons need the right parts, from the right partners, at the right time. That's where you come in.



Surgical Science builds medical simulation technology used in operating rooms and training centers worldwide. Behind every haptic feedback device and surgical simulator is a supply chain that has to be as precise as the products themselves.



As our Sourcing Lead for EU and Americas, you'll own the supply chain for your region — building the supplier relationships and strategies that keep our production running and our quality standards uncompromised.



This is a senior role based at our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden, and you'll be a key part of our Operations leadership team. You'll lead and work closely with colleagues in R&D, Production, and operations across multiple markets.



What you'll actually do

    Design and execute regional sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, and supply security across EU and non-APAC markets
    Build and manage long-term supplier relationships — from initial qualification to ongoing performance management and contract negotiations
    Drive supplier performance, holding partners accountable to our delivery, quality, and cost targets
    Lead supplier diversification and risk mitigation initiatives, ensuring we're never dependent on a single source for critical components
    Ensure all procurement activity complies with our policies and supports our quality management standards
    Collaborate cross-functionally with production, engineering, and finance to align sourcing decisions with business priorities
    Identify opportunities for cost reduction and process improvement without compromising on quality
    Travel globally to meet suppliers and establish long-term relationships



What you need to bring

    5–8 years of procurement or sourcing experience, ideally in a manufacturing or hardware-focused environment
    Proven track record in supplier negotiations and relationship management — you know how to get to yes and how to make partnerships last
    Strong analytical skills: you can translate supplier data and market signals into smart sourcing decisions
    Experience or strong enthusiasm with shaping processes, structures, and ways of working in a newly established or developing organization
    Ability and drive to establish new ways of working (structure, processes)
    Clear, confident communicator — in writing and in conversation — in English (Swedish is a plus, not a must)
    Comfortable working across time zones and with suppliers in multiple countries
    Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and comfortable adopting procurement tools
    Availability to travel frequently (primarily Europe, but travels outside of Europe may also be necessary)



Even better if you have

    Background in medical devices, electronics, or complex hardware/software product companies
    Experience with supplier qualification processes in regulated industries
    Familiarity with supply chain risk frameworks and contingency planning
    Experience managing or leading a team



Where this can take you

This role sits at the intersection of operations and business strategy — and it grows with you. As Surgical Science continues to expand its product portfolio and global footprint, there's a real path toward a broader supply chain leadership mandate. You'll develop deep expertise in medical simulation manufacturing, build an international supplier network, and have a direct influence on the commercial success of products that genuinely change how surgeons are trained.



Life at Surgical Science

    🌍 A global team of 10+ nationalities, headquartered in the heart of Gothenburg
    🏥 Work that matters — our products contribute to safer surgical outcomes every day
    💻 Hybrid work flexibility
    ⌚ Flexible working hours
    📈 Real career development in a company that's grown significantly and isn't done yet



Surgical Science as an employer

Surgical Science is a global and continuously expanding organisation. You will be part of a dynamic, creative environment where we make sure to allow all employees to influence and contribute with their own unique experiences and knowledge.



Guided by our core values -  curiosity, respect, and perseverance - we strive to empower our people by recognising their strengths, supporting their growth, and creating opportunities to make a real impact.



We invite you to join us on this exciting and meaningful journey - to shape the future of medical training and improve care for patients around the world.



Apply today!

If you think you would fit our fantastic team and enjoy our work environment, apply as soon as possible as recruitment is ongoing. Let us meet and work out together whether we are a match!We kindly request that you apply with a CV in English.

title: Material Technology Engineer – Comfort
description:
Company Description

Help create the next generation of comfort solutions

Are you passionate about textiles, comfort, and material innovation? Do you want to influence how millions of people experience comfort in their everyday life?

We're looking for a Material Technology Engineer - Comfort to drive the development of innovative materials, technologies, and manufacturing solutions within our Textile & Comfort area. Based on the responsibilities and competence requirements described for the Material Technology Engineer role.

Your mission

As part of the Material & Engineering team, you will lead innovation and development projects focused on textiles, soft materials, comfort constructions, and related manufacturing technologies.

You will work closely with product developers, suppliers, innovation teams, and external partners to identify opportunities and transform ideas into scalable solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Exploring new textile materials, fibers, constructions, fillings, foams, nonwovens, and comfort solutions.
    Evaluating emerging technologies and their potential application in future products.
    Supporting material roadmaps and identifying innovation opportunities that contribute to quality, sustainability, affordability, and customer value.
    Working early in the product development process to ensure optimal material and comfort solutions.
    Collaborating with suppliers, universities, startups, and industry experts to bring external innovation into the business.
    Developing and maintaining material specifications, quality requirements, and technical documentation.
    Driving knowledge sharing and capability building within Textile & Comfort.
    Supporting the implementation of new materials and technologies in industrial production.

Qualifications

Who you are

You are curious by nature and genuinely excited about understanding how materials influence comfort, functionality, durability, and sustainability.

We believe you have:

    A degree in Textile Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
    Experience working with textiles, soft materials, comfort products, upholstery, mattresses, bedding, furniture, automotive interiors, or related industries.
    Strong knowledge of textile materials, fiber technologies, fabric constructions, nonwovens, foams, fillings, or comfort systems.
    Experience leading development projects and working cross-functionally in complex environments.
    The ability to translate customer needs into material and technology solutions.
    A strong interest in sustainability, circularity, recycled materials, and future material innovations.
    Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
    Strong communication skills in English.

We think you'll thrive if you are

    Passionate about textiles and comfort.
    Curious about future materials and emerging technologies.

    Analytical and comfortable working with both data and hands-on testing.
    Energised by collaboration across functions, cultures, and external networks.

Why this role?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of comfort. You will work with material innovation from idea to implementation, influencing everything from next-generation textile materials to sustainable comfort solutions that reach customers around the world.

If you are excited about combining material science, textile expertise, innovation, and customer insight, we would love to hear from you.

If you have questions about the role, please contact Material & Engineering Manager Catarina Englund at catarina.englund1@inter.ikea.com

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Femina Karlsson at femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com.

Welcome with your application!

title: RF Engineer
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as an RF Engineer in our Instrumentation team. We are looking for someone who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.

As an RF Engineer, you will develop, test and maintain RF and telemetry systems that support rocket and stratospheric balloon missions at Esrange Space Center in northern Sweden. Joining the Instrumentation team within Science Services’ Rocket and Balloon department, you will combine hands-on work on existing systems with development projects and operational support during customer campaigns. You will work closely with engineers and international customers, turning technical requirements into reliable solutions for ground systems and launch operations.

REQUIREMENTS

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronics, electrical engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
    A strong background in RF design, analysis and testing, preferably within telemetry, telecommunications or space technologies.
    Experience with RF system analysis, including link budgets, noise figure calculations and modulation techniques.
    Hands-on experience with RF test and measurement equipment, such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators and RF analyzers.
    A practical approach to troubleshooting and an ability to translate technical requirements into workable solutions.
    Good collaboration skills and an interest in working across engineering disciplines in an international environment.
    Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
    A valid driver’s license and access to a car.

Experience with network hardware integration, network programming and software development is an advantage.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Develop, test, maintain and improve RF and telemetry systems at the Esrange Telemetry Station and across local installations.
    Gather and analyze requirements from internal teams and external customers, and develop RF solutions that meet their needs.
    Work with systems engineers to design and integrate custom installations for stratospheric balloon and rocket operations, including hybrid rocket projects.
    Perform RF system analysis, including link budgets, noise figure calculations and assessment of modulation schemes.
    Configure and operate RF equipment, including analyzers, signal generators, switch matrices, wideband recorders and receivers.
    Support PCB design and layout in collaboration with engineering teams.
    Support customer campaigns and launch operations, working with the Esrange Telemetry Station and customers’ mobile telemetry stations.
    Prepare technical documentation for design reviews, testing and system operation.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.





LOCATION

This is a permanent full-time position located at Esrange Space Center, Kiruna. As part of our team, you will participate in rocket and balloon campaigns that can be scheduled outside of regular business hours. Occasional requirements to work campaigns with our international partners outside of Sweden will be required.



FURTHER INFORMATION

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer:

SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com



NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.



WE HELP EARHT BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: General Counsel
description:
Paebbl is an industrial resilience company turning captured CO₂ into carbon-storing building materials. We accelerate the natural process of CO₂ mineralisation- in which CO₂ reacts with minerals to form stable carbonates from thousands of years -to a matter of hours, producing a carbon-negative powder that can replace conventional, heavily emitting cementitious materials. Having switched on the world’s first continuous CO₂ mineralisation demonstration plant, we are now scaling from startup execution into structured industrial operations. It is a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, ownership, and the ability to build things that work in the real world matter.

The Role

This is a hands-on, strategic role for someone who is comfortable operating in a startup or scale-up environment: pragmatic, commercially minded, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to balance legal risk with business momentum.

As General Counsel, you will be Paebbl’s senior legal leader and a trusted advisor to the executive team, board, and wider business. You will be responsible for shaping the company’s legal strategy, managing legal risk, supporting fundraising and governance, negotiating key commercial agreements, and building a scalable legal infrastructure that supports Paebbl’s growth.

This role requires someone who can move between strategic counsel and hands-on execution. One day you may be advising on board governance, financing, or regulatory risk; the next, you may be negotiating a partnership agreement, reviewing procurement terms, supporting employment matters, or managing external counsel across multiple jurisdictions.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in startup or scale-up environments and understands what it means to build legal processes that are practical, business-friendly, and fit for a fast-moving company.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Strategy and Leadership

    Build and lead Paebbl’s legal function, creating a practical, scalable, and business-oriented legal operating model.
    Act as a trusted legal advisor to the CEO, executive team, and board on strategic, commercial, corporate, and governance matters.
    Provide clear, pragmatic legal guidance that helps the business make informed decisions without slowing execution unnecessarily.
    Develop legal processes, templates, policies, and risk frameworks suitable for a fast-growing startup environment.
    Identify and manage legal risks across the business, ensuring Paebbl remains compliant while maintaining commercial agility.

Corporate Governance and Financing

    Support board governance, shareholder matters, corporate structuring, and legal documentation for board and investor processes.
    Partner with the finance and leadership teams on fundraising, investor due diligence, financing rounds, and related corporate matters.
    Manage corporate housekeeping across relevant jurisdictions, ensuring accurate records, filings, approvals, and governance documentation.
    Advise on equity, incentive plans, shareholder rights, and other corporate matters as the company grows.

Commercial Contracts and Partnerships

    Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including customer contracts, supplier agreements, strategic partnerships, NDAs, licensing arrangements, procurement contracts, and service agreements.
    Support business development and commercial teams in structuring deals that balance growth, risk, and operational feasibility.
    Create standardized contract templates and playbooks to improve speed, consistency, and quality of contracting across the company.
    Advise on contractual risk, liability, warranties, indemnities, IP ownership, confidentiality, data protection, and dispute resolution.

Industrial, Manufacturing, and Project Support

    Provide legal support for agreements related to manufacturing, engineering, construction, supply chain, equipment, technology deployment, and project delivery.
    Advise on legal risks related to industrial scale-up, operational partnerships, procurement, and cross-border execution.
    Work closely with technical, commercial, finance, and operations teams to ensure legal support is embedded early in project planning.

Regulatory, Compliance, and Risk

    Advise on relevant regulatory and compliance matters across Sweden, the EU, and other relevant jurisdictions.
    Build and maintain practical compliance frameworks covering areas such as anti-bribery and corruption, sanctions, data protection, competition law, conflicts of interest, and business ethics.
    Partner with teams across the business to ensure legal and compliance obligations are understood and implemented in a practical way.

Employment, People, and Internal Policies

    Partner with the People team on employment law matters, employee agreements, contractor arrangements, policies, equity documentation, and sensitive employee relations issues.
    Support the development of legally sound and values-aligned internal policies.
    Advise on cross-border employment and workforce-related legal questions as the company expands.

External Counsel and Legal Operations

    Select, manage, and coordinate external legal advisors across jurisdictions and subject areas.
    Ensure external counsel is used effectively, with clear scopes, cost discipline, and strong business alignment.
    Build internal legal operations processes, including matter tracking, contract management, approval workflows, and legal budget oversight.

What We’re Looking For

    Significant post-qualification experience, ideally including time in a startup, scale-up, venture-backed company, or fast-growth technology/industrial business.
    Strong corporate, commercial, and governance experience, including fundraising, investor relations support, board matters, and commercial contracting.
    Experience building legal processes, templates, policies, and systems in a company that is scaling quickly.
    Comfortable working in a hands-on role where legal leadership includes both strategic advice and day-to-day execution.
    Strong understanding of risk management, with the ability to distinguish between theoretical legal risk and practical business risk.
    Excellent commercial judgment and the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to non-lawyers.
    Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the judgment to enable progress.

At Paebbl, the General Counsel will not simply be a legal reviewer. This person will be a strategic partner in helping the company scale responsibly, protect its interests, and make better decisions as it grows.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a global procurement transformation journey in a company that is actively contributing to the energy transition and helping build a more sustainable future. You will be responsible for driving procurement excellence across processes, governance, digitalization, capability building, ESG, and supplier management while influencing stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and business functions.

The position can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Baar or Cressier depending on preferred location.

Key responsibilities

    Standardize and continuously improve Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes and governance across the organization.
    Design and implement best-practice procurement policies, frameworks, and playbooks that can be applied across countries, legal entities, and categories.
    Develop and maintain procurement tools strategy, including solutions such as eSourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, supplier portals, and analytics platforms.
    Establish common procurement data standards, KPI frameworks, and performance reporting structures to enable global transparency and comparability.
    Drive change management and adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working across Procurement, Finance, Operations, and the wider business.
    Lead and inspire a highly diverse and international team, creating a culture of growth, collaboration, courage, and continuous improvement.

We offer

At VAROPreem, you will join a welcoming and collaborative workplace where trust, personal responsibility, and professional development are highly valued. As the energy sector undergoes its most significant transformation in decades, you will have the opportunity to contribute to both today's energy needs and tomorrow's more sustainable solutions.

We offer a high degree of autonomy and encourage employees to take initiative, challenge established ways of working, and help shape the future of our business.

About you

You are a strategic and transformational leader who thrives on challenging the status quo and translating vision into tangible business results. You combine deep procurement expertise with strong commercial acumen, a data-driven mindset, and exceptional relationship-building skills.

You are confident influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex environments, while remaining pragmatic, collaborative, and focused on bringing people along the transformation journey. With your leadership experience and ability to inspire others, you create engagement, build high-performing teams, and drive sustainable change across international organizations.

Requirements

We believe you bring:

    Extensive experience within procurement, procurement development, organizational development, transformation, or functional excellence.
    Proven success leading large-scale, multi-year transformation programs across international organizations.
    Strong Source-to-Pay (S2P) expertise with practical experience in process design, optimization, and implementation.
    Excellent change management and stakeholder engagement skills.
    Experience working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
    A commercial mindset and the ability to identify opportunities that create business value.
    Experience from energy, oil & gas, refining, chemicals, manufacturing, infrastructure or other regulated and asset- intensive industries is highly desirable.
    Experience implementing or optimizing procurement technology platforms and digital procurement solutions.
    Fluent in English
    French and Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.

Next steps

We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but no later than 28 October 2026. Applying is easy – simply submit your CV or link your LinkedIn profile and answer a few screening questions. If you choose to apply with your LinkedIn profile and progress in the process, you will be asked to provide a CV at a later stage.

To ensure an objective and fair selection process, we use assessment tests as part of our recruitment process. As we apply continuous selection, the role may be filled before the application deadline.

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact Hiring manager Camilla Dimberg, camilla.dimberg@varopreem.se or Recruitment Partner Jennie Lundqvist, jennie.lundqvist@varopreem.se.

As VAROPreem operates within critical infrastructure, a background screening as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted prior to any employment offer. During the interview process, candidates must be able to present a valid form of identification, such as a passport or national identity card, alternatively a population registration certificate together with a valid driving licence.

As parts of VAROPreem’s operations are subject to security-sensitive regulations, a security clearance, including a background check through official registers, may be required depending on the position. Any such security screening will be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Swedish Security Protection Act.

The union contact person can be found here.

Welcome with your application!

title: Software Engineer - (Media SRE)
description:
Meet the Team

The Collaboration Technology Group is redefining the future of teamwork, building services that connect people effortlessly across devices, locations and time zones.

Our team in Stockholm builds, runs, and continuously improves the core media platform services behind Cisco’s collaboration products, operating at global scale across numerous datacentres. We’re a passionate, collaborative team focused on real-time media reliability, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in our Stockholm Webex Media (WxMedia) & SRE organization, you will bring new real-time media features to life and drive resolution for high-impact media platform escalations. You will combine Site Reliability Engineering practices with real-time media streaming architectures and modern agentic AI (reusable Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM tooling) to transform how we monitor, diagnose, and auto-remediate global media services handling billions of audio and video minutes.

What You'll Do

    Media Escalations & Real-Time Reliability: Lead deep-dive troubleshooting for complex WxMedia platform issues, investigating packet loss, jitter, latency, audio/video degradation, and SIP/WebRTC signaling failures across hybrid cloud and bare-metal environments.
    Real-Time Media Delivery: Bring new real-time media features to life based on product requirements, ensuring high performance, scalability, and seamless global routing.
    Technical Design & Architecture: Design and implement high-resilience software systems for AI-assisted observability, automated incident response, and self-healing cloud media infrastructure.
    Agentic Workflows & Tooling: Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI agents, MCP tool integrations, and deterministic evaluation pipelines for automated operational decision support.
    Telemetry & Insights: Implement ingestion and correlation pipelines across distributed logs, metrics, OpenTelemetry traces, change events, and runbooks to accelerate Mean Time to Detection (MTTD) and Resolution (MTTR).
    Safe Production Automation: Develop proactive anomaly detection and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) remediation workflows with meticulous safety, security, and quality guardrails.
    Reliability & Scalability Engineering: Partner with application and infrastructure teams to define SLIs/SLOs, handle error budgets, and lead investigation post-incident reviews (PIRs).
    Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, conduct thorough code reviews, establish engineering standards, and drive operational excellence across global development and operations teams.
    Cross-Team Delivery: Manage priorities and timelines, communicate progress clearly, and work across teams to turn production needs into reliable software and AI-assisted capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

    Bachelor’s degree + 8years of related experience, Master’s + 6 years, or PhD + 3 years in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
    Consistent record as a Senior / Lead SRE or Software Engineer delivering distributed, high-availability SaaS or media platforms at scale.
    Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real-time applications (e.g., RTP/RTCP, SRTP, WebRTC, SIP, SDP, RTSP, or HLS/DASH).
    Strong proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or Java with experience designing microservices, APIs, and production automation.
    Deep experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration in large-scale multi-cluster environments.
    Experience in SRE practices: SLI/SLO design, observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces), incident management, and automated root cause analysis (RCA).

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
    Experience with close-to-real-time systems and performance-sensitive code paths.
    Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
    Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.
    Experience building LLM pipelines, AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, RAG architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
    Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ThousandEyes, or distributed tracing systems.
    Expertise in Terraform/IaC and GitOps/CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
    Experience implementing responsible AI guardrails, deterministic fallback logic, and policy-driven remediation engines.
    Experience with streaming and data platforms (Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/Vector DBs).
    Collabhiring

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Marksäkerhetsingenjör - Esrange Space Center
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular. With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

Would you like to help develop a workplace where people, technology, and space come together? At SSC Space, you will have the opportunity to contribute to something that truly makes a difference – Help Earth Benefit from Space.

We are now looking for a Ground Safety Engineer who shares our values – Customer Passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage – and wants to play an important role in our continued growth and development within space technology and launch operations.

REQUIREMENTS

Do you want a job where safety and space truly come together? As a Ground Safety Engineer in our Launch Team, you will play a key role in making our rocket and balloon launch campaigns possible.

In this position, you will work closely with the operational team and have a clear purpose: to ensure a safe and secure environment during our campaigns. Your responsibilities will span the entire process - from planning and preparation to being present during launch operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Planning, assessing risks, and preparing ground safety activities ahead of campaigns.
    Participating operationally during rocket and balloon launch campaigns.
    Maintaining and further developing the systems and equipment used during launch operations.
    Contributing to the continuous improvement of safety routines and working practices.

At SSC Space, you will receive comprehensive onboarding and training to enable you to take responsibility for ground safety during our campaigns. This is a unique opportunity to combine technology, safety, and hands-on work in an environment unlike any other in the world.

The role also involves operational work on-site during rocket and balloon campaigns, requiring flexibility in both working methods and working hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

To succeed in this role, we believe you are someone who thrives in a dynamic environment. You are flexible, solution-oriented, and comfortable quickly shifting your focus when circumstances require it. You have a strong technical interest and a safety mindset that comes naturally to you.

We would like you to have:

    A degree in Engineering or equivalent experience within a relevant technical field.
    Experience in safety-related work, risk assessments, or working in environments where safety is a key priority.
    A good understanding of safe working practices and operational procedures.
    Proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.
    The ability to work flexible hours during campaign periods.

Most importantly, we value your attitude and your willingness to contribute to a safe and successful team environment.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Convenient staff transportation between Kiruna and Esrange Space Center at a subsidized cost, making commuting easier for employees based in the Kiruna area.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

LOCATION

This is a full-time position based at Esrange Space Center outside Kiruna, where you will work at the heart of our operations. The role is primarily site-based, although remote work may be possible in exceptional circumstances. During our rocket and balloon campaigns, you will take an active part in operations, which may occasionally require work outside regular office hours or at other locations.

  

FURTHER INFORMATION

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

Please note that a background check and security interview will be conducted as part of the recruitment process prior to employment.



WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

Vi söker dig som har högskoleutbildning inom it eller annan relevant utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet i närtid som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för tjänsten.

Till den här rollen är det ett krav att du har:

    Erfarenhet av villkorsstyrd åtkomst (Conditional Access, CA) och hantering av privilegierad åtkomst (Privileged Access, PA).
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.

    Grundläggande kunskap för hur inloggning fungerar på enheter och i tjänster.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av arbete i Nexus Digital Access Component eller motsvarande system.
    Erfarenhet av arbete med automatisering och skriptning.
    Kunskap inom protokoll: SAML, OIDC, OAuth och SCIM.

Som person är du utåtriktad i yrkesmässiga sammanhang och har lätt för att skapa och underhålla goda relationer. I din roll tar du initiativ och sätter i gång aktiviteter som ger goda resultat. Du har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade omständigheter och ser möjligheter i förändringar. Vidare planerar, organiserar och prioriterar du ditt arbete effektivt samt sätter upp och håller tidsramar.

Upplysningar
