title: AIDE PIZZAIOLO
description:
AIDE PIZZAÏOLO
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

Luigia est un groupe de restaurants italiens en forte croissance : 11 restaurants en Suisse, 2 en Italie et 1 en franchise à Dubaï.

Notre identité s’inspire de la cuisine des grands-mères italiennes : respect des recettes régionales, qualité et authenticité des produits, générosité, hospitalité et un principe simple : ne rien gaspiller, tout valoriser.

Luigia est une entreprise certifiée B Corp, reconnue pour son engagement social et environnemental. Avec 3 Spicchi Gambero Rosso, une présence parmi les excellences mondiales de la restauration et une reconnaissance dans le classement 50 Top Pizza, Luigia confirme chaque jour sa qualité et sa passion pour la cuisine italienne.



LE RÔLE :
En tant qu’Aide Pizzaïolo, vous assisterez la brigade pizzeria dans les préparations quotidiennes et pendant le service, en garantissant ordre, propreté et respect des standards Luigia. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Chef Pizzaïolo afin d’assurer un rythme fluide et une qualité constante.



VOS RESPONSABILITÉS :
Connaître les ingrédients et produits utilisés en pizzeria.
Collaborer efficacement avec le Chef Pizzaïolo et la brigade.
Préparer la mise en place quotidienne du poste pizzeria.
Préparer et découper les garnitures selon les méthodes Luigia.
Assurer le garnissage des pizzas, le contrôle des sorties et le soutien pendant le service.
Participer aux étapes d’abaisse et de cuisson des pizzas selon les procédures internes.
Connaître et appliquer les standards Luigia en matière de cuisson, présentation et qualité.
Connaître et respecter les normes d’hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP).
Maintenir propres le plan de travail, les contenants, les ustensiles et la zone de production.
Garantir la propreté du poste pizzeria en fin de service.


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :
Une première expérience en pizzeria ou une forte motivation à apprendre.
Bonne dextérité, rapidité et attention aux détails.
Sérieux, fiabilité et esprit d’équipe.
Sens de l’organisation, propreté et rigueur en matière d’hygiène.
Connaissance et respect des normes HACCP.


NOUS OFFRONS :
Contrat à durée indéterminée.
5 jours de travail et 2 jours de repos par semaine.
5 semaines de congés payés par an.
Environnement de travail dynamique, international et méritocratique.
Réelles opportunités d’évolution et de développement.
Formation continue et développement professionnel.
Soutien à la relocation (démarches administratives + aide à la recherche de logement).
Expérience immersive rémunérée de 3 jours pour découvrir Luigia avant de commencer.


CULTURE ET VALEURS :
Nous valorisons la diversité et le respect mutuel. Chez Luigia, nous croyons au travail d’équipe, à la confiance et au développement des talents, en offrant un environnement inclusif où chacun peut exprimer sa personnalité et contribuer au succès collectif.



CANDIDATURE :
Luigia recherche des collaborateurs audacieux, prêts à émerveiller les clients, ravir leurs papilles et les entourer de convivialité.
Si vous souhaitez rejoindre un projet qui allie tradition italienne, qualité et esprit de famille, envoyez-nous votre CV dès maintenant !

title: Digital Marketing Manager (100%)
description:
Are you a digitally savvy marketing professional who combines strategic thinking, strong analytical capabilities, and execution excellence? Are you passionate about creating seamless digital client journeys, optimizing user experiences, leveraging data and AI, and driving measurable commercial outcomes?

Vontobel Asset Management is seeking a highly motivated Digital Marketing Manager to join the Client Content Center and help shape the future of our digital marketing capabilities.

This role reports directly to the Head of Digital Marketing & Content. The successful candidate will play a critical role in enhancing digital client experiences, optimizing digital touchpoints, and delivering measurable business impact through data-driven marketing.

The role sits at the intersection of digital marketing, client experience, analytics, content generation, and business growth. A key focus will be connecting digital marketing activities to commercial objectives, fundraising priorities, client engagement, and business outcomes through robust performance measurement and continuous optimization.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a candidate who brings:

Proven experience developing and optimizing digital client journeys across websites, campaigns, email, and other digital touchpoints.

Strong expertise in digital marketing, UX optimization, website management, conversion optimization, and client engagement.

Excellent data literacy and a deep understanding of digital marketing KPIs, analytics, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.

Demonstrated ability to turn data and client insights into actionable recommendations that drive commercial impact.

Experience establishing and managing dashboards that measure engagement, lead generation, conversion, client journeys, and business outcomes.

Strong understanding of marketing technologies, CRM platforms, automation tools, and digital analytics solutions.

Passion for Artificial Intelligence, automation, personalization, and emerging technologies.

Experience leveraging AI to improve client engagement, digital experiences, scalability, operational efficiency, and marketing effectiveness.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across marketing, distribution, investments, product management, technology, and compliance.

A growth mindset, strong curiosity, and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.

Key responsibilities



Digital client journeys & client experience

Design, manage, and continuously optimize digital client journeys across the full client lifecycle.

Enhance client engagement, conversion, and retention through personalization and journey optimization.

Ensure digital experiences support commercial priorities, fundraising objectives, and client needs.

User experience & digital platforms

Drive continuous improvements of website usability, navigation, accessibility, and conversion performance.

Conduct user research, behavioral analysis, and testing to identify optimization opportunities.

Implement best practices in UX and digital experience management across client-facing platforms.

Digital analytics & KPI leadership

Develop and maintain KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting that measure digital performance and business impact.

Monitor and optimize key digital KPIs including engagement, leads, conversions, traffic quality, and client journey effectiveness.

Generate insights and recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and contribute to commercial growth.

AI, automation & innovation

Identify and implement AI-driven solutions that enhance digital marketing performance and client experiences.

Drive the adoption of marketing automation, personalization, predictive analytics, and new digital capabilities.

Promote innovation and continuous experimentation across the digital marketing ecosystem.

Digital campaign activation

Support the execution and optimization of integrated digital campaigns across all relevant channels with relevant stakeholders

Maximize performance across website, email, social media, paid media, and marketing automation platforms.

Partner with marketing teams to increase effectiveness and reach.





Candidate Profile

University degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

5+ years of experience in digital marketing, digital experience management, performance marketing, or related fields.

Experience within asset management, financial services, banking, or another regulated industry preferred.

Strong expertise in digital analytics platforms, web analytics, CRM systems, website management, and marketing automation technologies.

Demonstrated success in developing KPI frameworks and using data to drive decision-making and optimization.

Strong understanding of digital client journeys, UX principles, customer behavior, and conversion optimization.

Experience leveraging AI-powered marketing tools and modern digital technologies.

Experience working with cross-functional teams in an international environment.



Personal profile

Highly client-centric and digitally minded.

Strong analytical thinker with exceptional data literacy skills.

Commercially focused with a clear understanding of growth drivers and business outcomes.

Passionate about AI, technology, innovation, and digital transformation.

Collaborative and influential with strong stakeholder management capabilities.

Curious, proactive, and continuously seeking opportunities to improve performance.

Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Hands-on, results-oriented, and focused on measurable impact.



Location Requirement



This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.



What do we offer?

Experienced, diverse team in an international environment

Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive



We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.



At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.



We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Directeur\-Directrice Regimo Lausanne
=====================================

Directeur/Directrice de notre succursale de Lausanne (100 %)
============================================================

**Vous avez l’esprit d’entreprise et cultivez la relation client. Vous dirigez, fédérez des équipes et apportez des solutions concrètes. Vous souhaitez faire évoluer et développer la succursale de Lausanne ? Alors, Regimo est fait pour vous.**  


### Ce que vous ferez

En tant que responsable de la succursale de Lausanne, vous êtes directement rattaché·e au CEO de Regimo. Vous portez la responsabilité opérationnelle du site, dirigez l’équipe et entretenez des relations clés avec la clientèle et les partenaires commerciaux. À ce titre, vos missions principales consistent à :

* Assurer la direction de la succursale et superviser son important portefeuille de biens immobiliers de tous types

* Garantir une gestion immobilière de qualité, au service de la clientèle

* Piloter le développement opérationnel et la performance financière de la succursale : budget, chiffre d’affaires, rentabilité et indicateurs clés de performance

* Conduire, mobiliser et faire progresser une équipe d’environ 25 collaborateurs et collaboratrices     Fidéliser les clients clés et développer les relations avec eux  
Identifier les possibilités de développement sur le marché et saisir les opportunités d’affaires  
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la direction et les autres départements de l’entreprise

### Ce que nous offrons

Une équipe engagée et une entreprise proche du terrain, où le respect guide le travail au quotidien. Un poste de direction à forte dimension entrepreneuriale, avec une large autonomie, pour donner une nouvelle impulsion à la succursale de Lausanne.

* Un dialogue direct et régulier avec le CEO de Regimo
* Des circuits de décision courts, pour décider et agir vite
* Un soutien actif à votre formation continue et à votre développement sur le long terme
* Un environnement stable, porté par des caisses de pension suisses  
Un lieu de travail attractif, à quelques pas de la gare de Lausanne


### Ce que vous apportez

Votre expérience et votre goût des responsabilités comptent, tout comme votre état d’esprit, votre personnalité et votre sens du contact.

* Une connaissance approfondie du marché immobilier suisse, notamment romand, et du cadre juridique et réglementaire applicable
* Un réseau professionnel solide en Suisse romande
* Une formation supérieure en immobilier, par exemple un brevet fédéral de gérant·e d’immeubles ou un diplôme fédéral d’administrateur/d’administratrice de biens immobiliers, ou une qualification équivalente
* Plusieurs années d’expérience dans l’immobilier, notamment dans une fonction de direction, idéalement à un poste similaire
* Une expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles immobiliers complexes
* Le sens des affaires : vous comprenez les mécanismes de gestion d’entreprise, assumez la responsabilité du budget et des résultats, et décidez avec assurance dans l’intérêt global de Regimo  
* Un style de direction clair, respectueux et mobilisateur, qui responsabilise chacun·e et renforce l’esprit d’équipe
* De l’énergie, le goût du travail en équipe et le sens du client et du service
* De solides compétences en communication et une capacité à convaincre, auprès de clients et de partenaires exigeants ainsi qu’à tous les niveaux de l’entreprise
* Une très bonne maîtrise du français et de l’allemand (impératif)  
**Prise de fonction à partir de janvier 2027 ou à convenir.**

### A propos de Regimo

Regimo est une entreprise de services immobiliers active dans toute la Suisse, avec huit sites et quelque 200 collaborateurs et collaboratrices, dont environ 25 à Lausanne. Nous faisons partie du groupe Pensimo, qui regroupe plus de 150 caisses de pension suisses mettant en commun leurs placements immobiliers. Votre travail contribue à la prévoyance vieillesse et à l’offre de logements, directement au bénéfice des assuré·es.

* **L’initiative avant tout.** Chez nous, la responsabilité n’est pas un privilège : c’est la base du travail en commun. Nous encourageons chacun·e à prendre pleinement en charge ses dossiers et ses projets.
* **Une performance qui dure.** Nous voulons que chacun·e puisse donner le meilleur sur le long terme. Nous veillons donc à l’équilibre, au respect mutuel et à des relations d’égal à égal.
* **L’équité comme fondement.** Nous rémunérons justement nos employé·es et offrons des avantages sociaux solides, dont une caisse de pension performante et une couverture d’assurance entièrement à notre charge.


Ce profil vous correspond ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature et la traiterons en toute confidentialité.

title: Technicien IT N2 – Support & Projets clients
description:
*Poste ouvert aux femmes et aux hommes.*

Qui sommes\-nous ?

Basée au cœur de Lausanne, **Handylife SA** est une entreprise suisse d’une quinzaine de personnes spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus métiers.

Depuis plus de dix ans, nous développons et commercialisons dans toute la Suisse des solutions logicielles destinées principalement aux professionnels de la santé. Nous proposons également des prestations d’informatisation complète et accompagnons nos clients dans la durée, du déploiement de nos solutions à leur évolution.

Notre offre comprend notamment un dossier patient informatisé, une plateforme de prise de rendez\-vous en ligne, une application mobile ainsi que des prestations d’informatisation complète des cabinets médicaux.

Nos solutions se distinguent par leur grande flexibilité et leurs nombreuses possibilités de configuration et de personnalisation, permettant de les adapter aux besoins et aux processus de travail de chaque client.

Pour renforcer notre équipe et accompagner son développement, nous recherchons **un technicien informatique expérimenté**, capable d’apporter ses connaissances techniques, de partager son expérience avec ses collègues et de prendre progressivement des responsabilités dans le suivi de nos clients et de leurs projets.

Vos principales missions

Le cœur de votre activité sera le **support informatique de niveau 2** et le suivi technique de nos clients.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

* Assurer le support technique N2 par téléphone, e\-mail, prise en main à distance et ponctuellement sur site.
* Analyser, diagnostiquer, documenter et résoudre les incidents de manière structurée.
* Identifier les situations nécessitant une investigation plus approfondie et les transmettre au support de niveau 3\.
* Installer, configurer et maintenir les équipements et environnements informatiques de nos clients.
* Participer au déploiement de nos solutions, de la préparation de l’installation jusqu’à leur mise en service.
* Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’utilisation de nos logiciels et de leur environnement informatique.
* Configurer et personnaliser nos logiciels selon les besoins des clients.
* Prendre en charge des projets clients de petite à moyenne taille, analyser leurs besoins et leur proposer des solutions adaptées.
* Assurer le suivi des demandes et participer à la coordination des projets avec nos équipes internes.
* Partager votre expérience avec les membres de l’équipe.


Selon vos compétences et vos centres d’intérêt, vous pourrez progressivement élargir votre activité à d’autres domaines : **gestion de projets, analyse métier, conception et amélioration de nos interfaces utilisateurs (UI/UX), démonstrations de nos solutions ou présentations auprès de clients institutionnels et grands comptes.**

Votre profil

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne **avec expérience, autonome, structurée et à l’aise avec les clients**.

* Vous disposez d’une formation en informatique (CFC ou formation jugée équivalente).
* **3 à 5 ans d’expérience en support IT**, avec une expérience significative en N2\.
* Vous possédez de solides compétences dans les environnements Windows, les réseaux ainsi que le dépannage matériel et logiciel.
* Vous savez mener un diagnostic de manière méthodique et gérer vos interventions avec autonomie.
* Vous disposez de connaissances de base en SQL.
* Vous communiquez avec aisance en français et êtes à l’aise au téléphone.

title: Admissions Lead
description:
### About Us \& Our Community

At International School Rheintal (ISR), we are proud to combine world-class educational standards with a "small and mighty" community feel. As a fully accredited International Baccalaureate (IB) World School - serving around 220 students from Kindergarten through Grade 12 in our award-winning, ecologically designed campus in Buchs SG - we deliver a globally recognised curriculum that empowers students to thrive anywhere in the world.

We believe our strengths lie in our scale: high relational trust, deep connectedness between faculty and students, and an environment where every individual is known and valued. At ISR, our team is intrinsically motivated, highly professional, and dedicated to stepping up for one another. Being a close-knit campus means we work right at the centre of the action. It also means we value flexible, solution-focused colleagues who see stepping outside a formal job description not as a chore, but as a rich, hands-on way to contribute to an outstanding international learning environment and to understand how a vibrant learning community functions.

* Workload: 50% (Adjustable to 60% for the right candidate based on administrative scope)
* Location: International School Rheintal, Werdenbergstrasse 17, 9470 Buchs, Switzerland
* Start Date: December 2026 (or by arrangement for the right candidate)
* Closing date for applications: 25.10.2026
* Preliminary interviews: 30.10.26 and 4.11.26
* Full Job Description

### About the Role \& The Day-to-Day

Choosing the right school - whether relocating from abroad or seeking an internationally focused education right here in the Rheintal - is one of the biggest decisions a family will ever make. As our Admissions Lead, you are often the very first voice and face of ISR, shaping that critical first impression with empathy, composure, and authentic warmth. We are looking for a knowledgeable, supportive guide who understands how to make a great impression, answer complex questions, find information quickly, and support families thoughtfully through their decision-making process.

Alongside admissions, you will serve as an essential operational anchor for our campus: handling day-to-day inquiries, answering phones, providing executive support to school leadership, and stepping in to organise key operational tasks to keep the school running smoothly. We will provide thorough onboarding and ongoing support as you learn our community and systems.

This role offers a base workload of 50% (approx. 21 hours per week), which could be expanded up to 60% depending on the candidate's skills and agreed administrative responsibilities.

While the contract includes statutory Swiss vacation allowance (5 weeks per year), we off er an annualised hours model. This allows you to work increased hours during active school term weeks and busy admissions windows in order to enjoy additional time off during school holiday periods (exact scheduling agreed individually with the right candidate).

### What "Doing a Great Job" Looks Like

* You serve as a memorable, welcoming ambassador for ISR - ensuring every prospective family (both local and international), guest, and visitor experiences authentic warmth, professionalism, and care from their very first interaction.
* Prospective parents feel genuinely supported, well-informed, and reassured from their first inquiry through arrival. You guide local and relocating families with authenticity, deep school knowledge, and an attentive, solution-focused attitude.
* You provide reliable, calm, and proactive executive support - managing daily phone calls, handling front-of-house inquiries, organising operational details, and keeping office routines running efficiently.
* You collect and verify necessary documentation (school reports, references, authority requirements) from international and local institutions cleanly and confidentially, enabling informed admissions decisions that serve our students, the family, and the school.
* You collaborate effectively with pedagogical staff to support new student transition into the school.
* You maintain up-to-date inquiry and enrollment data, supporting school leadership in having reliable forecasts and early visibility into incoming student numbers across all grade levels.

### What You'll Bring

* A natural ability to connect with people from both local and diverse international backgrounds - helping all prospective families feel instantly welcome, listened to, and cared for.
* High emotional intelligence, a genuinely collaborative spirit, and an appreciation for the Rheintal region; you thrive in a close-knit team where colleagues support one another, communicate openly, and share a common dedication to our school's mission.
* High organisational competence, comfort handling phone communications, and the initiative to step in and support school leadership or organise logistics when needed.
* The ability to move smoothly between high-focus administrative work (reports, data entry, executive support) and warm, face-to-face interactions when visitors or phone calls change your workflow.
* Digital confidence and a proven track record of mastering new technology platforms, with a readiness to learn our school management systems.
* Proven experience in customer-facing roles, administration, hospitality, or public relations. We value exceptional interpersonal and organisational skills above specific education sector experience, although you bring excitement about working in a school. Strong communication skills in English (our language of instruction). Our ideal candidate is also confident in at least conversational German to connect with local families and our local community.
* Valid authorisation to work in Switzerland and residence within commuting distance to Buchs SG.
* Willingness to undergo background checks for working with children.

Ready to be the welcoming heart of our school? If you bring authentic warmth, sharp organisational instincts, and a passion for helping families find their place at ISR, we would love to hear from you.

### How to Apply

Please submit your application by completing our [application form](https://www.isr.ch/userfiles/isrmvc/Documents/Jobs/ISR-Job-Application-Form-2021-V3_2-%20%281%29.doc) and uploading it on our [job portal](https://app.jobportal.abaservices.ch/job-overview/37d31658-511e-4577-ae2e-6c927f14266e).

*Data Protection Note: By submitting your application, you consent to International School Rheintal processing your personal data strictly for recruitment purposes in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDSG).*

Help our clients successfully manage global challenges

As a (Assistant) Manager in the Global Employer Services (GES) team, you will provide multi-national companies with targeted advice and strategies for running Global Mobility programs in an efficient manner. Our team supports clients with the end-to-end management of global compensation for internationally mobile employees and optimization of Tax compliance and positions. As part of the US Tax team, you will advise on US tax returns and compliance topics and do the final signoff of US tax returns before delivery.

How you can make an impact

Coordinate our global tax compliance services including liaising directly with clients and Deloitte offices worldwide.
Review and sign US individual income tax returns for US resident and nonresident taxpayers, including Forms 1040, 114, 8938, 1116, 2555, 8858, and other forms specific to US residents with activities outside the United States.
Review and sign tax reconciliations and tax equalization calculations and lead various other tasks related to the successful delivery of Global Mobility programs for our clients.
Oversee the completion of tasks and quality of the work done by junior members of the team.
Interpret and implement International Assignment Policies and ensure consistent global tax treatment of various assignment compensation items and allowances.
Advise our clients on the tax and social security implications related to various global employment issues including tax residency, avoidance of double taxation and the taxation of complex compensation such as severance payments, long term and short-term incentive income.

Who We Are Looking For

You have successfully completed your Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Accountancy, or Law.
You have 5 years+ US tax experience/knowledge and hold relevant qualification (e.g. EA, CPA, etc).
Experience in global mobility or a “Big-4” firm is a plus.
You are curious to find answers, take the initiative and are happy taking on responsibility and like to work in project teams with a systematic approach.
You communicate fluently in English. Any further languages would be an advantage.

Your Team

Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 8 across our Geneva and Zurich offices. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines.

Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact.

title: IT System Specialist
description:
ti\&m steht für technology, innovation \& management und ist der Schweizer Leader für Digitalisierungsprojekte und \-produkte für alle Branchen.

IT System Specialist

**Was dich erwartet**

Unsere interne IT ist das Rückgrat für knapp 550 Mitarbeitende an 6 Standorten. Du sorgst zusammen mit einem kleinen, eingespielten Team dafür, dass alle jederzeit produktiv arbeiten können, vom Onboarding eines neuen Laptops bis zum Betrieb unserer Server\- und Cloud\-Umgebung. Dabei bist du nahe an den Menschen: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson bei Fragen rund um die interne IT und erlebst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Gleichzeitig hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum, unsere heterogene Infrastruktur weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Themen zu verantworten. Konkret heisst das:  


* Unterstützung im täglichen Geschäft der internen IT
    +         Sicherstellung des operativen IT\-Betriebs \& Optimierung der internen Infrastruktur

    + Pflege von Tickets und Mitarbeit in den Bereichen Incident\-, Request\-, Problem\- und Change\-Management

* Pflege und Erweiterung unserer modernen, heterogenen IT\-Infrastruktur
    +         Mitarbeit in Projekten sowohl in der Konzeption wie auch bei der Implementierung

    + Übernahme der Verantwortung für definierte Produkte

    + Übernahme von Tagesdiensten und Wartungsarbeiten

**Was du mitbringst**

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatiker/in EFZ (Systemtechnik oder Plattformentwicklung) und mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Systemadministration
* Fundierte Kenntnisse im Microsoft\-Umfeld: Active Directory und Entra ID, Exchange (Online), SharePoint, Teams
* Erfahrung mit macOS (idealerweise Jamf als MDM) und Linux
* Praxis mit Servervirtualisierung, unabhängig vom Hersteller ( VMware vSphere, Proxmox)
* Solide Netzwerkgrundlagen: TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, Firewalling sowie DNS und DHCP
* Erfahrung mit Atlassian Jira und Confluence oder vergleichbaren ITSM\- und Dokumentationstools
* Grundverständnis von Containerisierung, mit Docker oder Kubernetes


**Das zeichnet dich aus**

* Du arbeitest selbständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist dienstleistungsorientiert und magst den direkten Kontakt mit Mitarbeitenden
* Du bist dienstleistungsorientiert und schätzt den direkten Kontakt mit Mitarbeitenden
* Du bist ein Teamplayer und hast Freude daran, Neues zu lernen und dich weiterzuentwickeln


**Du punktest zusätzlich mit**

* Berufsbildner\-Ausbildung oder Interesse, unsere Lernenden ICT\-Plattformentwicklung mitzubegleiten
* Know\-How in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche:
    +         Erfahrung in IT\-Security ( Endpoint Protection, Identity Access Management, Patch\- und Vulnerability\-Management)

    + Azure Cloud Services

    + Container\-Plattformen

    + Veeam Backup \& Replication

**Wir suchen dich – werde Teil unseres Teams**

Für die Unterstützung in unserer internen IT suchen wir einen IT System Specialist mit breitem Wissen in den Themen Support, Clients, Windows, Mac und Linux Plattformen. Die Tätigkeiten setzen ein Informatik EFZ, nachgewiesene Berufserfahrung, stilsicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift, Flexibilität, Einsatzbereitschaft und Freude am Kontakt mit unseren Mitarbeitenden voraus.

**Warum wir**

Swiss Arbeitgeber Award, Best of Swiss Apps oder Digital Economy Award. Unsere Arbeitsplatzkultur und unsere Projekte gewinnen Preise. Für unsere Kunden aus Banking, Retail oder Governance entwickeln wir nutzerzentrierte Digitalisierungslösungen. Abseits von vorgegebenen Pfaden kannst du bei uns Neues ausprobieren und dich so richtig austoben. Hier findest du alles, was dein Techie\-Herz begehrt: In einem dynamischen und kollegialen Umfeld treibst du deine innovativen Ideen voran – natürlich immer mithilfe der neuesten Technologien. Apropos Arbeitsplatzkultur: Agilität fordern wir nicht nur bei unseren Projekten, sondern fördern sie auch für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Mit ti\&m liquid working bieten wir einfach anpassbare Arbeitszeitmodelle und die Möglichkeit, Auszeiten zu nehmen. Und mit unserer ti\&m academy entscheidest du, wo und wie du dich weiterbilden willst.

title: Deputy Program Manager - Cell 4
description:
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.

We are looking for an experienced Deputy Program Manager (ARP) to join Cell 4.
Reporting to the Program Manager, the Deputy Program Manager plays a key role in steering MSF’s operations within Cell 4, contributing to operational decision-making and ensuring the relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance. The role supports operational planning, resource mobilisation, programme monitoring, security and advocacy, while supervising and supporting Heads of Mission. As a central operational role within MSF, the Deputy Program Manager acts as a key interface between missions and headquarters, ensuring effective information flow, coherent HQ support and a shared understanding of operational priorities across OCG. The role also contributes to the internal visibility of programmes and to critical reflection on operational challenges and MSF’s social mission.

Tasks & Responsibilities
By delegation of responsibilities and tasks from the Program Manager:
In accordance with the Charter, the Chantilly / La Mancha agreements and OCG operational policy, the Deputy Program Manager ensures the overall relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance to populations in danger within a selected group of countries.
Is responsible for steering the operations planning cycle, ensuring that transversal internal processes are respected, that MSF policies are translated into action unless otherwise justified, and that resources are adequately mobilized to support operational objectives and the chosen intervention strategies.
Ensures that key medical and/or humanitarian stakes are identified within each mission and project, prioritizes them, and carries them internally and externally through bilateral meetings, documentation, témoignage and communication; determines how MSF will address the issues at stake and defines its public position.
Creates and maintains a network of relevant political, humanitarian, medical and academic contacts to ensure the best possible knowledge of the environment for teams working in the field, especially in tense contexts.
Monitors the level of exposure to risk affecting teams in the field and validates the security framework proposed by the Heads of Mission for each project.
Supervises, advises, supports and evaluates the Heads of Mission in the fulfilment of their overall responsibilities and duties; in this perspective, provides them with all relevant information and visits missions at key moments (exploratory missions, programme definition phases and/or reorientations due to evolving needs, context or policy).
Organizes the best possible level of headquarters support to field operations by optimizing the input, expertise and control functions of professionals from different departments, each representing a technical field necessary for the effective running of projects in the field.
Monitors programme implementation and the effective running of missions by analysing situation and programme reports submitted by the coordination and providing feedback; is accountable for timely reporting on operations, including institutional donors supporting MSF’s action in the field.
Aims to continuously improve MSF’s medical assistance by evaluating results achieved, leading thematic working groups on intervention strategies, initiating critical reviews as needed, supporting operational research projects, and contributing to the design and delivery of training modules for coordinators.

Your profile
Education
University-level degree in international relations, social sciences, medicine, public health, a paramedical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience
Experience in humanitarian aid, ideally as an MSF Head of Mission or Emergency Coordinator. Previous experience as a Medical Coordinator is an asset.
Expertise in analysing and managing unstable contexts and crisis situations.
Experience in, and interest in, the medical, social, economic and political dimensions of countries affected by humanitarian crises, whether acute or protracted, or undergoing development, is an asset.

Languages
Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
Knowledge of a third language is an asset.

Skills/ professional competencies
Strong representation and diplomatic skills, with proven negotiation abilities.
Strong strategic planning and orientation skills.
Ability to analyse humanitarian contexts, with a sound understanding of medical issues and MSF intervention strategies.
Ability to design and plan medical programmes, build and maintain networks, motivate and lead teams, organise responsibilities and delegate tasks effectively.
Excellent writing skills.

Personal Abilities/Qualities
Dynamic and flexible, with strong initiative and decision-making skills.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with a clear sense of priorities.
Highly developed stress-management skills.
Strong communication and public-speaking skills.
Participative management style.

Terms of employment :
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
3 years contract, renewable once.
Working place: Based in Geneva, with very frequent international travel.
Ideal start date: 1st of December 2026
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

CV (maximum 2 pages)

Documents must be submitted in either English or French.

The application deadline is  31 of october 2026

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Logisticien / logisticienne
===========================

**Pour que nos équipes puissent avancer, nous avons besoin de vous !**

De la préparation du matériel à la gestion des dépôts, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans le bon déroulement de nos chantiers. Vous aimez être utile, prendre des initiatives et voir concrétement le résultat de votre travail ? Cette opportunité est faite pour vous !



Entreprise familiale fondée en 1985, nous sommes l’un des plus grands groupes de peinture, plâtrerie et isolation de Suisse romande avec plus de 160 collaborateurs et 5 entreprises.

Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) **Logisticien / Logisticienne** pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique chez Peinture Renens SA.

Véritable **maillon essentiel entre nos dépôts, nos chantiers, nos collaborateurs et nos fournisseurs**, vous assurez la bonne gestion de nos stocks et de notre matériel.

Au quotidien, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

* Gérer et approvisionner les dépôts de peinture et de plâtrerie
* Préparer le matériel et les commandes nécessaires aux collaborateurs
* Effectuer les livraisons et les débarras sur les différents chantiers
* Réceptionner les marchandises et organiser leur rangement
* Gérer les retours de matériel et de marchandises
* Veiller à l’ordre, à l’entretien et à l’optimisation des espaces de stockage
* Assurer la gestion et le suivi des machines et de leur état
* Contrôler, nettoyer et faire réparer le matériel si nécessaire
* Assurer le suivi de la flotte de véhicules et gérer les services et problèmes courants
* Organiser l’élimination des déchets
* Participer aux inventaires et assurer un suivi régulier des stocks
* Contribuer à améliorer nos méthodes et nos procédures afin de faciliter le travail de tous


**Ce que nous recherchons**

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne **fiable, organisée et débrouillarde**, qui aime prendre des initiatives et trouver des solutions.

Vous êtes :

* autonome et capable de gérer vos priorités
* organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et à l’aise avec la planification
* flexible et résistant(e) au stress
* doté(e) d’un bon sens pratique et d’un esprit d’initiative
* à l’aise dans les contacts avec les collaborateurs, fournisseurs et partenaires
* discret(ète), respectueux(se) et doté(e) d’un bon esprit d’équipe
* à l’aise avec les responsabilités et le travail en toute autonomie.


**Votre profil**

* CFC, formation ou brevet fédéral dans le domaine de la logistique ou formation jugée équivalente
* Permis de conduire indispensable
* Expérience confirmée dans le domaine de la plâtrerie\-peinture, un réel atout
* Bonne maîtrise des techniques liées au métier
* çais parfaitement maîtrisé, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
* Les autres langues sont les bienvenues
* Une bonne présentation et de bonnes manières complètent votre profil


**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Parce que ce poste n'est pas uniquement un poste de magasinier !

Vous serez **un véritable acteur du bon fonctionnement de notre entreprise**, avec un rôle transversal et varié. Votre organisation, votre réactivité et votre sens pratique auront un impact direct sur le travail de nos équipes.

Vous aimez que les choses soient bien faites, que le matériel soit au bon endroit et que les équipes puissent compter sur vous ?

Alors nous avons certainement envie de faire votre connaissance !

Fachspezialist:in Gesundheitsmanagement
=======================================







  
Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung  




Fachspezialist:in Gesundheitsmanagement 50%
===========================================



Mit rund 1'400 Mitarbeitenden ist Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung (JuWe) für den Straf\- und Massnahmenvollzug sowie für die Durchführung verschiedener Haftarten verantwortlich. Unsere Mitarbeitenden aus rund 40 Berufen unterstützen und fördern die Wiedereingliederung straffällig gewordener Menschen und setzen sich wirksam und fortschrittlich für eine sichere und gerechte Gesellschaft ein.  

Der Fachbereich Human Resources gehört zur Amtsleitung. Die rund 25 Mitarbeitenden gestalten und verantworten sämtliche Aufgaben des Personalmanagements – von der Gewinnung, Beratung, und Entwicklung der JuWe Mitarbeitenden über personalrechtliche und administrative Dienstleistungen bis hin zu HR\-Controlling und strategischer Personalsteuerung.  

Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die das Thema Gesundheit ganzheitlich denkt, strategisch weiterentwickelt und nachhaltig in unserer Organisation verankert. Wenn Du Lust hast, nicht nur bestehende Prozesse zu betreuen, sondern den Bereich Gesundheit aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam mit HR und Führung weiterzuentwickeln, dann freuen wir uns, Dich kennenzulernen.





### Was auf Dich wartet



* Gemeinsam mit der Leitung HR\-Beratung konzipierst und entwickelst Du unsere Gesundheitsthemen sowie die dazugehörigen Prozesse weiter. Dabei behältst Du sowohl die Bedürfnisse der Organisation als auch die gesetzlichen und kantonalen Rahmenbedingungen im Blick  
* Du kannst bei uns Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung und Verankerung des Bereichs Gesundheit übernehmen: vom Anwesenheitsmanagement über das Gesundheitscontrolling und die Prävention bis hin zur Umsetzung konkreter Massnahmen  
* Du erkennst relevante Gesundheitskennzahlen, kannst diese systematisch analysieren und auswerten, daraus Handlungsfelder identifizieren und fundierte strategische Massnahmen ableiten. Die daraus entstehenden Projekte begleitest und leitest Du von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung  
* Du unterstützt dabei, Gesundheitsthemen wirkungsvoll in bestehende HR\- und Führungsprozesse zu integrieren, verantwortest den Gesundheitsprozess und berätst deine Kolleg:innen innerhalb der HR\-Beratung sowie weitere relevante Schnittstellen in fachlichen Fragestellungen  
* Du entwickelst zudem Sensibilisierungs\-, Informations\- und Schulungsangebote für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte  





### Was Du mitbringst



* Du verfügst über einen Bachelorabschluss. Eine zusätzliche Weiterbildung, beispielsweise einen CAS in Betrieblicher Gesundheitsförderung, Betrieblichem Gesundheitsmanagement (BGM), Sozialversicherungen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich, ist von Vorteil.  
* Du verfügst über fundiertes Fachwissen und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Gesundheit und/oder Absenzenmanagement und verstehst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge strukturiert zu analysieren und daraus umsetzbare Lösungen abzuleiten  
* Erfahrung in einem Umfeld mit Schichtbetrieb und unterschiedlichen Mitarbeitendengruppen ist für uns ein grosses Plus  
* Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, bildest dir eine fundierte Meinung und kannst diese situationsgerecht und überzeugend vertreten. Gleichzeitig baust du tragfähige Beziehungen auf und verstehst dich als interne:r Dienstleister:in und Sparringspartner:in für HR und Führung

* Berechnungen \& Simulation: Auslegung von Antriebs\- und Bewegungskomponenten (Aktoren, Motoren, Pneumatik) sowie Durchführung von FEA\- und Kinematik\-Simulationen zur Optimierung von Taktzeiten, Lastgrenzen und dynamischem Systemverhalten.

=======================================================

Description du client
---------------------

Vous êtes **physiothérapeute** et vous recherchez un **poste fixe à 80\-100%** sur le **Canton de Neuchâtel** ?

Notre client, un cabinet recherche un profil de:

PHYSIOTHERAPEUTE en Fixe à 80\-100%
------------------------------------

### Prise de poste à convenir !!!

Description du poste
--------------------

Nous recherchons, pour le compte de notre client, un(e) physiothérapeute souhaitant s'investir durablement au sein d'un cabinet reconnu du canton de Neuchâtel, dans le cadre d'un poste fixe à 80\-100%.  

Vous intégrerez une structure à taille humaine, composée de 3 physiothérapeutes et d'une secrétaire, offrant un environnement de travail moderne, organisé et stimulant, en plein centre\-ville et facilement accessible.  

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous assurerez une prise en charge complète et personnalisée de votre patientèle, en développant des traitements adaptés aux besoins cliniques et aux objectifs de rééducation de chaque patient. Vous interviendrez auprès d'une patientèle variée, notamment dans les domaines suivants : post\-opératoire, physiothérapie du dos, neurologie, uro\-gynécologie, drainage lymphatique et rééducation fonctionnelle.  

Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :  
\- L'évaluation initiale des patients, la collecte des informations cliniques et l'élaboration de bilans précis afin de définir des objectifs de traitement cohérents et réalistes.  
\- La mise en place et l'adaptation des séances de physiothérapie en fonction de l'évolution de l'état de santé, des prescriptions médicales et des besoins spécifiques de chaque patient.  
\- La réalisation de soins en cabinet dans des salles de traitement fermées, au sein d'un plateau technique de plus de 400 m2 équipé de matériel moderne et de dernière génération.  
\- La participation aux prises en charge en fitness médicalisé, avec suivi des exercices, correction des gestes et progression du programme de rééducation.  
\- La prise en charge de patients à domicile lorsque la situation le nécessite, dans le respect des protocoles de soin et avec une excellente capacité d'autonomie sur le terrain.  
\- La traçabilité des soins, la tenue rigoureuse des dossiers patients et la transmission des informations utiles à l'équipe et, si nécessaire, aux partenaires médicaux.  
\- La contribution active au bon fonctionnement du centre, en collaborant étroitement avec vos collègues et la secrétaire afin d'assurer une organisation fluide des rendez\-vous et des suivis.  
\- Le maintien d'un haut niveau de qualité dans la relation thérapeutique, avec une attention constante portée à l'écoute, à la confidentialité et à l'expérience patient.  
\- La participation aux échanges d'équipe, au partage d'expérience et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques du cabinet.  
\- L'investissement dans votre développement professionnel grâce à l'ouverture aux formations continues proposées par la structure.  

Le poste offre un cadre de travail agréable, une flexibilité dans l'organisation du temps de travail ainsi qu'un environnement propice à l'exercice d'une physiothérapie de qualité, centrée sur le patient et la collaboration interprofessionnelle.

Profil recherché
-----------------

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en physiothérapie ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu obligatoirement par la Croix\-Rouge suisse.  

Vous disposez d'une expérience dans la prise en charge physiothérapeutique et maîtrisez les techniques liées aux spécialités du poste, notamment la rééducation post\-opératoire, les pathologies du rachis, les prises en charge neurologiques, l'uro\-gynécologie, le drainage lymphatique et la réadaptation fonctionnelle. Une bonne maîtrise des protocoles de traitement, de l'évaluation clinique et de l'adaptation thérapeutique est indispensable.  

Au\-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous vous distinguez par les qualités suivantes :  
\- Un réel sens des responsabilités et une grande rigueur dans l'exécution de vos traitements et dans le suivi administratif de vos patients.  
\- Une excellente autonomie, vous permettant de gérer efficacement vos consultations, vos priorités et vos éventuelles interventions à domicile.  
\- Une forte capacité d'organisation et d'adaptation, essentielle dans un environnement dynamique et auprès d'une patientèle variée.  
\- Une attitude motivée, impliquée et orientée qualité, avec le souci constant d'offrir une prise en charge professionnelle et bienveillante.  
\- De bonnes aptitudes relationnelles, un sens de l'écoute développé et une communication claire et rassurante avec les patients comme avec l'équipe.  
\- Une approche flexible du travail, ainsi qu'une capacité à collaborer harmonieusement dans un cadre pluridisciplinaire.  
\- Une posture discrète, empathique et respectueuse, en phase avec les exigences d'un accompagnement thérapeutique de confiance.  

Votre intérêt pour la formation continue, votre professionnalisme et votre engagement dans la qualité des soins seront des atouts essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction.

Manager, Accounting \& Finance
==============================

An established international service\-based organization is seeking an experienced **Manager, Accounting \& Finance** to lead the finance operations of its European regional business. The organization operates globally, bringing together professionals, industry leaders, regulators, and stakeholders to advance innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional excellence in highly regulated sectors.

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic and hands\-on finance leader to serve as a key member of the regional leadership team while partnering closely with global finance and European regional operations. The successful candidate will oversee all accounting, treasury, financial planning, and financial analysis activities across the European region and play an integral role in supporting organizational growth and operational excellence.

Only candidates currently residing within commuting distance of Basel, Switzerland will be considered for this role.

**Position Summary**

Supporting regional and global leadership, the **Manager, Accounting \& Finance** will be responsible for the financial stewardship of the European region. This role combines strategic financial planning with operational accounting leadership and requires a strong understanding of cross\-border business operations, international accounting standards, treasury management, and regulatory \& tax compliance.

The successful candidate will provide financial insight, business partnership, and operational leadership to support both regional and global objectives.



**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Leadership \& Business Partnership**

* Serve as the primary finance partner to regional leadership.
* Provide recommendations regarding financial performance, risk management, and long\-term business sustainability.
* Support regional strategy development through financial modeling, business case analysis, and evaluation of new opportunities.
* Participate actively as a member of the European regional leadership team.


**Accounting \& Financial Operations**

* Lead and manage all regional accounting activities, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements and internal policies.
* Oversee general ledger activities, month\-end and year\-end close processes, and financial reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation of management reports and financial analyses.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to maintain consistency in accounting and reporting practices.


**Treasury, Accounts Receivable \& Accounts Payable**

* Manage banking relationships and regional cash management activities.
* Oversee accounts receivable and accounts payable functions.
* Monitor cash flow and working capital requirements.
* Support treasury planning and financial risk management activities across the region.


**Budgeting, Forecasting \& Financial Analysis**

* Lead the annual budgeting process and ongoing forecasting activities.
* Develop monthly financial forecasts and cash flow projections.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and develop corrective action plans in collaboration with regional leaders.
* Prepare ad\-hoc and insightful profitability, cost\-benefit, and break\-even analyses to support strategic decision\-making.


**Compliance, Audit \& Risk Management**

* Maintain compliance with relevant accounting, tax, VAT, and regulatory requirements throughout as it pertains to the organization’s operations.
* Monitor changes in financial and tax legislation and implement necessary process updates.
* Support annual external audits and coordinate with auditors as required.
* Review contracts alongside local leadership and external legal advisors to minimize risk exposure and ensure compliance.


**People \& Vendor Management**

* Oversee payroll and benefits administration.
* Manage relationships with external legal counsel, tax advisors, banking institutions, and other statutory authorities.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and oversight to two (2\) finance staff and internal operational team members as applicable.


**Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting capabilities, controls, and operational efficiencies.
* Participate in global initiatives to enhance financial systems, planning processes, and reporting tools.
* Drive continuous improvement across finance operations.


**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualification and/or prior auditing experience are highly 10 years of progressive finance and accounting experience.
* At least 5 years in an Accounting Manager or equivalent leadership role.
* Minimum 3 years of supervisory experience.
* Extensive experience overseeing: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Bank Accounts, Financial Reporting, and Budgeting and Forecasting.
* Experience working within a service\-based organization.
* Previous experience working for a subsidiary of an international parent organization.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating cross\-border financial transactions and business activities.


**Technical Expertise**

The ideal candidate will possess:

* Strong knowledge of European accounting standards and financial reporting requirements.
* Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and auditing standards.
* Understanding of Swiss and EU tax regulations, VAT requirements, and fiscal policies.
* Advanced proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial databases.
* Strong analytical, planning, and financial modeling skills.
* Experience with multinational financial operations and currency management.


**Language Requirements**

Fluency in    required with a strong professional proficiency in **English** required as well.

**Personal Characteristics**

We are seeking a professional who demonstrates:

* Strategic thinking and sound business judgment.
* Strong leadership and collaboration attention to detail and accuracy.

title: Admissions Lead
description:
### About Us \& Our Community

At International School Rheintal (ISR), we are proud to combine world-class educational standards with a "small and mighty" community feel. As a fully accredited International Baccalaureate (IB) World School - serving around 220 students from Kindergarten through Grade 12 in our award-winning, ecologically designed campus in Buchs SG - we deliver a globally recognised curriculum that empowers students to thrive anywhere in the world.

We believe our strengths lie in our scale: high relational trust, deep connectedness between faculty and students, and an environment where every individual is known and valued. At ISR, our team is intrinsically motivated, highly professional, and dedicated to stepping up for one another. Being a close-knit campus means we work right at the centre of the action. It also means we value flexible, solution-focused colleagues who see stepping outside a formal job description not as a chore, but as a rich, hands-on way to contribute to an outstanding international learning environment and to understand how a vibrant learning community functions.

* Workload: 50% (Adjustable to 60% for the right candidate based on administrative scope)
* Location: International School Rheintal, Werdenbergstrasse 17, 9470 Buchs, Switzerland
* Start Date: December 2026 (or by arrangement for the right candidate)
* Closing date for applications: 25.10.2026
* Preliminary interviews: 30.10.26 and 4.11.26
* Full Job Description

### About the Role \& The Day-to-Day

Choosing the right school - whether relocating from abroad or seeking an internationally focused education right here in the Rheintal - is one of the biggest decisions a family will ever make. As our Admissions Lead, you are often the very first voice and face of ISR, shaping that critical first impression with empathy, composure, and authentic warmth. We are looking for a knowledgeable, supportive guide who understands how to make a great impression, answer complex questions, find information quickly, and support families thoughtfully through their decision-making process.

Alongside admissions, you will serve as an essential operational anchor for our campus: handling day-to-day inquiries, answering phones, providing executive support to school leadership, and stepping in to organise key operational tasks to keep the school running smoothly. We will provide thorough onboarding and ongoing support as you learn our community and systems.

This role offers a base workload of 50% (approx. 21 hours per week), which could be expanded up to 60% depending on the candidate's skills and agreed administrative responsibilities.

While the contract includes statutory Swiss vacation allowance (5 weeks per year), we off er an annualised hours model. This allows you to work increased hours during active school term weeks and busy admissions windows in order to enjoy additional time off during school holiday periods (exact scheduling agreed individually with the right candidate).

### What "Doing a Great Job" Looks Like

* You serve as a memorable, welcoming ambassador for ISR - ensuring every prospective family (both local and international), guest, and visitor experiences authentic warmth, professionalism, and care from their very first interaction.
* Prospective parents feel genuinely supported, well-informed, and reassured from their first inquiry through arrival. You guide local and relocating families with authenticity, deep school knowledge, and an attentive, solution-focused attitude.
* You provide reliable, calm, and proactive executive support - managing daily phone calls, handling front-of-house inquiries, organising operational details, and keeping office routines running efficiently.
* You collect and verify necessary documentation (school reports, references, authority requirements) from international and local institutions cleanly and confidentially, enabling informed admissions decisions that serve our students, the family, and the school.
* You collaborate effectively with pedagogical staff to support new student transition into the school.
* You maintain up-to-date inquiry and enrollment data, supporting school leadership in having reliable forecasts and early visibility into incoming student numbers across all grade levels.

### What You'll Bring

* A natural ability to connect with people from both local and diverse international backgrounds - helping all prospective families feel instantly welcome, listened to, and cared for.
* High emotional intelligence, a genuinely collaborative spirit, and an appreciation for the Rheintal region; you thrive in a close-knit team where colleagues support one another, communicate openly, and share a common dedication to our school's mission.
* High organisational competence, comfort handling phone communications, and the initiative to step in and support school leadership or organise logistics when needed.
* The ability to move smoothly between high-focus administrative work (reports, data entry, executive support) and warm, face-to-face interactions when visitors or phone calls change your workflow.
* Digital confidence and a proven track record of mastering new technology platforms, with a readiness to learn our school management systems.
* Proven experience in customer-facing roles, administration, hospitality, or public relations. We value exceptional interpersonal and organisational skills above specific education sector experience, although you bring excitement about working in a school. Strong communication skills in English (our language of instruction). Our ideal candidate is also confident in at least conversational German to connect with local families and our local community.
* Valid authorisation to work in Switzerland and residence within commuting distance to Buchs SG.
* Willingness to undergo background checks for working with children.

Ready to be the welcoming heart of our school? If you bring authentic warmth, sharp organisational instincts, and a passion for helping families find their place at ISR, we would love to hear from you.

### How to Apply

Please submit your application by completing our [application form](https://www.isr.ch/userfiles/isrmvc/Documents/Jobs/ISR-Job-Application-Form-2021-V3_2-%20%281%29.doc) and uploading it on our [job portal](https://app.jobportal.abaservices.ch/job-overview/37d31658-511e-4577-ae2e-6c927f14266e).

*Data Protection Note: By submitting your application, you consent to International School Rheintal processing your personal data strictly for recruitment purposes in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDSG).*

title: Deputy Program Manager - Cell 4
description:
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.

We are looking for an experienced Deputy Program Manager (ARP) to join Cell 4.
Reporting to the Program Manager, the Deputy Program Manager plays a key role in steering MSF’s operations within Cell 4, contributing to operational decision-making and ensuring the relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance. The role supports operational planning, resource mobilisation, programme monitoring, security and advocacy, while supervising and supporting Heads of Mission. As a central operational role within MSF, the Deputy Program Manager acts as a key interface between missions and headquarters, ensuring effective information flow, coherent HQ support and a shared understanding of operational priorities across OCG. The role also contributes to the internal visibility of programmes and to critical reflection on operational challenges and MSF’s social mission.

Tasks & Responsibilities
By delegation of responsibilities and tasks from the Program Manager:
In accordance with the Charter, the Chantilly / La Mancha agreements and OCG operational policy, the Deputy Program Manager ensures the overall relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance to populations in danger within a selected group of countries.
Is responsible for steering the operations planning cycle, ensuring that transversal internal processes are respected, that MSF policies are translated into action unless otherwise justified, and that resources are adequately mobilized to support operational objectives and the chosen intervention strategies.
Ensures that key medical and/or humanitarian stakes are identified within each mission and project, prioritizes them, and carries them internally and externally through bilateral meetings, documentation, témoignage and communication; determines how MSF will address the issues at stake and defines its public position.
Creates and maintains a network of relevant political, humanitarian, medical and academic contacts to ensure the best possible knowledge of the environment for teams working in the field, especially in tense contexts.
Monitors the level of exposure to risk affecting teams in the field and validates the security framework proposed by the Heads of Mission for each project.
Supervises, advises, supports and evaluates the Heads of Mission in the fulfilment of their overall responsibilities and duties; in this perspective, provides them with all relevant information and visits missions at key moments (exploratory missions, programme definition phases and/or reorientations due to evolving needs, context or policy).
Organizes the best possible level of headquarters support to field operations by optimizing the input, expertise and control functions of professionals from different departments, each representing a technical field necessary for the effective running of projects in the field.
Monitors programme implementation and the effective running of missions by analysing situation and programme reports submitted by the coordination and providing feedback; is accountable for timely reporting on operations, including institutional donors supporting MSF’s action in the field.
Aims to continuously improve MSF’s medical assistance by evaluating results achieved, leading thematic working groups on intervention strategies, initiating critical reviews as needed, supporting operational research projects, and contributing to the design and delivery of training modules for coordinators.

Your profile
Education
University-level degree in international relations, social sciences, medicine, public health, a paramedical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience
Experience in humanitarian aid, ideally as an MSF Head of Mission or Emergency Coordinator. Previous experience as a Medical Coordinator is an asset.
Expertise in analysing and managing unstable contexts and crisis situations.
Experience in, and interest in, the medical, social, economic and political dimensions of countries affected by humanitarian crises, whether acute or protracted, or undergoing development, is an asset.

Languages
Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
Knowledge of a third language is an asset.

Skills/ professional competencies
Strong representation and diplomatic skills, with proven negotiation abilities.
Strong strategic planning and orientation skills.
Ability to analyse humanitarian contexts, with a sound understanding of medical issues and MSF intervention strategies.
Ability to design and plan medical programmes, build and maintain networks, motivate and lead teams, organise responsibilities and delegate tasks effectively.
Excellent writing skills.

Personal Abilities/Qualities
Dynamic and flexible, with strong initiative and decision-making skills.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with a clear sense of priorities.
Highly developed stress-management skills.
Strong communication and public-speaking skills.
Participative management style.

Terms of employment :
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
3 years contract, renewable once.
Working place: Based in Geneva, with very frequent international travel.
Ideal start date: 1st of December 2026
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
CV (maximum 2 pages)
Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
Documents must be submitted in either English or French.

The application deadline is  31 of october 2026

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

Join Deloitte Switzerland’s SAP Security and Authorization Team

Secure the digital core of enterprises through SAP security and authorization management

About the Role

Are you passionate about translating complex SAP security challenges into elegant, resilient solutions that safeguard critical business systems? At Deloitte Switzerland, within our SAP Security team in Technology & Transformation, you will play a pivotal role in helping organisations strengthen their SAP security posture and authorization controls. Your expertise will empower clients to manage complex security challenges in an increasingly digital and regulated environment, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and resilience.

Day-to-day, you will lead SAP security and authorization transformation initiatives, design robust security frameworks, and provide expert guidance on managing access controls and security risks within SAP environments, notably SAP S/4HANA implementations.

How you can make an impact

Manage the delivery of projects, actively engaging with clients and overlooking quality and performance of teams.
Drive growth by expanding our SAP Security offering and on-boarding high-value clients.
Lead strategic initiatives to help clients assess SAP security risks, define resilient security controls and frameworks, and establish good-practice security processes with long-term compliance roadmaps.
Design comprehensive SAP security baselines and authorization concepts, including roles and Segregation of Duties rulesets for various SAP systems, such as SAP ECC and S/4HANA.
Conduct comprehensive SAP security assessments and implement SAP cyber security controls aligned with industry frameworks (e.g. NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).
Implement solutions (e.g. SAP GRC, SAP Ariba, etc.) that optimize processes and deliver innovative solutions to complex SAP security challenges at our clients.
Work with best-in-class AI solutions to deliver value to clients.
Contribute to the further improvements of innovative AI and automation tools and assets that drive the future of SAP security and authorization transformation.
Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to support go-to-market strategies and develop cutting-edge SAP security offerings.

You are proactive, adaptable, keen to grow and have strong interpersonal and communication skills, focused on building outstanding relationships with clients.
You are able to manage end-to-end sales processes / “RFP” related dynamics for medium/high complexity clients. Experience in a leading Consulting firm will be considered a plus.
Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in SAP Security and Authorizations, including authorization frameworks, role concept and design (attribute-based (ABAC) and role-based access controls (RBAC)), Segregation of Duties, and GRC technologies. Hands-on experience with SAP security solutions beyond SAP GRC is a plus.
Proven expertise in implementing SAP S/4HANA, including business process mapping, technical configuration of authorizations, and Fiori.
You have proven experience in Cyber Security Frameworks and Application Security, with hands-on expertise in managing SAP System Security (e.g. patch and vulnerability management, system parameters, connectivity, technical users, secure code etc). Experience with SAP Security Software and Tools is a plus.
Fluent in English, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders. Additional languages, such as German or French, is a plus.

Relevant certifications : CISM, SAP Certifications, CISSP, CISA
Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) security, including identity and access management (IAM), API security, secure integration patterns, and cloud-native security controls. Knowledge of SAP BTP security best practices and threat modelling is a plus.
You understand the operating models to be put into place for efficient day-to-day SAP security processes. Experience with near- and off-shore models is a plus.
Demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence (AI), such as leveraging AI tools or solutions within risk, security, or SAP-related contexts (e.g., AI-driven access control analysis, intelligent risk assessment, automation of security controls).
Coaching, team management and problem resolution skills are part of your strengths.

Einführung

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten





* In dieser führst und entwickelst du ein engagiertes Support\-Team von etwa zehn Mitarbeitenden (inkl. Lernenden und Werkstudenten), stärkst eine serviceorientierte, kollegiale Teamkultur und sorgst gemeinsam mit deinem Team dafür, dass der 1st\- und 2nd\-Level\-Support professionell gewährleistet wird.

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

* Du bist serviceorientiert, strukturiert und kommunikativ \- und bewahrst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen .
* Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, gelegentlich zu reisen.

Bei uns kannst du global Wirkung erzielen und gleichzeitig nah an den Menschen und am operativen Geschäft bleiben. Du arbeitest mit einem Team, das gemeinsam etwas bewegen, Verantwortung übernehmen und sich weiterentwickeln möchte. Dabei verbindest du Führung mit strategischem Denken und einer ausgeprägten Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft \- mit viel Raum, das IT Service Management aktiv zu gestalten.

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs\-, Lüftungs\- und Klimaanlagen. CDI \- Store Manager Zürich (W/M)
==================================

GENERAL MISSION

As part of Hermès Switzerland and Central Europe's strategy, you will manage and develop your store by:

\- Leading a team to offer our customers personalized and exceptional service

\- Developing and retaining a local and international customer base

\- Optimizing operations management in accordance with internal procedures

You will work closely with the subsidiary's support functions and act in an exemplary manner, putting the customer at the heart of your concerns.

You will generously share the spirit of Hermès with every employee and every visitor to the store.

MAIN ACTIVITIES

LEADING THE TEAM

o You lead, manage, and motivate the store team to achieve set objectives and provide excellent service to all customers and visitors

o You share relevant information and analysis with the team to communicate your vision for the business and help everyone understand the store's challenges

o You foster team spirit

o You set quantitative and qualitative objectives and evaluate results.

o You supervise and coach your employees.

o In close collaboration with the Human Resources Department, you recruit team members, organize their integration, and oversee and implement the necessary actions for their training and development. You conduct performance reviews when necessary.

DEVELOP SALES AND SERVICE

o You ensure a regular presence on the sales floor to support the team, set an example, and orchestrate in\-store activity

o With the support of the Customer Experience department, you supervise the quality of information in the customer database and determine targeted clienteling actions

o You keep abreast of trends, benchmark the competition, and analyze opportunities. You propose and implement appropriate actions to develop your store

You work closely with the Communications Department to organize customer events for your store

o You promote Hermès by getting involved in your local community.

PURCHASING

o You work closely with the Product Offer Department to define your purchasing strategy.

o Based on sales analysis and your knowledge of the clientele, you will make purchases for your store four times a year.

OPTIMIZE OPERATIONS AND STOCK MANAGEMENT

o You will optimize stock management and goods flows to facilitate customer service while optimizing stock levels and quality with the support of the Operations Department.

o You share, explain, apply, and enforce all internal procedures in collaboration with Internal Control.

o You supervise inventories and ensure that markdowns are kept to a minimum.

o You ensure that the store is in excellent condition at all times and suggest maintenance and refurbishment work to the branch management to improve the customer experience and facilitate operations.

PARTICIPATE IN THE SWISS AND POLISH RETAIL COMMUNITY

o You contribute to the life of the subsidiary by participating in various meetings organized by General Management and Retail Management, sharing the vision, ideas, and best practices implemented in your store

o You report regularly on your activities

CANDIDATE PROFILE

\- A sense of teamwork

\- A focus on results

\- High quality standards

\- A curious and entrepreneurial spirit

\- Analytical skills

\- Organizational skills

\- knowledge of IT tools and great agility in using different information systems

\- At least 10 years of experience in managing a commercial entity and leading a team with diverse and multicultural profiles

\- The ability to develop a highly demanding local and international clientele

\- Very good oral and written communication skills in and English, French is a great asset.

**Was du bewegst**

Wir bieten dir faire Bezahlung, klare Strukturen, geregelte Arbeitszeiten und langfristige Perspektiven.



  **für dein ganzes Leben**  




Unser Arbeitsmodell passt sich, wo immer möglich, deinem Leben an. Bei uns bringst du alle Lebensbereiche in Einklang.

Wir geben dir Raum für Entwicklung, Weiterbildung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.

Wir bieten dir praktische Extras, die deinen Alltag erleichtern und bereichern.

Du hast Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess oder zur Arbeitgeberin Stadt Bern? Ich freue mich, dir weiterzuhelfen.

  **Dein Bewerbungsprozess**



So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab:



**Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung**  




Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. **Schritt 3: Weitere Schritte im Prozess**  




Je nach Stelle vereinbaren wir einen Probe\- oder Schnuppertag, stellen dir eine fachliche Aufgabe, organisieren ein Treffen mit dem Team oder laden zu einem Assessment ein. In der Regel gehören auch Referenzauskünfte zu unserem Bewerbungsablauf. Über alle Schritte im Prozess wirst du transparent informiert.  




**Schritt 4: Bewerbungsentscheid**  




Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.
